syllogism: ప్రతి గ్రహం ఒక ఖగోళ వస్తువు. ప్రతి నక్షత్రం ఒక ఖగోళ వస్తువు. గ్రహాలైన అన్ని వస్తువులు జంతువులు. అన్ని గ్రహాలు గానపాఠాలు. అన్ని పూర్ణసంఖ్యల సమితిలో అక్షరాలు లేవు. సంఖ్యల ఒక సమూహం గ్రహాలు. ఫలితంగా, ఖగోళ వస్తువులలో కొంత భాగం సంఖ్యలు.
syllogism_orig: Every planet is a celestial body. Each and every star is a celestial body. All of the things that are planets are animals. All planets are singing lessons. The set of all integers contains no letters. A group of numbers are planets. As a result, a portion of celestial bodies are numbers.

syllogism: Ningún perro es un ave. Hay aves, y todas ellas son animales. Algunos peces son pingüinos. Algunos de los animales conocidos como beagles son perros. Todos los pingüinos pertenecen a la clase de las aves. Se debe concluir que algunas aves son peces.
syllogism_orig: No dog is a bird. There are birds, and all of them are animals. Some fish are penguins. Some of the animals known as beagles are dogs. All penguins belong to the class of birds. One must conclude that some birds are fish.

syllogism: Einige Menschen sind keine Fachleute. Eine Reihe von Frauen sind Menschen. Von den Menschen, die Musiker sind, sind einige von ihnen Programmierer. Es ist wahr, dass alle Physiker Wissenschaftler sind. Alle erfolgreichen Menschen sind solche, die reich sein können. Unter den Menschen, die Wissenschaftler sind, gibt es einige, die auch Programmierer sind. Daraus folgt, dass einige Menschen, die Musiker sind, auch Wissenschaftler sind.
syllogism_orig: Some people are not professionals. A number of women are humans. Of the people who are musicians, a number of them are programmers. It is true that all physicists are scientists. All successful people are those who can be rich. Among the people who are scientists, there are some who are also programmers. It therefore stands that some people who are musicians are also scientists.

syllogism: Alle dingen die katten zijn, zijn katachtigen. Elk ding dat een slang is, is een koudbloedig dier. Het is een feit dat sommige dieren geen insecten zijn. Alles wat een hond genoemd kan worden, is zonder uitzondering een dier. Er bestaan geen gevleugelde wezens die dieren zijn. Elke kat is een dier. Elke hond is een kat.
syllogism_orig: All things that are cats are felines. Every single thing that is a snake is a cold-blooded animal. It is a fact that some animals are not insects. Anything that can be called a dog is, without exception, an animal. There exist no winged creatures that are animals. Every single cat is an animal. Every dog is a cat.

syllogism: Non esistono animali che siano anche piante. Ogni singolo albero è un tipo di pianta. Tutte le cose che sono alberi sono mortali. Nessun essere umano è una pianta. Non esistono pietre che siano vive. Qualsiasi cosa sia un essere umano è un mortale. Ciò significa che tutto ciò che è un albero è un essere umano.
syllogism_orig: There are no animals that are also plants. Every single tree is a type of plant. All things that are trees are mortals. Not a single human is a plant. There are no stones that are alive. Anything that is a human is a mortal. This means that everything that is a tree is a human.

syllogism: Non esistono elementi che siano sia felini che gatti. Alcuni cani sono liquidi. Ogni singolo cane è un animale domestico. Non esistono cani che siano rettili. Nessun cane è un rettile. Nessun liquido è un gatto. Qualsiasi cosa sia un gatto è una creatura con tre occhi. Si conclude che alcuni cani sono gatti.
syllogism_orig: There are no items that are both felines and cats. Some dogs are liquids. Every single dog is a domestic animal. There are no dogs that are reptiles. No dog is a reptile. No liquids are cats. Anything that is a cat is a creature with three eyes. It is concluded that some dogs are cats.

syllogism: Il existe des idées qui sont faites de fromage. Chaque figure géométrique est une émotion. Certaines émotions sont classées comme de la tristesse. Rien de ce qui est une émotion n'est un sentiment. Chaque voiture est une émotion. Chaque idée est une émotion. Il n'est pas le cas que certains cercles soient des émotions. Il doit être le cas que certaines tristesses ne sont pas un sentiment.
syllogism_orig: There are some ideas that are made of cheese. Every single geometric figure is an emotion. Certain emotions are classified as sadness. Nothing that is an emotion is a feeling. Every single car is an emotion. Every single idea is an emotion. It is not the case that some circles are emotions. It must be the case that some sadness is not a feeling.

syllogism: También es cierto que algunos profesionales son seres humanos. Ninguna persona que es doctor es también maestro. Cada enfermero es alguien que puede volar. Cada doctor es un profesional. Todo lo que es doctor es un alienígena. Algunos enfermeros son doctores. Por lo tanto, un cierto número de doctores pueden volar.
syllogism_orig: It is also true that a few professionals are human beings. No person who is a doctor is also a teacher. Every single nurse is someone who can fly. Every single doctor is a professional. Anything that is a doctor is an alien. A few nurses are doctors. Therefore, a certain number of doctors can fly.

syllogism: కొన్ని కుక్కలు శునకాలు. కొన్ని కుక్కలు క్షీరదాలు. ప్రతి ఒక్క పూడిల్ ఒక శునకం. ఏ భవనం కుక్క కాదు. శునకం అయినది ఏదీ పిల్లి కాదు. కాబట్టి, కొన్ని కుక్కలు పిల్లులు.
syllogism_orig: A certain number of dogs are canines. Some of the dogs are mammals. Every single poodle is a canine. No building is a dog. Nothing that is a canine is a cat. Thus, some dogs are cats.

syllogism: Kuna meza ambazo ni furaha. Sehemu ya meza ni ndege. Kuna mawazo ambayo yametengenezwa kwa jibini. Sehemu ya viti ni meza. Pundamilia wote, bila ubaguzi, ni viti. Chochote ambacho ni furaha ni hisia. Kwa hivyo, baadhi ya hisia ni meza.
syllogism_orig: There are some tables that are happiness. A portion of tables are birds. There are some ideas that are made of cheese. A portion of chairs are tables. All zebras are, without exception, chairs. Anything that is happiness is an emotion. Consequently, some emotions are tables.

syllogism: Hay personajes ficticios que son animales. Cada animal con pelaje es una nube. Cada personaje ficticio es una piedra. Una porción de los animales de sangre caliente son mamíferos. Algunas piedras son, de hecho, flores. Por lo tanto, una porción de los animales son piedras.
syllogism_orig: There are fictional characters which are animals. Every single animal with fur is a cloud. Every fictional characters is a stone. A portion of warm-blooded animals are mammals. A few stones are, in fact, flowers. Thus, a portion of animals are stones.

syllogism: কিছু জ্যাক রাসেল আছে যারা কুকুর। প্রতিটি পাখি স্তন্যপায়ী নয়। প্রতিটি কুকুর একটি স্তন্যপায়ী। কিছু প্রাণী স্তন্যপায়ী। প্রতিটি প্রাণী যে কুকুর সে স্তন্যপায়ীও। প্রতিটি প্রাণী যে পুডল সে একটি কুকুর। এটি অনিবার্যভাবে অনুসরণ করে যে কিছু জ্যাক রাসেল স্তন্যপায়ী।
syllogism_orig: There are some jack russels which are dogs. Every single bird is not a mammal. Every dog is a mammal. Some animals are mammals. Every single creature that is a dog is also a mammal. Every single creature that is a poodle is a dog. It necessarily follows that some jack russels are mammals.

syllogism: Ни один предмет, который является морковью, не является болгарским перцем. Всё, что является яблоком, по определению является фруктом. Между категорией овощей и категорией фруктов нет пересечения. Также верно, что ни одна кошка не является овощем. Существуют некоторые морковки, которые являются овощами. Не существует фруктов, которые являются овощами. Яблоки и овощи — это две отдельные категории.
syllogism_orig: None of the items that are carrots are bell peppers. Anything that is an apple is, by definition, a fruit. There is no overlap between the category of vegetables and the category of fruits. It is also true that no cats are vegetables. There are some carrots that are vegetables. There are no fruits which are vegetables. Apples and vegetables are two separate categories.

syllogism: Löwen sind keine Gazellen. Es ist auch wahr, dass jeder Löwe ein Säugetier ist. Alle afrikanischen Löwen sind Dinge, die Löwen sind. Die Klasse der Insekten und die Klasse der Löwen überschneiden sich nicht. Jeder einzelne Löwe ist ein Tier. Daraus folgt, dass es einige afrikanische Löwen gibt, die keine Gazellen sind.
syllogism_orig: Lions are not gazelles. It is also true that every lion is a mammal. All African lions are things that are lions. The class of insects and the class of lions do not overlap. Every single lion is an animal. It follows that there are some African lions that are not gazelles.

syllogism: Alle Dinge, die Dreiecke sind, sind Vielecke. Es gibt keine Dreiecke, die Quadrate sind. Jeder einzelne Gegenstand, der vier gleiche Seiten hat, hat vier Seiten. Alle Dinge, die Dreiecke sind, sind geometrische Formen. Ein Quadrat, jedes einzelne davon, ist eine geometrische Form. Es gibt kein Dreieck, das ein Quadrat ist. Jedes einzelne Dreieck ist ein Vieleck. Es ist der Fall, dass einige Vielecke keine Quadrate sind.
syllogism_orig: All things which are triangles are polygons. There are no triangles which are squares. Every single object that has four equal sides has four sides. All things which are triangles are geometric shapes. A square, every single one of them, is a geometric shape. There is no triangle that is a square. Every single triangle is a polygon. It's the case that some polygons are not squares.

syllogism: No existen cucharas que sean soles. Todos los planetas son lecciones de canto. Ninguna cuchara es un tenedor. Todas las cosas que son reptiles son vertebrados. Todo objeto que orbita una estrella es un planeta. Cualquier cosa que sea una estrella es una cuchara. De esto, podemos deducir que algunos soles no son estrellas.
syllogism_orig: There exist no spoons that are suns. All planets are singing lessons. No spoons are forks. All things that are reptiles are vertebrates. Every object that orbits a star is a planet. Anything that is a star is a spoon. From this, we can deduce that some suns are not stars.

syllogism: È anche vero che ogni leone è un mammifero. Ogni persona che è un bambino è un mortale. Ogni singolo essere umano è una creatura mortale. Un sottoinsieme dei mammiferi è composto da donne. Tutti i mortali sono umani. Nessun umano è un animale acquatico. Di conseguenza, ogni singolo umano è un bambino.
syllogism_orig: It is also true that every lion is a mammal. Every person who is a child is a mortal. Every single human being is a mortal creature. A subset of mammals is composed of women. All mortals are humans. Not a single human is an aquatic animal. Consequently, every single human is a child.

syllogism: Ci sono alcune lune che sono rocce. Ogni stella è un corpo celeste. Ci sono alcuni pianeti che sono rose. Tutte le rose sono, in effetti, fiori. È anche vero che alcune piante sono fiori. Ne consegue che alcuni fiori sono pianeti.
syllogism_orig: There are some moons that are rocks. Each and every star is a celestial body. There are some planets which are roses. All roses are, in fact, flowers. It is also true that some plants are flowers. It follows that some flowers are planets.

syllogism: Kila mtu ni binadamu. Ni uwongo kabisa kwamba watu ambao ni wanafunzi ni vitu visivyo na uhai. Wapo wanafunzi ambao ni watu wazima. Hakuna wanafunzi ambao ni wataalamu. Kila mtu ambaye ni mwanafunzi ni mtu. Kwa hivyo hakuna mtu yeyote ambaye ni mtu mzima.
syllogism_orig: Every single person is a human. It is completely false that people who are students are inhanimate objects. There exist students that are adults. No students are professionals. Every single person who is a student is a person. It follows that not a single person is an adult.

syllogism: এটাও সত্য যে কোনো কুকুর পাথর নয়। এটা সত্য নয় যে কোনো পাখি বিড়াল। প্রতিটি কুকুরই একটি স্তন্যপায়ী। স্তন্যপায়ীদের একটি অংশকে ঘেউ ঘেউ করতে পারে এমন প্রাণী হিসেবে শ্রেণীবদ্ধ করা যায়। কোনো কুকুর সরীসৃপ নয়। যা কিছু জীবন্ত বস্তু তা-ই একটি প্রাণী। কিছু ঘেউ ঘেউ করতে পারে এমন প্রাণী কুকুর নয়।
syllogism_orig: It is also true that no dogs are rocks. It is not true that any bird is a cat. Every single dog is a mammal. A portion of mammals can be classified as creatures that bark. No dog is a reptile. Everything that is a living thing is a creature. Some creatures that can bark are not dogs.

syllogism: Die Entität, die als Frankreich bekannt ist, ist ein Land. Jede Hauptstadt wird als Großstadt angesehen. Ein Teil der Hauptstädte befindet sich in Europa. Jedes einzelne Land hat eine Hauptstadt. Es gibt zumindest einen Teil von Frankreich, der eine Hauptstadt hat.
syllogism_orig: The entity known as France is a country. Every capital city is considered a major city. A portion of capital cities are located in Europe. Every single country has a capital city. There is at least some part of France that has a capital city.

syllogism: Kuna miezi mingine ambayo ni miamba. Chochote ambacho ni sayari ni kitu cha angani. Hakuna Dunia hata moja ambayo ni kitu cha angani. Kila kitu ambacho ni salamanda ni sayari. Haiwezekani kwa daraja kuwa kitu cha angani. Hakuna nyota ambazo ni sayari. Kila nyota ni kitu cha angani. Kwa hivyo ni kweli kwamba kila kitu cha angani ni sayari.
syllogism_orig: There are some moons that are rocks. Anything that is a planet is a celestial body. Not a single Earth is a celestial body. Everything that is a salamander is a planet. It is impossible for a bridge to be a celestial body. There are no stars that are planets. Each and every star is a celestial body. It is therefore true that every celestial body is a planet.

syllogism: Nessun insetto è un animale. Alcuni animali acquatici sono uccelli. Ogni singola formica è un insetto. Ogni singolo mammifero è un animale. Qualsiasi cosa sia un rettile è anche un animale. Di conseguenza, nessuna formica è un animale.
syllogism_orig: There are no insects that are animals. Some aquatic animals are things that are birds. Every single ant is an insect. Every single mammal is an animal. Anything that is a reptile is also an animal. Consequently, nothing that is an ant is an animal.

syllogism: టెక్నాలజీ అయిన ప్రతిదీ ఒక ఫర్నీచర్ ముక్క. ఫర్నీచర్ అయిన కుర్చీలు ఏవీ లేవు. ఫర్నీచర్ అయిన సోఫాలు ఏవీ లేవు. అన్ని ఫర్నీచర్లు వస్తువులు అనేది కూడా నిజం. బెంచ్ అయిన ప్రతి వస్తువు ఒక కుర్చీ. కుర్చీ అయిన ప్రతిదీ ఒక సోఫా.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a technology is a piece of furniture. There are no chairs that are furniture. There are no sofas that are furniture. It is also true that all furniture are objects. Any object that is a bench is a chair. Anything that is a chair is a sofa.

syllogism: Hakuna kitu ambacho ni chombo cha usafiri kinachoweza kuruka. Angalau gari moja halina magurudumu. Hakuna kitu ambacho ni chombo cha usafiri ambacho pia ni gari. Kila ndege ni chombo cha usafiri. Kundi la magari ya binafsi linajumuisha baadhi ambayo ni magari. Majengo yote yaliyopo ni magari. Kila chombo cha usafiri kina magurudumu. Kwa hivyo ni ukweli kwamba hakuna ndege inayoweza kuruka.
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is a vehicle is able to fly. At least one car does not have wheels. There is no item that is a vehicle which is also a car. Each and every airplane is a vehicle. The group of automobiles includes some that are cars. All buildings in existence are cars. Every vehicle has wheels. It is therefore a fact that no airplane is able to fly.

syllogism: По крайней мере одна вещь, которая является газовым гигантом, является планетой. Каждый, кто является животным, является живым существом. Ни одно здание не является животным. Некоторые кошки являются млекопитающими. Некоторые животные являются людьми. Вывод о том, что ни одно здание не является живым существом, неизбежен.
syllogism_orig: At least one thing that is a gas giant is a planet. Every single person who is an animal is a living thing. Not a single building is an animal. A few cats are mammals. Some animals are human. The conclusion that no buildings are living things is inescapable.

syllogism: Qualsiasi cosa che sia un mammifero è un organismo vivente. Ci sono alcuni animali che non sono mammiferi. È anche vero che nessun gatto è un vegetale. Tutto ciò che è un cane è un mammifero. Ogni singolo cane è un organismo vivente. Non ci sono animali che siano vegetali. Ciascun felino è un animale. Pertanto, ogni cane è un animale.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a mammal is a living organism. There are some animals that are not mammals. It is also true that no cats are vegetables. Everything that is a dog is a mammal. Every single dog is an living organism. There are no animals that are vegetables. Each and every feline is an animal. Thus, every dog is an animal.

syllogism: 所有建筑物都是结构体。有些建筑物不是摩天大楼。没有任何房屋是体育场。每辆汽车都是交通工具。没有任何建筑物可以被视为交通工具。因此，有些结构体不是摩天大楼。
syllogism_orig: All buildings are considered structures. There are some buildings that are not skyscrapers. Not a single house is a stadium. Every car is a vehicle. Nothing that is a building can be considered a vehicle. It is therefore true that some structures are not skyscrapers.

syllogism: আইনজীবীরা, ব্যতিক্রম ছাড়াই, পেশাদার। এমন কোনো ডাক্তার নেই যারা চিকিৎসা ডিগ্রিধারী ব্যক্তি নয়। কোনো ছাত্র পেশাদার নয়। এটি সত্য যে প্রতিটি শিক্ষক একজন কলেজ স্নাতক। কিছু পেশাদার কলেজ স্নাতক হিসেবেও পরিচিত। অতএব, এই সিদ্ধান্তে উপনীত হওয়া যায় যে কিছু পেশাদার শিক্ষকও বটে।
syllogism_orig: Lawyers are, without exception, professionals. There are no doctors who are not people with medical degrees. No students are professionals. It is the case that every teacher is a college graduate. Some professionals are also known to be college graduates. Thus, it can be concluded that some professionals are also teachers.

syllogism: Elk fictieboek is een verhaal. Alle boeken zijn publicaties. Niets dat een tijdschrift is, is een boek. Er zijn geen boeken die zowel fictie als non-fictie zijn. Elke roman is een boek. Alles wat een roman is, is een boek. Er zijn enkele posters die geen boeken zijn. Uit deze feiten blijkt duidelijk dat enkele publicaties romans zijn.
syllogism_orig: Every single fiction book is a story. All books are publications. Nothing that is a magazine is a book. There are no books that are fiction and also non-fiction. Every novel is a book. Anything that is a novel is a book. There are some posters that are not books. From these facts, it is clear that a few publications are novels.

syllogism: Es gibt kein einziges Auto, das ein Himmel ist. Jeder Himmel ist ein blaues Ding. Einige Wassertiere sind Dinge, die Vögel sind. Einige der Dinge, die Fahrzeuge sind, sind Autos. Mindestens ein Ding, das ein Gasriese ist, ist ein Planet. Alles, was einen Verbrennungsmotor hat, braucht Treibstoff. Daraus lässt sich schließen, dass kein Auto ein blaues Ding ist.
syllogism_orig: There is not a single car that is a sky. Every sky is a blue thing. Some aquatic animals are things that are birds. Some of the things that are vehicles are cars. At least one thing that is a gas giant is a planet. Anything with an internal combustion engine needs fuel. It can be concluded that no car is a blue thing.

syllogism: Les météores sont, sans exception, des planètes. Tout ce qui est une étoile est froid. Aucune étoile n'est un météore. Toutes les choses qui sont des ponts sont des animaux. Tout objet qui orbite autour d'une étoile est une planète. Un certain nombre de planètes sont des étoiles.
syllogism_orig: Meteors are, without exception, planets. Everything that is a star is cold. No star is a meteor. All of the things that are bridges are animals. Every object that orbits a star is a planet. A number of planets are stars.

syllogism: Каждый объект, который является живым существом, является объектом, обладающим массой. Звёзды и газовые гиганты не имеют абсолютно ничего общего. Каждая морковь является овощем. Верно, что каждая ручка является объектом. Некоторые вещи не являются ручками. Не существует ничего, что является овощем и одновременно является фруктом. Из этого можно утверждать, что некоторые вещи не являются объектами.
syllogism_orig: Every object that is a living thing is an object with mass. Stars and gas giants have no overlap whatsoever. Every single thing that is a carrot is a vegetable. It is true that every pen is an object. Some things are not pens. There is nothing that is a vegetable that is also a fruit. From this, it can be claimed that some things are not objects.

syllogism: Toda criatura que é um canino é um mamífero. Existem animais de estimação que são mamíferos. Nenhum felino é um canino. Nenhum cão é uma ave. Uma parte dos caninos são cães. Qualquer coisa que seja um peixe nada. É o caso que tudo que é um cão é um mamífero. Portanto, é o caso que alguns cães são mamíferos.
syllogism_orig: Every single creature that is a canine is a mammal. There are pets which are mammals. There are no felines that are canines. No dog is a bird. A portion of canines are dogs. Anything that is a fish swims. It is the case that everything which is a dog is a mammal. It is therefore the case that some dogs are mammals.

syllogism: Elk wezen dat als vogel wordt geïdentificeerd, is een wezen met veren. Er zijn geen vissen die zoogdieren zijn. Alles wat een mus is, is ook een vogel. Er zijn enkele vleermuizen die geen vogels zijn. Sommige dieren die bekend staan als beagles zijn honden. Dit betekent noodzakelijkerwijs dat sommige vleermuizen geen mussen zijn.
syllogism_orig: Every single creature identified as a bird is a creature with feathers. There are no fish that are mammals. Anything that is a sparrow is also a bird. There are some bats which are not birds. Some of the animals known as beagles are dogs. This necessarily means that some bats are not sparrows.

syllogism: Tous les mortels sont des humains. Il n'existe aucun poisson qui soit un avocat. Toute personne qui est un politicien est un mortel. Pas un seul humain n'est une plante. Tout objet qui est un être vivant est un objet ayant une masse. Par conséquent, chaque humain est un politicien.
syllogism_orig: All mortals are humans. There are no fish that are lawyers. Every person who is a politician is a mortal. Not a single human is a plant. Every object that is a living thing is an object with mass. Consequently, every single human is a politician.

syllogism: Ci sono alcuni corpi celesti che sono stelle. Niente che sia un pianeta è un corpo celeste che orbita attorno a un altro corpo celeste. Alcune stelle sono soli. L'insieme delle stelle e l'insieme dei corpi celesti che orbitano attorno ad altri corpi celesti sono mutuamente esclusivi. Ogni cucchiaio è un pianeta. L'intero gruppo dei pianeti è costituito da stelle.
syllogism_orig: There are some celestial bodies that are stars. Nothing that is a planet is a celestial body that orbits another celestial body. A few stars are suns. The set of stars and the set of celestial bodies that orbit other celestial bodies are mutually exclusive. Every spoon is a planet. The entire group of planets consists of stars.

syllogism: Existe um subconjunto de plantas que são frutas. Todas as árvores são, por definição, plantas. Qualquer coisa que seja um vegetal é uma planta. Algumas plantas são um tipo de vegetal. Toda e qualquer coisa que seja uma cenoura é um vegetal. Toda e qualquer maçã é uma fruta. Alguns vegetais não são frutas.
syllogism_orig: There is a subset of plants that are fruits. All trees are, by definition, plants. Anything that is a vegetable is a plant. Some plants are a type of vegetable. Every single thing that is a carrot is a vegetable. Every single apple is a fruit. A number of vegetables are not fruits.

syllogism: Todo lo que es una rosa es una planta. Todos los árboles son, por definición, plantas. Todo lo que pertenece a la clase de los árboles es una planta de más de 20 pies de altura. Ninguna de las cosas que son arbustos son plantas de más de 20 pies de altura. Algunas plantas son un tipo de vegetal. Los árboles y los arbustos no pertenecen al mismo grupo.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a rose is a plant. All trees are, by definition, plants. Anything that belongs to the class of trees is a plant over 20 feet tall. None of the things that are shrubs are plants over 20 feet tall. Some plants are a type of vegetable. Trees and shrubs do not belong to the same group.

syllogism: Nada que sea un océano es un gas. Cualquier cosa que sea un océano es un desierto. Nada que sea un líquido es H2O. No existe ninguna criatura acuática que pueda respirar bajo el agua. Cualquier objeto que sea un cuerpo de agua es un gas. Existe al menos un cuerpo de agua que no es un océano.
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is an ocean is a gas. Anything which is an ocean is a desert. Nothing that is a liquid is H2O. There is no such thing as a water creature that is able to breathe underwater. Any object that is a body of water is a gas. There exists at least one body of water which is not an ocean.

syllogism: Каждый автомобиль является моторизованным транспортным средством. Часть предметов, которые являются автомобилями, также являются транспортными средствами. Верно, что все автомобили являются транспортными средствами. Всё, что является велосипедом, является транспортным средством. Нет ни одного автомобиля, который является велосипедом. Известно, что ни один грузовик не является велосипедом. Не существует предмета, который является транспортным средством и одновременно автомобилем. Из этого следует вывод, что ни один грузовик не является транспортным средством.
syllogism_orig: Every car is a motorized vehicle. A portion of the items that are automobiles are also vehicles. It is true that all cars are vehicles. Anything that is a bicycle is a vehicle. There are no cars that are bicycles. It is known that no trucks are bicycles. There is no item that is a vehicle which is also a car. This leads to the conclusion that no truck is a vehicle.

syllogism: Algunas piedras son, de hecho, flores. Las plantas nunca son piedras. No hay piedras que estén vivas. No hay árboles que sean piedras. Cada diamante es una piedra. Todo lo que es una piedra es suave. Una cierta cantidad de diamantes es suave.
syllogism_orig: A few stones are, in fact, flowers. Plants are never stones. There are no stones that are alive. There are no trees that are stones. Every single diamond is a stone. Anything that is a stone is soft. A certain quantity of diamonds is soft.

syllogism: Tudo que é um pássaro é um animal. Todas as coisas que são gatos são felinos. É o caso que nenhum gato é um cão. Também é verdade que nenhum pássaro é um gato. Não há um único mamífero que seja um gato. Assim, pode-se concluir que alguns pássaros são cães.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a bird is an animal. All things that are cats are felines. It is the case that no cats are dogs. It is also true that no birds are cats. There is not a single mammal that is a cat. Thus, it can be concluded that some birds are dogs.

syllogism: Todo bicicleta é um veículo. Todo carro é um veículo. Alguns carros possuem um motor de combustão interna. Também é verdade que nenhuma bicicleta é um carro. É verdade que todos os carros são veículos. Qualquer coisa que seja um carro é um veículo. Tudo que é uma bicicleta é um veículo. É o caso que algumas bicicletas não são carros.
syllogism_orig: Every bicycle is a vehicle. Every single car is a vehicle. Some cars possess an internal combustion engine. It is also true that no bikes are cars. It is true that all cars are vehicles. Anything that is a car is a vehicle. Everything that is a bicycle is a vehicle. It is the case that some bicycles are not cars.

syllogism: প্রতিটি জিনিস যা একটি গাজর তা একটি সবজি। কোনো কিছু যা একটি পাথর তা একটি মাংস নয়। প্রতিটি আপেল একটি ফল। এমন কিছু নেই যা একটি সবজি এবং একই সাথে একটি ফলও। এটাও সত্য যে কোনো ফল একটি মাংস নয়। অতএব, কোনো ফল একটি পাথর নয়।
syllogism_orig: Every single thing that is a carrot is a vegetable. Nothing that is a stone is a meat. Every single apple is a fruit. There is nothing that is a vegetable that is also a fruit. It is also the case that no fruit is a meat. Therefore, no fruit is a stone.

syllogism: Elke hond is een zoogdier. Alles wat een vogel is, is een vliegend wezen. Geen enkel dier dat een hond is, is een vogel. Een aantal haaien zijn vissen. Er zijn geen insecten die vogels zijn. Elke vogel die bestaat is van glas gemaakt. Er zijn enkele roodborstjes die vogels zijn. Hieruit volgt dat enkele roodborstjes van glas gemaakt zijn.
syllogism_orig: Every single dog is a mammal. Anything that is a bird is a flying creature. No animal that is a dog is a bird. A number of sharks are fish. There are no insects which are birds. Every bird in existence is made of glass. There are some robins that are birds. It follows, then, that some robins are made of glass.

syllogism: Kein Tier, das ein Primat ist, ist auch ein Fisch. Es gibt kein Lebewesen mit Federn, das auch ein Insekt ist. Es ist nicht der Fall, dass jeder Mensch männlich ist. Es gibt kein Tier, das ein Lebewesen ist. Jeder Pinguin ist ein Lebewesen. Jeder einzelne Mensch ist ein Lebewesen mit zehn Beinen. Daraus folgt, dass einige Lebewesen mit zehn Beinen männlich sind.
syllogism_orig: No animals that are primates are also fish. There are no creatures with feathers which are also insects. It is not the case that every human is a male. There is no animal that is a living creature. Any penguin is a living creature. Every single human is a creature with ten legs. From this, it follows that some creatures with ten legs are males.

syllogism: 凡是鸟都是脊椎动物。每只鸟都是鱼。没有鱼是麻雀。有些鸟是鹦鹉。有些人不是昆虫。由此必然得出，有些麻雀不是鸟。
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a bird is a vertebrate. Every bird is a fish. There are no fish which are sparrows. Some birds are parrots. There are some people who are not insects. This necessarily suggests that some sparrows are not birds.

syllogism: Kila kitu chenye pande nne sawa kina pande nne. Hakuna pembetatu ambayo ni mraba. Pembetatu kamwe si mraba. Hakuna maumbo ambayo ni pembetatu ambayo pia yanaweza kuelezwa kuwa ni quadrilaterali. Pia ni kweli kwamba hakuna duara ambalo ni mraba. Chochote ambacho ni mraba ni quadrilaterali. Vitu vyote ambavyo ni pembetatu ni maumbo ya jiometri. Kuna pembetatu fulani ambazo si miraba.
syllogism_orig: Every single object that has four equal sides has four sides. There is no triangle that is a square. A triangle is never a square. There are no shapes that are triangles which can also be described as quadrilaterals. It is also the case that no circle is a square. Anything that is a square is a quadrilateral. All things which are triangles are geometric shapes. There exist certain triangles that are not squares.

syllogism: Las zanahorias son, en todos los casos, verduras. No hay animales que sean verduras. Ninguno de los elementos que son zanahorias son pimientos. Hay algunas zanahorias que son verduras. No hay frutas que sean verduras. No hay verduras que puedan describirse como frutas. Cada plátano es un tipo de fruta. Por lo tanto, es seguro que ninguna zanahoria es una fruta.
syllogism_orig: Carrots are, in every instance, vegetables. There are no animals that are vegetables. None of the items that are carrots are bell peppers. There are some carrots that are vegetables. There are no fruits which are vegetables. There are no vegetables that can be described as fruits. Every single banana is a type of fruit. Therefore, it is certain that no carrots are fruits.

syllogism: Некоторые из того, что является напитками, являются жидкостями. Не существует автомобилей, которые являются жидкостями. Все твёрдые тела также являются мокрыми. Не существует газов, которые также являются жидкостями. Также верно, что ни один газ не является твёрдым телом. Каждая жидкость является мокрой. Следовательно, ничто, что является твёрдым телом, не является не жидкостью.
syllogism_orig: Some of the things that are beverages are liquids. There are no cars that are liquids. All solids are also wet. There are no gases which are also liquids. It is also the case that no gas is a solid. Every single liquid is wet. Therefore, nothing that is a solid is not a liquid.

syllogism: Cada gato es una criatura viviente. Cada perro es una criatura viviente. Es cierto que algunos gorriones son criaturas voladoras. Cada mamífero es un gato. Cada caniche es un perro. Por lo tanto, hay algunos perros que no son gatos.
syllogism_orig: Every single cat is a living creature. Every single dog is a living creature. It is true that some sparrows are flying creatures. Every single mammal is a cat. Every poodle is a dog. As such, there are some dogs that are not cats.

syllogism: Kila simba ni jengo. Hakuna nyumba ambayo ni uwanja wa michezo. Kuna majengo ambayo ni nyumba. Muundo wowote ambao ni nyumba umetengenezwa kwa chokoleti. Kila mbwa ni mnyama wa kufugwa. Hii inamaanisha kwamba majengo mengine yametengenezwa kwa chokoleti.
syllogism_orig: Every single lion is a building. Not a single house is a stadium. There are some buildings which are houses. Any structure which is a house is made of chocolate. Every single dog is a domestic animal. This means that some buildings are made of chocolate.

syllogism: Ten minste één ding dat een gasreus is, is een planeet. Alles wat een levend organisme is, is een ding dat energie verbruikt. Er zijn geen dingen die geen planten zijn die planten zijn. Alles wat een vogel is, is een dier. Alle planten zijn dingen die energie verbruiken. Sommige planten zijn een soort groente. Dit betekent dat alle planten levende organismen zijn.
syllogism_orig: At least one thing that is a gas giant is a planet. Everything that is a living organism is a thing that consumes energy. There are no items that are not plants that are plants. Anything that is a bird is an animal. Any and all plants are things that consume energy. Some plants are a type of vegetable. This means that all plants are living organisms.

syllogism: ప్రతి రాజధాని నగరం ఒక ప్రధాన నగరంగా పరిగణించబడుతుంది. నదులు సముద్రాలు అయినవి ఏవీ లేవు. కొన్ని పెద్ద నగరాలు రాజధాని నగరాలుగా వర్గీకరించబడ్డాయి. రాజధాని నగరాలలో కొంత భాగం ఐరోపాలో ఉన్నాయి. సముద్రాలు అయిన రాజధాని నగరాలు ఏవీ లేవు. ఏ సముద్రమూ ఒక ఖండం అనేది నిజం కాదు. కాబట్టి, కొన్ని పెద్ద నగరాలు సముద్రాలు కావు అనేది స్పష్టం.
syllogism_orig: Every capital city is considered a major city. There are no rivers that are oceans. A select few large cities are classified as capital cities. A portion of capital cities are located in Europe. There are no capital cities which are oceans. It is not true that any ocean is a continent. Therefore, it is clear that some large cities are not oceans.

syllogism: অন্তত একটি গাছ একটি উদ্ভিদ। এমন কোনো উদ্ভিদ নেই যাকে গাছ বলা যায়। এটাও সত্য যে প্রতিটি উদ্ভিদ এক ধরনের সবজি। গাছ যা কিছু তা সবই উদ্ভিদ। প্রতিটি ওক একটি গাছ। এর থেকে এই সিদ্ধান্তে উপনীত হওয়া গেছে যে প্রতিটি সবজি একটি গাছ।
syllogism_orig: At least one tree is a plant. There are no plants that can be called trees. It is also true that every plant is a type of vegetable. Everything that is a tree is a plant. Every single oak is a tree. This has led to the conclusion that every vegetable is a tree.

syllogism: Todo e qualquer felino é um animal. Não é verdade que alguma ave seja um gato. É um fato que alguns animais não são peixes. Todo e qualquer mamífero é um vertebrado. Existem alguns animais que são aves. Alguns animais aquáticos podem ser considerados peixes. Deve ser o caso que nenhum peixe é uma ave.
syllogism_orig: Each and every feline is an animal. It is not true that any bird is a cat. It is a fact that some animals are not fish. Every single mammal is a vertebrate. There are some animals that are birds. Some aquatic animals can be considered fish. It must be the case that no fish is a bird.

syllogism: যা কিছু রোবট তা জল দিয়ে তৈরি। যা কিছু তারা তা ঠান্ডা। কিছু গ্রহ আছে যা তারা। প্রতিটি তারা একটি গ্রহ। পৃথিবী একটি গ্রহ। কোনো গ্রহ সূর্য নয়। অতএব এটি একটি সঠিক সিদ্ধান্ত যে কিছু সূর্য তারা নয়।
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a robot is a thing made of water. Everything that is a star is cold. There are some planets that are stars. Every single star is a planet. The Earth is a planet. No planets are suns. It is therefore a sound deduction that some suns are not stars.

syllogism: Tutte le persone che sono fisici sono scienziati. Non è il caso che ogni singolo scienziato sia un ingegnere. Qualsiasi cosa che sia uno scienziato è una persona che studia. Ogni scienziato è un ascensore. Ogni singola persona che è un dottore è anche un medico praticante. È vero che tutti i fisici sono scienziati. Ne consegue che alcuni ascensori sono ingegneri.
syllogism_orig: All people who are physicists are scientists. It is not the case that every single scientist is an engineer. Anything that is a scientist is a person who studies. Every scientist is an elevator. Every single person who is a doctor is also a medical practitioner. It is true that all physicists are scientists. It follows from this that some elevators are engineers.

syllogism: Cada ave es un animal que tiene alas. Todo animal que es un gato es un vertebrado. Todo lo que es un gato es un animal. No es cierto que algún ave sea un gato. Cada ave es un vertebrado. Por lo tanto, algunos animales con alas deben ser vertebrados.
syllogism_orig: Each bird is an animal that has wings. Every single animal that is a cat is a vertebrate. Everything that is a cat is an animal. It is not true that any bird is a cat. Each bird is a vertebrate. So, some animals with wings must be vertebrates.

syllogism: Einige Haie sind keine Fische. Alles, was ein Pinguin ist, ist auch ein Vogel. Jedes Tier ist ein Säugetier. Es ist auch wahr, dass keine Hunde Steine sind. Jedes Tier, das eine Katze ist, ist eine Wolke. Alle Dinge, die Fische sind, sind Wirbeltiere. Alle Fische sind Tiere, die im Wasser leben. Wir können schließen, dass einige Haie keine Tiere sind, die im Wasser leben.
syllogism_orig: Some sharks are not fish. Anything that is a penguin is also a bird. Every animal is a mammal. It is also true that no dogs are rocks. Any animal that is a cat is a cloud. All things that are fish are vertebrates. All fish are animals that live in water. We can infer that some sharks are not animals that live in water.

syllogism: కుక్కలు రాళ్ళు కావు అనేది కూడా నిజమే. కొన్ని జంతువులు క్షీరదాలు. కొన్ని చేపలు పిల్లులు. కుక్క అయిన ప్రతిదీ జంతువు. ప్రతి ఒక్క పిల్లి జంతువు. చేపలు ఏ విధంగానూ జంతువులు కావు.
syllogism_orig: It is also true that no dogs are rocks. Some animals are mammals. There are some fish which are cats. Everything that is a dog is an animal. Every single cat is an animal. Fish are in no way animals.

syllogism: Qualsiasi cosa che sia una nuvola è fatta di roccia. Almeno una cosa che è un gigante gassoso è un pianeta. Ci sono alcune cose che sono nuvole che non sono fatte di acqua. È impossibile che qualcosa sia un organismo e una creatura allo stesso tempo. Ogni singola nuvola è fatta di vapore. Tutte le cose che sono tigri sono felini. Da ciò consegue che esistono alcune cose fatte di vapore che non sono fatte di acqua.
syllogism_orig: Anything which is a cloud is made of rock. At least one thing that is a gas giant is a planet. There are some things which are clouds that are not made of water. It is impossible for something to be an organism and a creature at the same time. Every single cloud is made of vapour. All things that are tigers are felines. It follows from this that there exist some things made of vapour that are not made of water.

syllogism: Alles wat een vis is, zwemt. Er zijn geen honden die katten zijn. Het is het geval dat geen kat een vis is. Sommige dieren die bekend staan als beagles zijn honden. Er zijn sommige dieren die katten zijn. Het is ook waar dat geen katten groenten zijn. Daarom is het mogelijk te concluderen dat sommige vissen geen honden zijn.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a fish swims. There are no dogs that are cats. It is the case that no cat is a fish. Some of the animals known as beagles are dogs. There are some animals which are cats. It is also true that no cats are vegetables. Therefore, it is possible to conclude that some fish are not dogs.

syllogism: Todo lo que es un cuadrado es también un polígono. Todo lo que es un cuadrado tiene cuatro lados iguales. No hay ningún cuadrado que sea un círculo. También es el caso de que ningún círculo es un cuadrado. Algunas de las figuras son cuadrados. Un cuadrado, cada uno de ellos, es una forma geométrica. Se sabe que no hay círculos que sean cuadrados. Por lo tanto, es el caso de que algunas figuras son círculos.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a square is also a polygon. Anything that is a square has four equal sides. There is no square that is a circle. It is also the case that no circle is a square. Some of the shapes are squares. A square, every single one of them, is a geometric shape. It is known that there are no circles that are squares. Therefore, it is the case that some shapes are circles.

syllogism: Una parte dei vertebrati sono squali. Ogni pesce è una creatura che è un anfibio. Esistono creature che sono squali che non sono creature che vivono nell'acqua. Esistono alcuni uccelli che sono pesci. Esistono alcuni pesci che sono pesci ossei. Qualsiasi cosa che sia un cane è un mammifero. Senza eccezione, tutti gli squali sono pesci. Pertanto, è certo che ogni squalo è un anfibio.
syllogism_orig: A portion of vertebrates are sharks. Every fish is a creature that is an amphibian. There exist creatures which are sharks that are not creatures that leave in water. There exist some birds that are fish. There exist some fish that are bony fish. Anything that is a dog is a mammal. Without exception, all sharks are fish. Therefore, it is certain that every shark is an amphibian.

syllogism: Todo hombre es soltero. Toda persona que es hombre es un humano. No es el caso que todo humano sea un hombre. Todo papa es un hombre. Todo sacerdote es un hombre. Todo hombre es un humano. Todo lo que es sacerdote es un hombre. Se concluye necesariamente que todo papa es un sacerdote.
syllogism_orig: Every man is a bachelor. Any person who is a man is a human. It is not the case that every huma is a man. Every single pope is a man. Every single priest is a man. Every single man is a human. Anything that is a priest is a man. It is necessarily concluded that every pope is a priest.

syllogism: Каждая птица является животным. Верно, что ни одна птица не является насекомым. Ни одна из вещей, которые являются птицами, не является насекомым. Неверно, что какие-либо рыбы являются кошками. Всё, что является животным, является нелетающим существом. Каждый лев является животным. Ничто из того, что является животным, не является неживым существом. Нет ни одной птицы, которая не была бы нелетающим существом.
syllogism_orig: Every single bird is an animal. It is true that no birds are insects. None of the things that are birds are insects. It is not true that any fish are cats. Anything which is an animal is a flightless thing. Every single lion is an animal. Nothing that is an animal is a non-living thing. There are no birds that are not flightless.

syllogism: Het is waar dat geen enkele vis een zwemmer is. Er zijn geen bomen die niet kunnen teleporteren. Alles wat een wetenschapper is, is een professional. Elk vliegend object is een wezen met vleugels. Sommige mensen zijn geen professionals. Er zijn vissen, en sommige daarvan zijn tonijnen. Op basis hiervan moet het zo zijn dat een bepaalde hoeveelheid tonijnen geen zwemmers zijn.
syllogism_orig: It is true that no fish is a swimmer. There are no trees that cannot teleport. Anything that is a scientist is a professional. Every flying object is a creature with wings. Some people are not professionals. There are fish, and some of them are tuna. Based on this, it must be the case that a certain amount of tuna are not swimmers.

syllogism: 每一头大象都是哺乳动物。每个人类都是一种哺乳动物。至少存在一种生物既是哺乳动物又是海豚。一些大象是哺乳动物。有些宠物是哺乳动物。存在一些鱼是哺乳动物。因此，一些大象是鱼。
syllogism_orig: Every single elephant is a mammal. Every human is a kind of mammal. There exists at least one creature that is a mammal and also a dolphin. A few elephants are mammals. There are pets which are mammals. There exist some fish that are mammals. Consequently, some elephants are fish.

syllogism: ముక్కులు కలిగిన చేపలు అయిన జంతువులు ఏవీ లేవు. పాము అయిన ప్రతి ఒక్కటి శీతల రక్త జంతువు. అన్ని పక్షులు ముక్కులు కలిగిన జంతువులు. ఏ కుక్క కూడా పక్షి కాదు. అన్ని చిలుకలు పక్షులుగా వర్గీకరించబడ్డాయి. అందువల్ల, కొన్ని పక్షులు చేపలు కావు అని చెప్పవచ్చు.
syllogism_orig: There are no animals that are fish that have beaks. Every single thing that is a snake is a cold-blooded animal. All birds are animals that have beaks. No dog is a bird. All parrots are classified as birds. Consequently, it can be said that some birds are not fish.

syllogism: É o caso que nenhum animal voador é um pinguim. Toda e qualquer coisa que é uma cobra é um animal de sangue frio. É o caso que nenhuma ave é um peixe. Todo mamífero é um animal. Toda e qualquer coisa que é um cão é um mamífero. Disto, segue-se que alguns animais são de fato cães.
syllogism_orig: It is the case that no flying animal is a penguin. Every single thing that is a snake is a cold-blooded animal. It is the case that no bird is a fish. Every mammal is an animal. Every single thing that is a dog is a mammal. From this, it follows that some animals are indeed dogs.

syllogism: Les araignées ne peuvent pas être des arachnides. Il y a certaines araignées qui sont des arachnides. Chaque arachnide a six pattes. Il est le cas qu'aucun arachnide n'a huit pattes. C'est un fait que toutes les tarentules sont des araignées. Il faut en conclure que certaines tarentules ne sont pas des arachnides.
syllogism_orig: Spiders cannot be arachnids. There are some spiders that are arachnids. Every single arachnid has six legs. It is the case that no arachnid has eight legs. It is a fact that all tarantulas are spiders. It must be concluded that some tarantulas are not arachnids.

syllogism: Qualquer coisa que seja um instrumento de escrita é um objeto. Também é verdade que todos os móveis são objetos. Todo objeto que orbita uma estrela é um planeta. Todo objeto voador é uma criatura com asas. Qualquer coisa que seja um gigante gasoso é um objeto que é um planeta. Cadeiras de forma alguma são móveis. Tudo que é uma cadeira é um objeto. Existem alguns objetos que não são móveis.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a writing tool is an object. It is also true that all furniture are objects. Every object that orbits a star is a planet. Every flying object is a creature with wings. Anything that is a gas giant is an object that is a planet. Chairs are in no way furniture. Everything that is a chair is an object. There are some objects that are not furniture.

syllogism: Os humanos não são de forma alguma animais. Todo gato é um animal. Nenhum humano é um animal aquático. Não existe nenhuma criatura alada que seja um animal. Todo carnívoro é um animal. Alguns animais aquáticos podem ser considerados peixes. Tudo que é um cão é um animal. Existe pelo menos um cão que é um gato.
syllogism_orig: Humans are in no way animals. Every single cat is an animal. Not a single human is an aquatic animal. There exist no winged creatures that are animals. Every single carnivore is an animal. Some aquatic animals can be considered fish. Everything that is a dog is an animal. There is at least one dog that is a cat.

syllogism: Ogni singola cosa che è una Ferrari è un'automobile. Non esiste una sola automobile che sia un veicolo a due ruote. Nessuna automobile è una bicicletta. Almeno una bicicletta non è un veicolo motorizzato. Qualsiasi cosa sia una bicicletta è anche un veicolo. Un sottoinsieme dei veicoli è costituito da camion. Ogni bicicletta è un veicolo. Pertanto, alcune Ferrari non sono biciclette.
syllogism_orig: Every single thing that is a Ferrari is a car. There isn't a single car that is a two-wheeled vehicle. It is the case that no cars are bicycles. At least one bicycle is not a motorized vehicle. Anything that is a bicycle is also a vehicle. A subset of vehicles consists of trucks. Every bicycle is a vehicle. Therefore, some Ferraris are not bicycles.

syllogism: అన్ని ఫాంటసీ నవలా రచయితలు ఫాంటసీ నవలల రచయితలు. కొందరు నవలా రచయితలు రచయితలు అని తెలిసింది. ఫాంటసీ నవలల రచయితలైన శాస్త్రవేత్తలు ఎవరూ లేరు. కొందరు రచయితలు కవులు కూడా. కొందరు నవలా రచయితలు కవులు అని చెప్పబడింది.
syllogism_orig: All fantasy novelists are authors of fantasy novels. It is known that some novelists are writers. There are no scientists that are authors of fantasy novels. Some writers are also poets. It has been said that some novelists are poets.

syllogism: Er zijn geen dieren die groenten zijn. Elk insect is een dier. Er zijn geen mensen die dieren zijn. Alle reptielen zijn dieren. Alles wat een kat is, is een dier. Sommige honden zijn zoogdieren. Bijgevolg is elk reptiel een mier.
syllogism_orig: There are no animals that are vegetables. Every insect is an animal. There are no humans that are animals. All reptiles are animals. Everything that is a cat is an animal. Some of the dogs are mammals. Consequently, every single reptile is an ant.

syllogism: శిశువులైన జీవుల్లో కొన్ని జీవులు (organisms) అయి ఉంటాయి. ప్రతి షార్క్ ఒక జలచరం. నీటి జీవి అయి నీటిలో శ్వాసించగలిగేది ఏదీ లేదు. ప్రతి సింహం ఒక క్షీరదం అనేది కూడా నిజం. మానవులు మరియు జీవులు (organisms) రెండూ అయిన జీవులు ఏవీ లేవు. దీని నుండి, కొన్ని శిశువులు మానవులు కావు అని మనం తార్కికంగా నిర్ధారించవచ్చు.
syllogism_orig: Among the creatures that are babies, some are organisms. Every single shark is an aquatic creature. There is no such thing as a water creature that is able to breathe underwater. It is also true that every lion is a mammal. There are no creatures that are both humans and organisms. From this, we can logically derive that some babies are not humans.

syllogism: కొన్ని బంతులు గుండ్రంగా లేవు. కొన్ని పోస్టర్లు పుస్తకాలు కావు. వంతెనలు అయిన అన్ని వస్తువులు జంతువులు. ప్రతి ఒక్క పుస్తకం ఫర్నిచర్. ప్రతి ఒక్క పుస్తకం ఒక గ్రహం. కనీసం ఒక వాయు దిగ్గజం ఒక గ్రహం. గ్రహం అయిన ప్రతిదీ ఒక ఖగోళ వస్తువు. కాబట్టి, గ్రహాలు అయిన ఫర్నిచర్ ముక్కలు ఉన్నాయి.
syllogism_orig: Some balls are not round. There are some posters that are not books. All of the things that are bridges are animals. Every single book is furniture. Every single book is a planet. At least one thing that is a gas giant is a planet. Anything that is a planet is a celestial body. Therefore, there are pieces of furniture that are planets.

syllogism: Algunos de los animales conocidos como beagles son perros. Ningún gato es un caniche. No hay animales que sean vegetales. Cada gato es un perro. Hay algunos animales que son mamíferos. Algo que es un perro es un animal. Cada carnívoro es un animal. En consecuencia, cada perro es un mamífero.
syllogism_orig: Some of the animals known as beagles are dogs. No cat is a poodle. There are no animals that are vegetables. Every single cat is a dog. There are some animals that are mammals. Something that is a dog is an animal. Every single carnivore is an animal. Consequently, every dog is a mammal.

syllogism: যে প্রাণীগুলো জন্তু, তাদের মধ্যে কিছু স্তন্যপায়ী। প্রতিটি কৃমি একটি পাখি। কোনো উড়ন্ত প্রাণী পাখি নয়। যেকোনো কিছু যা আইনজীবী তা একজন রাজনীতিবিদ। একটি নির্দিষ্ট সংখ্যক চড়ুই উড়ন্ত প্রাণী। প্রতিটি বিড়াল একটি চতুষ্পদ প্রাণী। জন্তুরা ঠোঁট ও পালকযুক্ত প্রাণীদের থেকে সম্পূর্ণ পৃথক। এর থেকে প্রমাণিত হয় যে সব চড়ুই পাখি নয়।
syllogism_orig: Among the creatures that are animals, some are mammals. Every worm is a bird. There are no flying creatures which are birds. Anything that is a lawyer is a politician. A certain number of sparrows are flying creatures. Every single cat is a four-legged creature. Animals are entirely separate from creatures with beaks and feathers. It follows that not all sparrows are birds.

syllogism: ఏ సింహం కూడా జంతువు కాదు అనేది నిజం. ప్రతి కుక్క ఒక మేఘం. కుక్క అయినది ఏదైనా పెంపుడు జంతువు కూడా అవుతుంది. అన్ని జంతువులు మేఘాలు. ఏ కుక్క కూడా చేప కాదు అనేది వాస్తవం. పిల్లులు కొన్ని క్షీరదాలు కూడా ఉన్నాయి. ప్రతి జంతువు ఒక కుక్క అనేది తప్పనిసరిగా నిజం.
syllogism_orig: It is true that no lion is an animal. Every single dog is a cloud. Anything that is a dog is also a pet. All animals are clouds. It is the case that no dog is a fish. There exist cats that are also mammals. It must be true that every animal is a dog.

syllogism: Certains liquides sont des chats. Tout ce qui est un chat est un mammifère. Tout animal à fourrure est un nuage. Aucun homme n'est un chat. Toute créature qui est un caniche est un chien. Par conséquent, certains mammifères sont des liquides.
syllogism_orig: Some liquids are cats. Every single thing that is a cat is a mammal. Every single animal with fur is a cloud. There is no man that is a cat. Every single creature that is a poodle is a dog. Therefore, some mammals are liquids.

syllogism: Kuna nyani wengine ambao ni mamalia. Chochote ambacho ni binadamu ni mamalia. Baadhi ya mbwa ni mamalia. Hakuna mamalia ambao ni samaki. Hakuna reptilia ambao pia ni mamalia. Baadhi ya nyani si mamalia.
syllogism_orig: There are some apes that are mammals. Anything that is a human is a mammal. Some of the dogs are mammals. There are no mammals that are fish. There are no reptiles which are also mammals. Some apes are not mammals.

syllogism: Ogni singola mela è un frutto. Ogni singola banana è un tipo di frutto. Non esistono frutti che siano verdure. Non esistono verdure che siano frutti. Tutte le mele sono frutti. Per questo motivo alcune mele sono verdure.
syllogism_orig: Every single apple is a fruit. Every single banana is a type of fruit. There are no fruits which are vegetables. There are no vegetables that are fruits. All apples are fruits. This is why some apples are vegetables.

syllogism: Aucune fleur n'est un légume. Aucune plante n'est un rocher. Chaque fleur est une plante. Chaque rose est une plante. Tout ce qui est une fleur est fait de métal. Chaque rose est une fleur. Au moins une rose est faite de métal.
syllogism_orig: There are no flowers that are vegetables. There is no plant that is a rock. Every single flower is a plant. Every single rose is a plant. Anything that is a flower is made of metal. Every single rose is a flower. At least one rose is made of metal.

syllogism: 一些猫是哺乳动物。任何鸟都是动物。有一些狗是动物。没有有翅膀的东西是生物。鸟存在，并且所有的鸟都是动物。没有哺乳动物是动物。每种动物都是哺乳动物。必然有一些狗不是哺乳动物。
syllogism_orig: A few cats are mammals. Anything that is a bird is an animal. There are some dogs that are animals. There are no things with wings that are living creatures. There are birds, and all of them are animals. It is the case that no mammal is an animal. Every animal is a mammal. It must be the case that some dogs are not mammals.

syllogism: Ничто из того, что является транспортным средством, не является зданием. Нет ни одного дома, который является автомобилем. Некоторые из зданий являются домами. Ни один дом не является стадионом. Нет ни одного предмета, который является транспортным средством и одновременно автомобилем. Следовательно, некоторые автомобили являются зданиями.
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is a vehicle is a building. There are no houses that are cars. A few of the buildings are houses. Not a single house is a stadium. There is no item that is a vehicle which is also a car. As a result, some cars are buildings.

syllogism: Het is niet het geval dat elke huma een man is. Er zijn enkele mannen die acteurs zijn. Het is het geval dat alle acteurs performers zijn. Elke priester is een man. Elke man is een mens. Alle priesters zijn menselijk. Elke persoon die een man is, is een mens. Daarom kunnen we afleiden dat sommige mannen performers zijn.
syllogism_orig: It is not the case that every huma is a man. There are some men who are actors. It is the case that all actors are performers. Every single priest is a man. Every single man is a human. All priests are human. Any person who is a man is a human. Therefore, we can derive that some men are performers.

syllogism: ఎగరగల కొన్ని క్షీరదాలు ఉన్నాయి. కనీసం ఒక కీటకం ఈకలు గల జీవి కాదు. పక్షుల సమూహం ఈకలు గల జీవుల సమూహంలో ఉపసమితి. ఒక జంతువుల సమూహం సకశేరుకాలు. క్షీరదమైన ఏ దానికీ ఈకలు ఉండవు. పిచ్చుకలైన అన్ని జీవులు పక్షులు. ప్రతి కీటకం పక్షి కాదు.
syllogism_orig: There are some mammals that can fly. At least one insect is not a creature with feathers. The group of birds is a subset of the group of creatures with feathers. A group of animals are vertebrates. Nothing that is a mammal has feathers. All things that are sparrows are birds. Not every insect is a bird.

syllogism: Vitu vyote ambavyo ni paka ni wanyama wa jamii ya paka. Vitu vyote ambavyo ni mzimu ni ukweli wa kisayansi. Vitu vyote ambavyo ni pembetatu ni maumbo ya kijiometri. Kila kitu kilichotengenezwa kwa kioo hakiwezi kuvunjika. Vitu vyote ambavyo ni mzimu ni viumbe vya kishirikina. Poligoni na miduara havina uhusiano wowote. Vitu vyote ambavyo ni bahari vimetengenezwa kwa hariri. Kwa hivyo, baadhi ya viumbe vya kishirikina ni ukweli wa kisayansi.
syllogism_orig: All things that are cats are felines. All things which are ghosts are scientific facts. All things which are triangles are geometric shapes. Every single thing made of glass is indestructible. All things which are ghosts are mythical beings. Polygons and circles have no overlap whatsoever. All things which are oceans are made of silk. It follows that some mythical beings are scientific facts.

syllogism: È vero che tutto ciò che è un elefante è un mammifero. Ogni singolo animale che è un gatto è un vertebrato. Nessun pesce è un insetto. È il caso che non esistano pesci che siano anche mammiferi. È anche vero che nessun pesce è un elefante. Qualsiasi cosa che sia una balena non è un pesce. Pertanto, si conclude che nessun pesce è un mammifero.
syllogism_orig: It is true that everything that is an elephant is a mammal. Every single animal that is a cat is a vertebrate. Not a single fish is an insect. It is the case that there are no fish that are also mammals. It is also true that no fish are elephants. Anything that is a whale is not a fish. Thus, it is concluded that no fish are mammals.

syllogism: ప్రతి ఒక్క పండు చెట్ల మీద పెరిగే వస్తువు. మొక్కలు కాని కొన్ని వస్తువులు చెట్లు. అన్ని ఆపిల్స్ చెట్ల మీద పెరిగే వస్తువులు. ప్రతి ఒక్క క్యారెట్ ఒక కూరగాయ. పువ్వులను చెట్లుగా పరిగణించగల సందర్భాలు ఏవీ లేవు. కొన్ని జంతువులు పిచ్చుకలు. కనీసం ఒక ఆపిల్ ఒక పండు.
syllogism_orig: Every single fruit is a thing that grows on trees. A number of items that are not plants are trees. All apples are things that grow on trees. Every single thing that is a carrot is a vegetable. There are no instances where flowers can be considered trees. There are some animals that are sparrows. At least one apple is a fruit.

syllogism: Todo mamífero é um animal. A classe dos insetos e a classe dos leões não se sobrepõem. Nenhum animal voador é um pinguim. Também é verdade que toda ave é um tipo de animal. Não existem animais que sejam rosas. Não existem aves que possam ser chamadas de peixes. Todo ser que é uma cobra é um animal de sangue frio. Isso levou à conclusão de que uma parte dos animais são aves.
syllogism_orig: Every single mammal is an animal. The class of insects and the class of lions do not overlap. It is the case that no flying animal is a penguin. It is also true that every bird is a type of animal. There are no animals that are roses. There are no birds that can be called fish. Every single thing that is a snake is a cold-blooded animal. This has led to the conclusion that a portion of animals are birds.

syllogism: Es ist bekannt, dass einige Menschen zu den nicht-künstlerischen Menschen gehören. Es gibt einige Bandmitglieder, die Sänger sind. Ein Teil der Künstler sind Maler. Alle Bandmitglieder gelten als Musiker. Es ist wahr, dass es einige Individuen gibt, die Musiker sind, die keine Pianisten sind. Daraus folgt, dass einige Musiker Sänger sind.
syllogism_orig: It is known that some human beings are among the non-artistic people. There are some band members who are singers. A portion of artists are painters. All band members are considered musicians. It is true that there are some individuals who are musicians who are not pianists. It follows that some musicians are singers.

syllogism: Tutti gli oggetti che sono telefoni sono dispositivi elettronici. Una parte dei cibi sani sono verdure. Non esistono torte che siano cibi salati. Nessuno dei dispositivi elettronici è un cibo. Ci sono alcune carote che sono verdure. Ci sono alcuni cibi dolci che sono torte. È il caso che nessun cibo salato sia un cibo dolce.
syllogism_orig: All items that are phones are electronic devices. A portion of healthy foods are vegetables. There are no cakes that are salty foods. None of the electronic devices are foods. There are some carrots that are vegetables. There are some sweet foods that are cakes. It is the case that no salty foods are sweet foods.

syllogism: Alles, was ein Mensch ist, ist ein Ehemann. Alles, was ein Wissenschaftler ist, ist ein Fachmann. Die gesamte Menge der Menschen besteht aus Lebewesen. Es gibt keine Ärzte, die keine medizinischen Fachkräfte sind. Jeder einzelne Hund ist ein Lebewesen. Etwas, das ein Lebewesen ist, ist ein Säugetier. Es ist der Fall, dass alle Menschen Säugetiere sind.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a human is a husband. Anything that is a scientist is a professional. The entire set of people is composed of living organisms. There are no doctors who are not medical professionals. Every single dog is an living organism. Something that is a living organism is a mammal. It is the case that all people are mammals.

syllogism: Alguns animais são mamíferos. Absolutamente nada que seja um réptil é um mamífero. Todo e qualquer peixe é um animal. Não há animais que sejam ao mesmo tempo peixes e de sangue quente. O grupo inteiro dos mamíferos consiste em animais que são de sangue quente. Todas as coisas que são pardais são aves. Todo e qualquer felino é um gato. Peixes e mamíferos são categorias mutuamente exclusivas.
syllogism_orig: Some animals are mammals. Absolutely nothing that is a reptile is a mammal. Every single fish is an animal. There are no animals that are both fish and warm-blooded. The entire group of mammals consists of animals that are warm-blooded. All things that are sparrows are birds. Every single feline is a cat. Fish and mammals are mutually exclusive categories.

syllogism: Ни один автомобиль не является океаном. Вся вода является жидкостью. Всё, что является роботом, сделано из воды. Также ни один газ не является твёрдым телом. Ни одна жидкость не является флюидом. Следовательно, некоторая часть воды не является флюидом.
syllogism_orig: There are no cars that are oceans. All water is a liquid. Anything that is a robot is a thing made of water. It is also the case that no gas is a solid. It is the case that no liquid is a fluid. Consequently, some of the water is not a fluid.

syllogism: Een vierkant, elk zonder uitzondering, is een geometrische vorm. Het is niet het geval dat sommige lijnen veelhoeken zijn. Het is ook het geval dat geen enkele cirkel een vierkant is. Alle dingen die driehoeken zijn, zijn veelhoeken. Alle dingen die driehoeken zijn, zijn geometrische vormen. Elke driehoek is een veelhoek. Daaruit volgt dat sommige lijnen geen driehoeken zijn.
syllogism_orig: A square, every single one of them, is a geometric shape. It is not the case that some lines are polygons. It is also the case that no circle is a square. All things which are triangles are polygons. All things which are triangles are geometric shapes. Every single triangle is a polygon. Therefore, it follows that some lines are not triangles.

syllogism: Existen figuras que son cuadrados y también son rectángulos. Hay algunas figuras que son círculos. Todo lo que es un cuadrado también es un polígono. Cada figura de cuatro lados es un rectángulo. Nada que sea un cuadrado es un círculo. Debe ser el caso que ninguna figura es un cuadrado.
syllogism_orig: There exist shapes that are squares and are also rectangles. There are some shapes that are circles. Anything that is a square is also a polygon. Every single four-sided-shape is a rectangle. Nothing that is a square is a circle. It must be the case that every single shape is not a square.

syllogism: È il caso che tutto ciò che è un cane è un mammifero. Ogni singola casa è una cosa che è un edificio. Non c'è nulla che sia un ortaggio che sia anche un frutto. Un capanno non è mai una cosa che è un edificio. Tutto ciò che è una pianta è un organismo. Qualsiasi cosa che sia un robot è una cosa fatta d'acqua. Ne consegue che nessun capanno è una casa.
syllogism_orig: It is the case that everything which is a dog is a mammal. Every single house is a thing that is a building. There is nothing that is a vegetable that is also a fruit. A shed is never a thing that is a building. Everything that is a plant is an organism. Anything that is a robot is a thing made of water. It follows that no shed is a house.

syllogism: প্লাস্টিক এমন কোনো কিছুই ধাতু নয়। রূপা, ব্যতিক্রম ছাড়াই, একটি ধাতু। কোনো সোনাই রূপা নয়। সোনাকে সর্বদা ধাতু হিসেবে শ্রেণিবদ্ধ করা হয়। ধাতু এমন সকল বস্তুই মৌল। বেশ কিছু ধাতু সোনা।
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is a plastic is a metal. Silver is, without exception, a metal. No gold is silver. Gold is always classified as a metal. All objects that are metals are elements. A number of metals are gold.

syllogism: Todo cachorro é um mamífero. Tudo que é um mamífero é um humano. Zebras não são de forma alguma cachorros. É o caso que algumas criaturas vivas não são mamíferos. Também é verdade que nenhum gato é um canino. Existem mamíferos que são gatos. Segue-se que nenhum cachorro é um gato.
syllogism_orig: Every single dog is a mammal. Anything that is a mammal is a human. Zebras are in no way dogs. It is the case that some living creatures are not mammals. It is also true that no cats are canines. There exist mammals who are cats. It follows that not a single dog is a cat.

syllogism: Non esistono rocce che siano oggetti. Alcuni tavoli sono uccelli. Alcuni tavoli sono, sorprendentemente, rocce. Ogni singola cosa che è un utensile è un oggetto. Ogni singola banana è un tipo di frutto. Gli animali e i tavoli non hanno alcuna sovrapposizione. Ciò significa che una parte dei tavoli non sono oggetti.
syllogism_orig: There are no rocks that are objects. A few tables are birds. A few tables are, surprisingly, rocks. Every single thing that is a tool is an object. Every single banana is a type of fruit. Animals and tables have no overlap whatsoever. This means that a portion of tables are not objects.

syllogism: వైద్యుడైన ప్రతిదీ మానవుడు కూడా. ప్రతి వైద్యుడు ఒక వృత్తినిపుణుడు. వైద్యుడైన ప్రతి ఒక్కరూ వైద్యశాస్త్రంలో శిక్షణ పొందినవారు. కొందరు వృత్తినిపుణులు మానవులు అనేది కూడా నిజం. ప్రతి ఒక్క శిశువైద్యుడు ఒక వైద్యుడు. పిల్లల సమూహంలో వృత్తినిపుణులు లేరు. వైద్యుడైన ఏ వ్యక్తి కూడా ఉపాధ్యాయుడు కాదు. కనీసం ఒక పిల్లవాడు వైద్యుడు కాదు.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a doctor is also a human. Every doctor is a professional. Anyone who is a doctor is trained in medicine. It is also true that a few professionals are human beings. Every single pediatrician is a doctor. The set of children does not contain professionals. No person who is a doctor is also a teacher. At least one child is not a doctor.

syllogism: 存在一些猫科动物也是宠物。任何狗都是生物。没有猫是犬科动物。没有狗是猫。一些狗是宠物。由此可得，一些宠物是猫。
syllogism_orig: There exist some felines that are also pets. Anything which is a dog is a living creature. It is also true that no cats are canines. There are no dogs who are cats. A few dogs are pets. This implies that some pets are cats.

syllogism: Каждое существо, которое является млекопитающим, также считается животным. Верно, что все рыбы являются позвоночными. Существуют некоторые существа, которые являются млекопитающими, но при этом не являются рептилиями. Некоторые из млекопитающих являются хищниками. Каждый хищник является животным. Каждое млекопитающее является позвоночным. Из этих утверждений следует, что некоторые животные не являются рептилиями.
syllogism_orig: Every creature that is a mammal is also considered an animal. It is true that all fish are vertebrates. There exist certain creatures that are mammals, yet they are not reptiles. Some of the mammals are carnivores. Every single carnivore is an animal. Every single mammal is a vertebrate. From these statements, it follows that some animals are not reptiles.

syllogism: వ్యక్తి కాని భౌతిక శాస్త్రవేత్త ఎవరూ లేరు. కొందరు తెలివైన వ్యక్తులు భౌతిక శాస్త్రవేత్తలు. ప్రతి భౌతిక శాస్త్రవేత్త ఒక శాస్త్రవేత్త. ప్రతి ఒక్క వ్యక్తి ఒక మానవుడు. అన్ని ఫాంటసీ నవలా రచయితలు ఫాంటసీ నవలల రచయితలు. ఫలితంగా, ప్రతి ఒక్క శాస్త్రవేత్త ఒక తెలివైన వ్యక్తి.
syllogism_orig: There is no physicist who is not a person. There are some smart people that are physicists. Every physicist is a scientist. Every single person is a human. All fantasy novelists are authors of fantasy novels. As a result, every single scientist is a smart person.

syllogism: 所有正方形都是多边形。已知没有圆是正方形。三角形从来不是正方形。正方形，每一个都是几何图形。每个三角形都是多边形。没有任何正方形同时也是三角形。
syllogism_orig: All shapes that are squares are polygons. It is known that there are no circles that are squares. A triangle is never a square. A square, every single one of them, is a geometric shape. Every triangle is a polygon. Nothing that is a square is also a triangle.

syllogism: Il n'est pas vrai qu'un dispositif d'entrée quelconque soit utilisé pour taper. Aucun nuage n'est un instrument de musique. Chaque clavier est un dispositif d'entrée. Chaque clavier est un nuage. Tous les appareils électroniques sont des objets. Aucun appareil électronique n'est un aliment. Il est donc un fait qu'aucun clavier n'est utilisé pour taper.
syllogism_orig: It is not true that any input device is used for typing. Not a single cloud is a musical instrument. Each and every keyboard is an input device. Every keyboard is a cloud. All electronic devices are items. None of the electronic devices are foods. It is therefore a fact that no keyboard is used for typing.

syllogism: Elk zoogdier is een gedomesticeerd dier. Sommige waterdieren kunnen als vis worden beschouwd. Elk wezen dat als vogel wordt geïdentificeerd, is een wezen met veren. Elke vogel is een dier. Een deel van de dingen die vogels zijn, heeft veren. Sommige pinguïns zijn vogels. Daaruit volgt noodzakelijkerwijs dat sommige dieren pinguïns zijn.
syllogism_orig: Every mammal is a domesticated animal. Some aquatic animals can be considered fish. Every single creature identified as a bird is a creature with feathers. Every bird is an animal. A portion of the things that are birds have feathers. Some penguins are birds. As such, it is necessarily true that some animals are penguins.

syllogism: Aucun article de coutellerie n'est un livre. Il n'est pas le cas que tout roman est une nouvelle. Tous les romanciers de fantasy sont des auteurs de romans de fantasy. Toute chose qui est un roman est un livre. Rien de ce qui est un magazine n'est un livre. Il existe des affiches qui ne sont pas des livres. On peut donc conclure que certains livres ne sont pas des nouvelles.
syllogism_orig: No cutlery items are books. It is not the case that every novel is a short story. All fantasy novelists are authors of fantasy novels. Every single thing that is a novel is a book. Nothing that is a magazine is a book. There are some posters that are not books. One can therefore conclude that some books are not short stories.

syllogism: Tutti gli umani sono primati. Nessun animale che è un primate è anche un pesce. Niente che sia mortale è immortale. Non esiste un singolo umano che sia un fantasma. Alcuni animali acquatici possono essere considerati pesci. È il caso che nessun fantasma sia immortale. Ne consegue che nessun umano è immortale.
syllogism_orig: There are all humans which are primates. No animals that are primates are also fish. Nothing that is mortal is immortal. There is not a single human that is a ghost. Some aquatic animals can be considered fish. It is the case that no ghost is immortal. It follows that no human is immortal.

syllogism: Kila ndege ni mnyama. Kuna wanyama wengine ambao ni paka. Hakuna wanyama ambao ni viumbe hai. Binadamu wote ni wanyama pia. Kitu chochote ambacho ni ndege ni kiumbe kirukavyo. Kwa hivyo, binadamu wote lazima wawe ndege.
syllogism_orig: Every bird is an animal. There are some animals which are cats. There are no animals that are living creatures. All humans are animals as well. Anything that is a bird is a flying creature. Therefore, all humans must be birds.

syllogism: Hakuna jengo ambalo ni mbwa. Ni kweli kwamba kila kitu ambacho ni mbwa ni mamalia. Hakuna muundo wowote ambao ni wingu. Kila uwanja wa michezo ni jengo. Kila gari ni chombo cha usafiri. Kitu chochote ambacho ni jengo pia ni muundo. Hakuna nyumba yoyote ambayo ni uwanja wa michezo. Kwa hivyo, hakuna wingu ambalo ni jengo.
syllogism_orig: No building is a dog. It is the case that everything which is a dog is a mammal. There is not a single structure that is a cloud. Every single stadium is a building. Every car is a vehicle. Any object that is a building is also a structure. Not a single house is a stadium. It follows that no cloud is a building.

syllogism: Er zijn enkele dieren die zebra's zijn. Het is een feit dat alle zoogdieren levenloze voorwerpen zijn. Alle objecten die metalen zijn, zijn elementen. Er bestaat een groep studenten die ook tieners zijn. Er zijn enkele objecten die metalen zijn die geen goud zijn. Alles wat een gasreus is, is een object dat een planeet is. Elk ding dat een werktuig is, is een object. Daarom is elke zebra een levenloos voorwerp.  Wait, let me re-examine the original more carefully.  Er zijn enkele dieren die zebra's zijn. Het is een feit dat alle zoogdieren bezielde objecten zijn. Alle objecten die metalen zijn, zijn elementen. Er bestaat een groep studenten die ook tieners zijn. Er zijn enkele objecten die metalen zijn die geen goud zijn. Alles wat een gasreus is, is een object dat een planeet is. Elk ding dat een werktuig is, is een object. Daarom is elke zebra een bezield object.
syllogism_orig: There are some animals which are zebras. It is a fact that all mammals are animate objects. All objects that are metals are elements. There exists a group of students who are also teenagers. There are some objects that are metals that are not gold. Anything that is a gas giant is an object that is a planet. Every single thing that is a tool is an object. Therefore, every single zebra is an animate object.

syllogism: প্রতিটি কুকুর সালোকসংশ্লেষণে সক্ষম। একটিও কুকুর কুকুরজাতীয় প্রাণী নয়। এমন কুকুর আছে যারা পুডল। অল্পসংখ্যক স্তন্যপায়ী প্রাণী হলো প্রাণী। এমন বিড়াল আছে যারা কুকুরও বটে। জেব্রারা কোনোভাবেই কুকুর নয়। এর থেকে বোঝা যায় যে কিছু পুডল সালোকসংশ্লেষণ করতে পারে।
syllogism_orig: Every single dog is capable of photosynthesis. Not a single dog is a canine. There exist dogs which are poodles. A small number of mammals are animals. There are cats which are also dogs. Zebras are in no way dogs. This implies that a portion of poodles can photosynthesize.

syllogism: Всё, что является учёным, является человеком, который учится. Верно, что все физики являются учёными. Существует группа учёных, которые также являются физиками. Каждый учёный является человеком, который проводит систематические исследования. Множество художников не содержит людей, которые проводят систематические исследования. Не существует физика, который не является человеком. Художники не являются учёными.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a scientist is a person who studies. It is true that all physicists are scientists. There exists a group of scientists who are also physicists. Every single scientist is a person who conducts systematic research. The set of artists contains no people who conduct systematic research. There is no physicist who is not a person. Artists are not scientists.

syllogism: কিছু গাজর সবজি। যেসব জিনিস ফোন সেগুলো সবই ইলেকট্রনিক ডিভাইস। কিছু ফাস্ট ফুড রেস্তোরাঁয় ড্রাইভ-থ্রু আছে। কিছু কফি শপ আছে যেগুলো ফাস্ট ফুড রেস্তোরাঁও বটে। স্বাস্থ্যকর খাবারের একটি অংশ সবজি। কোনো ইলেকট্রনিক ডিভাইসই খাবার নয়। অতএব, কিছু কফি শপে ড্রাইভ-থ্রু আছে।
syllogism_orig: There are some carrots that are vegetables. All items that are phones are electronic devices. Some fast food restaurants have a drive-thru. There are coffee shops which are also fast food restaurants. A portion of healthy foods are vegetables. None of the electronic devices are foods. It follows, then, that some coffee shops have a drive-thru.

syllogism: Некоторые существа являются млекопитающими и одновременно животными. Каждая рыба является водным существом. Среди существ, которые являются тиграми, некоторые являются животными. Каждое млекопитающее является позвоночным. Любое животное, которое является кошкой, является облаком. Все воробьи являются птицами. Среди рыб некоторые являются псовыми. Из этого следует, что по крайней мере некоторые тигры не являются млекопитающими.
syllogism_orig: There are some creatures that are mammals and also animals. Every single fish is a water creature. Among the group of creatures that are tigers, some are animals. Every single mammal is a vertebrate. Any animal that is a cat is a cloud. All things that are sparrows are birds. Among the fish, a few are canines. It follows that at least some tigers are not mammals.

syllogism: Algumas estrelas são sóis. Tudo o que é um planeta é um corpo celeste. Também é verdade que todas as estrelas são corpos celestes. Tudo o que é um planeta é considerado um corpo celeste. Alguns trens não são corpos celestes. É o caso que todo e qualquer trem é um planeta. É verdade que tudo o que é um sol é uma estrela. Assim, conclui-se que todos os corpos celestes são sóis.
syllogism_orig: A few stars are suns. Anything that is a planet is a celestial body. It is also true that all stars are celestial bodies. Anything that is a planet is considered a celestial body. Some trains are not celestial bodies. It is the case that every single train is a planet. It is true that everything that is a sun is a star. Thus, it is concluded that all celestial bodies are suns.

syllogism: Nulla che sia un indumento è una camicia. Ci sono alcune rocce che sono chitarre. Qualsiasi cosa che sia un essere umano è un mammifero. C'è dell'abbigliamento che è fatto di camicie. Tutto ciò che è una scimmia è un mammifero. Tutto ciò che è un essere vivente è una creatura. Ogni elemento che è un pesce è una pianta. Nessuna scimmia è un mammifero.
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is clothing is a shirt. There are some rocks that are guitars. Anything that is a human is a mammal. There is some apparel that is made of shirts. Everything that is an ape is a mammal. Everything that is a living thing is a creature. Every item that is a fish is a plant. No apes are mammals.

syllogism: Chaque chien est un mammifère. Certains animaux sont des mammifères. Un certain nombre d'hippopotames se trouvent parmi les animaux terrestres. Chaque carnivore est un animal. Aucun animal n'est une rose. Rien de ce qui est un animal terrestre n'est un animal aquatique. Chaque aigle est un animal. Ainsi, on peut conclure que certains hippopotames sont des animaux aquatiques.
syllogism_orig: Every single dog is a mammal. Some animals are mammals. A certain number of hippos are to be found among the land animals. Every single carnivore is an animal. There are no animals that are roses. Nothing that is a land animal is an aquatic animal. Every single eagle is an animal. Thus, it can be concluded that some hippos are aquatic animals.

syllogism: Hakuna wanyama ambao ni mijusi. Hakuna kitu ambacho ni mbwa-mwitu ambacho pia ni paka-mwitu. Kila mnyama ambaye ni mbwa, kwa asili yake, ni mbwa-mwitu. Kila poodle ni mbwa.
