Kila mamalia ni paka. Ni kweli kwamba baadhi ya viumbe hai si mamalia. Inaweza kuhitimishwa kimantiki kwamba hakuna mbwa ambao ni paka-mwitu.
syllogism_orig: There are no animals which are lizards. There is nothing that is a canine which is also a feline. Every animal that is a dog is, by its very nature, a canine. Every poodle is a dog. Every single mammal is a cat. It is the case that some living creatures are not mammals. It can be logically concluded that no dogs are felines.

syllogism: 所有的鸟都是能飞的东西。所有的轿车都是汽车。每一辆自行车都是交通工具。没有任何东西既是汽车又是卡车。每一辆汽车都是一种情感。每一辆轿车都是交通工具。因此，所有的交通工具都必须是汽车。
syllogism_orig: Any and all birds are things that can fly. All sedans are cars. Every bicycle is a vehicle. There is not a single item that is a car and also a truck. Every single car is an emotion. Every sedan is a vehicle. Therefore, all vehicles must be cars.

syllogism: Todos los árboles son, por definición, plantas. Cada rosa es una planta. Todo lo que es un árbol es una planta. Todas las plantas necesitan luz solar. Cada flor es una planta. También es cierto que algunas plantas son flores. Existen algunas cosas que son árboles que no son pinos. Se sigue lógicamente que hay algunas plantas que no son pinos.
syllogism_orig: All trees are, by definition, plants. Every single rose is a plant. Everything that is a tree is a plant. All plants are in need of sunlight. Every single flower is a plant. It is also true that some plants are flowers. There exist some things which are trees that are not pines. It logically follows that there are some plants that are not pines.

syllogism: Es gibt einige Karotten, die Gemüse sind. Es gibt kein Gemüse, das Äpfel sind. Es gibt keine Blumen, die Gemüse sind. Unter den Äpfeln sind einige rote Früchte. Es gibt nichts, das ein Gemüse ist, das auch eine Frucht ist. Nicht alle roten Früchte sind Gemüse.
syllogism_orig: There are some carrots that are vegetables. There are no vegetables that are apples. There are no flowers that are vegetables. Among the apples, a few are red fruits. There is nothing that is a vegetable that is also a fruit. Not all red fruits are vegetables.

syllogism: Cada objeto que tiene cuatro lados iguales tiene cuatro lados. Al menos una cosa que es un círculo es un triángulo. No hay cuadrados que sean redondos. No hay círculos que sean cuadrados. Cada triángulo es un cuadrado. Se sigue, entonces, que algunos círculos son cuadrados.
syllogism_orig: Every single object that has four equal sides has four sides. At least one thing that is a circle is a triangle. There are no squares which are round. There are no circles which are squares. Every single triangle is a square. It follows, then, that some circles are square.

syllogism: Chaque poisson est une créature aquatique. C'est un fait que chaque soda est un liquide. Chaque chose faite d'eau est une planète. Rien de ce qui est un liquide n'est un solide. De même, il est vrai que toute eau est un liquide. Chaque requin est un poisson. Par conséquent, il a été affirmé que chaque goutte d'eau est du soda.
syllogism_orig: Every single fish is a water creature. It is a fact that every single soda is a liquid. Every single thing made of water is a planet. Nothing that is a liquid is a solid. Likewise, it is true that all water is liquid. Every shark is a fish. Therefore, it has been asserted that every bit of water is soda.

syllogism: ప్రతి ఒక్క పులి ఒక క్షీరదం. ప్రతి ఒక్క క్షీరదం ఒక క్షీరదం. పిల్లి అయిన ప్రతిదీ ఒక జంతువు. పిల్లులు అయిన అన్ని వస్తువులు క్షీరదాలు. పిల్లి అయిన ఏదైనా ఒక క్షీరదం. పులులు అయిన అన్ని వస్తువులు క్షీరదాలు. ఏ పిల్లులు కూడా కుక్కజాతివి కావు అనేది కూడా నిజం. కనీసం ఒక పిల్లి ఒక క్షీరదం. syllogism_orig: Every single tiger is a feline. Every single feline is a mammal. Everything that is a cat is an animal. All things that are cats are felines. Anything that is a cat is a feline. All things that are tigers are felines. It is also true that no cats are canines. At least one cat is a mammal.

syllogism: Tout ce qui est une planète est un corps céleste. Certaines des planètes sont des animaux. Tous les animaux sont des êtres vivants. Tout ce qui est un mammifère est un animal à sang chaud. Tout humain est un animal qui est un primate. Il est vrai qu'aucun animal volant n'est un pingouin. Par conséquent, certains êtres vivants sont des planètes.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a planet is a celestial body. Some of the planets are animals. All animals are living things. Anything that is a mammal is a warm-blooded animal. Every human is an animal that is a primate. It is the case that no flying animal is a penguin. As a result, some living things are planets.

syllogism: కొన్ని క్షీరదాలు నిర్జీవ వస్తువులు కానివి ఉన్నాయి. బంగాళాదుంపలు అయిన కొన్ని వస్తువులు జీవులు కావు. కొన్ని జంతువులు పిచ్చుకలు అయినవి ఉన్నాయి. బంగాళాదుంప అయిన ప్రతి ఒక్క వస్తువు మానవుడు. సముద్రాలు అయిన అన్ని వస్తువులు పట్టుతో తయారు చేయబడినవి. బంగాళాదుంప అయిన ఏ వస్తువు అయినా కూరగాయ. ఏదైనా ఒకే సమయంలో జీవి మరియు ప్రాణి అయి ఉండటం అసాధ్యం. దీని తార్కిక పరిణామం ఏమిటంటే కొందరు మానవులు జీవులు కారు.
syllogism_orig: There are some mammals that are not non-living things. Some things that are potatoes are not living things. There are some animals that are sparrows. Every single thing that is a potato is a human. All things which are oceans are made of silk. Any object that is a potato is a vegetable. It is impossible for something to be an organism and a creature at the same time. A logical consequence of this is that some humans are not living things.

syllogism: Всё, что является облаком, является также рыбой. Всё, что является рыбой, является также насекомым. Неверно, что какие-либо рыбы являются кошками. Всё, что является облаком, является также рептилией. Абсолютно ничто, что является рептилией, не является млекопитающим. Следовательно, некоторые рыбы являются рептилиями.
syllogism_orig: Everything that is a cloud is also a fish. Everything that is a fish is also an insect. It is not true that any fish are cats. Everything that is a cloud is also a reptile. Absolutely nothing that is a reptile is a mammal. Hence, some fish are reptiles.

syllogism: যা কিছু প্রাণী তা জড় বস্তু নয়। কোনো ধারণা কুকুর নয়। কোনো কুকুর বিড়াল নয়। কোনো প্রাণী জীবন্ত প্রাণী নয়। যা কিছু প্রাণী তা জীবন্ত বস্তু। যা কিছু প্রাণী তা ধারণা। এটি অনিবার্যভাবে নির্দেশ করে যে কিছু কুকুর প্রাণী নয়।
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is an animal is a non-living thing. There are no ideas that are dogs. There are no dogs that are cats. There are no animals that are living creatures. Anything that is an animal is a living thing. Anything that is a animal is an idea. This necessarily suggests that some dogs are not animals.

syllogism: Toda persona soltera es un humano. Entre los que son estudiantes, hay algunos que son atletas. Todos los escritores son personas creativas. Es cierto que todos los físicos son científicos. Todo lo que es poeta también es escritor. Podemos concluir de esto que una porción de las personas creativas son poetas.
syllogism_orig: Every single person is a human. Among those who are students, there are some who are athletes. All writers are people who are creative. It is true that all physicists are scientists. Anything that is a poet is also a writer. We can conclude from this that a portion of creative people are poets.

syllogism: Ни одно животное, являющееся млекопитающим, не может считаться рыбой. Всё, что является собакой, является живым существом. Существуют некоторые млекопитающие, которые живут на суше. Некоторые живые существа не являются млекопитающими. Ни одна рыба не живёт на суше. Ни одна птица не умеет летать. Существуют домашние животные, которые являются млекопитающими. Следовательно, все рыбы являются млекопитающими.
syllogism_orig: No animals that are mammals can be considered fish. Anything which is a dog is a living creature. There are some mammals which live on land. It is the case that some living creatures are not mammals. It is the case that no fish lives on land. It is the case that no bird can fly. There are pets which are mammals. Consequently, all fish are mammals.

syllogism: Каждое отдельное одеяние является предметом одежды. Ни одно художественное произведение не является новостной статьёй. Каждый роман является художественным произведением. Не существует книг, которые являются одновременно художественными и нехудожественными. Существуют некоторые плакаты, которые не являются книгами. Все авторы фэнтези являются авторами фэнтезийных романов. Из этого следует, что ни одна новостная статья не является романом.
syllogism_orig: Every single garment is an article of clothing. No work of fiction is a news article. Every novel is a work of fiction. There are no books that are fiction and also non-fiction. There are some posters that are not books. All fantasy novelists are authors of fantasy novels. It is thus the case that no news article is a novel.

syllogism: যেকোনো কিছু যা উদ্ভিদ তা জীবিত। এমন কোনো প্রাণী নেই যা গোলাপ। এটাও সত্য যে কিছু উদ্ভিদ ফুল। কোনো অবস্থাতেই একটি ফুল গাছ নয়। প্রতিটি গাছই এমন একটি জিনিস যা জীবিত। যেকোনো কিছু যা ওক তা উদ্ভিদ। সমস্ত গাছ, সংজ্ঞা অনুসারে, উদ্ভিদ। অন্তত একটি উদ্ভিদ গাছ।
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a plant is alive. There are no animals that are roses. It is also true that some plants are flowers. Under no circumstances is a flower a tree. Every single tree is a thing that is alive. Everything that is an oak is a plant. All trees are, by definition, plants. At least one plant is a tree.

syllogism: 没有一条鱼是昆虫。每一只猫都是四足动物。没有昆虫是鸟。所有鸟都是有翅膀的生物。没有鸟是昆虫。没有鸟是猫。同样，没有鱼是植物。由此可以得出的结论是：没有昆虫是有翅膀的生物。
syllogism_orig: Not a single fish is an insect. Every single cat is a four-legged creature. There are no insects which are birds. It is true that everything which is a bird is a winged creature. It is true that no birds are insects. It is not true that any bird is a cat. It is also true that no fish are plants. A conclusion that can be drawn from this is that there are no insects which are winged creatures.

syllogism: Kila kitu ambacho ni karoti ni mboga. Kila tufaha ni tunda. Hakuna kitu ambacho ni mboga ambacho pia ni tunda. Chochote ambacho ni jiwe si beri. Miongoni mwa vitu ambavyo ni matunda, baadhi si beri. Hakuna matunda ambayo ni mboga. Kwa hivyo, baadhi ya matunda si mawe.
syllogism_orig: Every single thing that is a carrot is a vegetable. Every single apple is a fruit. There is nothing that is a vegetable that is also a fruit. Anything that is a stone is not a berry. Of the items that are fruits, some are not berries. There are no fruits which are vegetables. It follows that some fruits are not stones.

syllogism: Er zijn enkele wortelen die groenten zijn. Er zijn geen vruchten die groenten zijn. Geen van de items die wortelen zijn, zijn paprika's. Niets dat een vrucht is, is broccoli. Alle items van broccoli zijn groenten. Een subset van groenten is geen fruit.
syllogism_orig: There are some carrots that are vegetables. There are no fruits which are vegetables. None of the items that are carrots are bell peppers. Nothing that is a fruit is broccoli. All items of broccoli are vegetables. A subset of vegetables is not fruit.

syllogism: Kitu chochote ambacho ni mwanasayansi ni mtaalamu. Kitu chochote ambacho ni mwanasayansi ni mtu anayesoma. Kila mtu ambaye ni msanii ni mtu mbunifu. Baadhi ya watu si wataalamu. Idadi ya wanawake ni binadamu. Kuna baadhi ya watu ambao ni wasanii ambao si wachoraji. Inafuata kwamba baadhi ya watu wabunifu ni wachoraji.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a scientist is a professional. Anything that is a scientist is a person who studies. Every single person who is an artist is a creative person. Some people are not professionals. A number of women are humans. There exist some individuals who are artists that are not painters. It follows that some creative people are painters.

syllogism: Unter der Gruppe der Eltern sind einige Mütter. Es gibt einige Personen, die Freude am Lesen finden, die Bibliothekare sind. Unter denjenigen, die Studenten sind, gibt es einige, die Sportler sind. Jede Person, die ein professioneller Koch ist, ist eine Person, die kochen kann. Nicht eine einzige Person, die ein Elternteil ist, ist ein Mensch. Daraus können wir logisch schließen, dass einige Mütter keine Menschen sind.
syllogism_orig: Among the group of people who are parents, some are mothers. There are some individuals who find pleasure in reading who are librarians. Among those who are students, there are some who are athletes. Every person who is a professional cook is a person who can cook. Not a single person who is a parent is a human. From this, we can logically conclude that there are some mothers who are not humans.

syllogism: కొంతమంది వ్యక్తులు వృత్తి నిపుణులు కారు. ఏ ఒక్క వైద్యుడు కూడా వేదికపై ప్రదర్శన ఇచ్చే వ్యక్తి కాదు. విజయవంతమైన వ్యక్తులందరూ ధనవంతులు కాగలిగిన వారు. కళాకారులలో కొంత భాగం చిత్రకారులు. ప్రతి ఒక్క వ్యక్తి ఒక మానవుడు. ప్రతి ఒక్క సంగీతకారుడు వేదికపై ప్రదర్శన ఇచ్చే వ్యక్తిగా పరిగణించబడతాడు. సంగీతకారుడు అని పిలవబడే ఏదైనా కళాకారుడు కూడా అవుతాడు. కాబట్టి, వైద్యులు కాని కొంతమంది సంగీతకారులు ఉన్నారు.
syllogism_orig: Some people are not professionals. Not one single doctor is a person who performs on stage. All successful people are those who can be rich. A portion of artists are painters. Every single person is a human. Every single musician is considered a person who performs on stage. Anything that can be called a musician is also an artist. Consequently, there exist some musicians who are not doctors.

syllogism: Una parte de los cocineros profesionales son chefs. Todo adolescente es un humano. Ningún mamífero es un objeto que puede pensar. Toda persona que es un primer ministro es un político. Es el caso que algunas personas no son humanos.
syllogism_orig: A portion of professional cooks are chefs. Every teenager is a human. Not a single mammal is an object that can think. Every single student is a person who spends time studying. Any person who is a human is a robot. The set of people contains no robots. Every person who is a prime minister is a politician. It is the case that some people are not humans.

syllogism: గ్రహం అయిన ప్రతిదీ ఒక ఖగోళ వస్తువు. కొన్ని రైళ్లు ఖగోళ వస్తువులు కావు. ప్రతి చెంచా ఒక గ్రహం. సూర్యుడు అయిన ప్రతిదీ ఒక ఖగోళ వస్తువు. కొన్ని సాలమాండర్లు ఉభయచరాలు. ఒక ఖగోళ వస్తువు ఎప్పుడూ ఫర్నీచర్ ముక్క కాదు. రోబోట్ అయిన ప్రతిదీ నీటితో తయారైన వస్తువు. గ్రహం అయిన కనీసం ఒక సూర్యుడు ఉన్నాడు.
syllogism_orig: Everything that is a planet is a celestial body. Some trains are not celestial bodies. Every spoon is a planet. Anything that is a sun is a celestial body. A few salamanders are amphibians. A celestial body is never a piece of furniture. Anything that is a robot is a thing made of water. There exists at least one sun that is a planet.

syllogism: Kila gari ni chombo chenye injini. Kila gari ni chombo cha usafiri. Kila wingu ni chombo cha usafiri. Hakuna chombo cha usafiri ambacho ni jengo. Hakuna wingu ambalo ni basi. Kila kitu ambacho ni gari ni chombo cha usafiri. Hakuna wingu ambalo ni gari. Kwa hivyo, hakuna basi ambalo ni chombo cha usafiri.
syllogism_orig: Every car is a motorized vehicle. Every car is a vehicle. Every single cloud is a vehicle. Nothing that is a vehicle is a building. There are no clouds that are buses. Every single thing that is a car is a vehicle. No clouds are cars. Therefore, there is no bus that is a vehicle.

syllogism: Alle hoofdsteden zijn per definitie steden. Een deel van de hoofdsteden bevindt zich in Europa. Elke hoofdstad wordt beschouwd als een grote stad. Er zijn enkele hoofdsteden die vervuild zijn. Men moet concluderen dat sommige steden vervuild zijn.
syllogism_orig: All capitals are, by definition, cities. A portion of capital cities are located in Europe. Every capital city is considered a major city. There are some capitals that are polluted. One must conclude that some cities are polluted.

syllogism: మానవుడైన ప్రతిదీ క్షీరదం. క్షీరదమైనది ఏదీ కుక్క కాదు. గ్రహాలైన అన్ని వస్తువులు జంతువులు. కొన్ని జీవులు క్షీరదాలు కావు అనేది నిజం. పిల్లులు ఏవీ శునకజాతివి కావు అనేది కూడా నిజం. ఏ కుక్క అయినా జంతువు అనేది నిజం కాదు. దీని నుండి ఏ క్షీరదమూ జంతువు కాదు అనే నిర్ణయానికి వస్తాము.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a human is a mammal. Nothing that is a mammal is a dog. All of the things that are planets are animals. It is the case that some living creatures are not mammals. It is also true that no cats are canines. It is not true that any dog is an animal. This leads to the conclusion that no mammal is an animal.

syllogism: Não existem peixes que sejam mamíferos. Existem alguns gatos que são mamíferos. É o caso que não existem peixes que também sejam mamíferos. Todo e qualquer felino é um gato. Alguns mamíferos são cães. Existem gatos que também são mamíferos. Existe pelo menos uma criatura que é um mamífero e também um golfinho. Gatos de forma alguma são cães.
syllogism_orig: There are no fish that are mammals. There are some cats who are mammals. It is the case that there are no fish that are also mammals. Every single feline is a cat. Some mammals are dogs. There exist cats that are also mammals. There exists at least one creature that is a mammal and also a dolphin. Cats are in no way dogs.

syllogism: Todo zapato es un tipo de calzado. Hay algunos trenes que también son tipos de transporte. No es cierto que algún coche sea un tren. Nada que sea una sandalia es un tipo de calzado. Es el caso que ninguna sandalia es un zapato.
syllogism_orig: Every shoe is a type of footwear. There are a few trains that are also types of transportation. It is not true that any car is a train. Nothing that is a sandal is a type of footwear. It is the case that no sandal is a shoe.

syllogism: Geen dieren die zoogdieren zijn, kunnen als vissen worden beschouwd. Er zijn geen vissen die zoogdieren zijn. Het is waar dat geen zoogdieren insecten zijn. Onder de wezens die dieren zijn, zijn sommige zoogdieren. Er zijn geen slangen die reptielen zijn. Een wezen dat een reptiel is, is nooit een zoogdier. Het is noodzakelijkerwijs het geval dat een slang nooit een zoogdier is.
syllogism_orig: No animals that are mammals can be considered fish. There are no fish that are mammals. It is true that no mammals are insects. Among the creatures that are animals, some are mammals. There are no snakes that are reptiles. A creature that is a reptile is never a mammal. It is necessarily the case that a snake is never a mammal.

syllogism: Каждое млекопитающее является животным. Каждая рыба является животным. Каждая собака является домашним животным. Существуют некоторые млекопитающие, которые умеют летать. Существуют некоторые млекопитающие, которые не являются неживыми объектами. Из этого следует, что некоторые рыбы являются млекопитающими.
syllogism_orig: Every mammal is an animal. Every fish is an animal. Every single dog is a domestic animal. There are some mammals that can fly. There are some mammals that are not non-living things. This suggests that some fish are mammals.

syllogism: Il existe des animaux qui sont des moineaux. Toutes les choses qui sont des moineaux sont des oiseaux. Toutes les choses qui sont des pommes sont des fruits. Tout ce qui est un oiseau est un animal. Certains animaux aquatiques sont des choses qui sont des oiseaux. Tout ce qui est un fruit n'est pas un produit de boulangerie. Ainsi, certaines des choses qui sont des pommes ne sont pas des produits de boulangerie.
syllogism_orig: There are some animals that are sparrows. All things that are sparrows are birds. All of the things that are apples are fruits. Anything that is a bird is an animal. Some aquatic animals are things that are birds. Anything that is a fruit is not a baked good. Thus, some of the things that are apples are not baked goods.

syllogism: 每一个鸟都是动物。每一只鸟都是云。每一架飞机都是云。没有鸟是没有翅膀的。有些交通工具是汽车。这意味着每一只鸟都是飞机。
syllogism_orig: Every single thing that is a bird is an animal. It is true that every bird is a cloud. Every airplane is a cloud. There are no birds that do not have wings. Some of the things that are vehicles are cars. This means that every single bird is an airplane.

syllogism: Jedes Objekt, das einen Stern umkreist, ist ein Planet. Es gibt einige Planeten, die Himmelskörper sind. Jeder Löffel ist ein Planet. Alles, was ein Stern ist, ist ein Planet. Sterne und Gasriesen haben keinerlei Überschneidung. Sterne sind in keiner Weise Himmelskörper. Alle Planeten sind Gesangsstunden. Es ist der Fall, dass einige Planeten keine Himmelskörper sind.
syllogism_orig: Every object that orbits a star is a planet. There are some planets which are celestial bodies. Every spoon is a planet. Anything that is a star is a planet. Stars and gas giants have no overlap whatsoever. Stars are in no way celestial bodies. All planets are singing lessons. It's the case that some planets are not celestial bodies.

syllogism: Absoluut niets dat een reptiel is, is een zoogdier. Elke hond is een zoogdier. Er zijn geen hagedissen die vissen zijn. Er bestaan geen wezens die zowel vis als reptiel zijn. Er zijn geen zoogdieren die reptielen zijn. Er zijn geen reptielen die ook zoogdieren zijn. Daarom is het het geval dat sommige hagedissen reptielen zijn.
syllogism_orig: Absolutely nothing that is a reptile is a mammal. Every single dog is a mammal. There are no lizards which are fish. There exist no creatures that are both fish and reptiles. There are no mammals which are reptiles. There are no reptiles which are also mammals. It is therefore the case that some lizards are reptiles.

syllogism: Hakuna samaki ambao ni mamalia. Wanyama wote wanaochukuliwa kuwa mamalia ni viumbe wenye manyoya. Hakuna kabisa kiumbe ambacho ni reptilia ambacho ni mamalia. Baadhi ya wanyama ni mamalia. Kila mamalia mmoja ni mnyama mwenye uti wa mgongo. Hakuna samaki ambao ni viumbe wenye manyoya. Kwa hivyo, inaweza kusemwa kwamba baadhi ya mamalia si samaki.
syllogism_orig: There are no fish that are mammals. All of the animals that are considered mammals are creatures with fur. Absolutely nothing that is a reptile is a mammal. Some animals are mammals. Every single mammal is a vertebrate. No fish are creatures with fur. Consequently, it can be said that some mammals are not fish.

syllogism: Il est vrai qu'aucun oiseau ne peut voler. Tout moineau est un oiseau. Tout ce qui est avocat est un politicien. Tout animal qui est un oiseau est une créature dotée d'un bec et de plumes. syllogism_orig: It is the case that no bird can fly. Every sparrow is a bird. Anything that is a lawyer is a politician. Every single animal that is a bird is a creature with a beak and feathers. Every bird is a creature. Every single fish is a creature. Anything which is a dog is a living creature. All birds are fish.

syllogism: Kila mamalia ni mnyama. Hakuna samaki ambaye ni mamalia. Pia ni kweli kwamba hakuna mbwa ambaye ni mwamba. Kila samaki ni mnyama. Hakuna paka ambaye ni mtambaazi. Kwa hivyo, hakuna samaki ambaye ni mnyama.
syllogism_orig: Every single mammal is an animal. There are no fish which are mammals. It is also true that no dogs are rocks. Every fish is an animal. Nothing that is a cat is a reptile. Consequently, there are no fish which are animals.

syllogism: Es verdad que todas las novelas son libros. Ningún libro de no ficción es una obra de ficción. Todas las novelas son obras de ficción. Nada que sea una revista es un libro. Todos los novelistas de fantasía son autores de novelas de fantasía. De esto se deduce que algunas novelas no son libros de no ficción.
syllogism_orig: It is true that all novels are books. Not one single nonfiction book is a fictional work. All novels are fictional works. Nothing that is a magazine is a book. All fantasy novelists are authors of fantasy novels. It follows from this that some novels are not nonfiction books.

syllogism: ప్రతి ఒక్క బల్లి ఒక రకమైన బల్లిపాము. బల్లిపాము అయినది ఏదీ క్షీరదం కాదు. మానవుడైనది ఏదైనా ఒక ప్రైమేట్. కొన్ని బల్లులు కూడా సరీసృపాలు. పాము అయినది ప్రతి ఒక్కటి శీతల రక్త జంతువు. కుక్క అయినది ఏదైనా కూడా ఒక జంతువు. సరీసృపాలైన కుక్కలు ఏవీ లేవు. కాబట్టి, కొన్ని సరీసృపాలు బల్లిపాములు.
syllogism_orig: Every single gecko is a type of lizard. Nothing that is a lizard is a mammal. Anything that is a human is a primate. A number of geckos are also reptiles. Every single thing that is a snake is a cold-blooded animal. Anything that is a dog is also an animal. There are no dogs that are reptiles. Therefore, some reptiles are lizards.

syllogism: Er zijn enkele priemgetallen die geen concepten zijn. Alle gehele getallen zijn even getallen. Alles wat een geheel getal is, is een getal. Het is waar dat elk getal een concept is. Het is waar dat geen enkele leeuw een dier is. Hieruit moet volgen dat sommige priemgetallen geen getallen zijn.
syllogism_orig: There are some prime numbers which are not concepts. All integers are even numbers. Everything that is an integer is a number. It is true that every single number is a concept. It is true that no lion is an animal. It must follow that some prime numbers are not numbers.

syllogism: ఓక్ అయిన ప్రతిదీ మొక్క. చెట్ల మొత్తం సమూహం స్త్రీలతో కూడి ఉంది. ఏ పిల్లి కూడా స్త్రీ కాదు. పిల్లి అయిన పురుషుడు ఎవరూ లేరు. ఏ మానవుడూ చెట్టు కాదు. కొందరు స్త్రీలు మానవులు కారు అని తార్కికంగా తేలుతుంది.
syllogism_orig: Everything that is an oak is a plant. The entire set of trees is composed of women. No cat is a woman whatsoever. There is no man that is a cat. Not a single human is a tree. It logically follows that some women are not human.

syllogism: Kuna paka wa porini ambao pia ni wanyama wa kufugwa. Si kweli kwamba ndege yeyote ni paka. Vitu vyote ambavyo ni simba milia ni paka wa porini. Ni ukweli kwamba paka wote ni paka wa porini. Kila pudeli ni mbwa. Kila kitu ambacho ni paka wa porini ni mamalia. Kila paka wa porini ni mnyama. Kwa hivyo, kila mamalia ni paka.
syllogism_orig: There exist some felines that are also pets. It is not true that any bird is a cat. All things that are tigers are felines. It is a fact that all cats are felines. Every poodle is a dog. Everything that is a feline is a mammal. Each and every feline is an animal. Therefore, every single mammal is a cat.

syllogism: প্রতিটি বস্তু যা একটি নক্ষত্রকে প্রদক্ষিণ করে তা একটি গ্রহ। কিছু গ্রহ আছে যা নক্ষত্র। প্রতিটি নক্ষত্রই একটি মহাজাগতিক বস্তু। একটি সেতুর পক্ষে মহাজাগতিক বস্তু হওয়া অসম্ভব। প্রতিটি গ্রহই আসলে একটি মহাজাগতিক বস্তু। প্রতিটি নক্ষত্র একটি উজ্জ্বল মহাজাগতিক বস্তু। কিছু গ্রহ আছে যা উজ্জ্বল নয়। এটি সত্য যে কিছু গ্রহ নক্ষত্র নয়।
syllogism_orig: Every object that orbits a star is a planet. There are some planets that are stars. Each and every star is a celestial body. It is impossible for a bridge to be a celestial body. Each of the planets is, in fact, a celestial body. Every star is a luminous celestial body. There are some planets that are not luminous. It is the case that some planets are not stars.

syllogism: Nessuna nuvola è uno strumento musicale. Alcune capanne sono case. Non esiste alcun leone che sia un grattacielo. Ogni verdura è una nuvola. Ogni singolo animale con pelliccia è una nuvola. Alcune nuvole sono case. Una casa è un edificio. Pertanto, è necessariamente vero che alcuni edifici sono nuvole.
syllogism_orig: Not a single cloud is a musical instrument. A few huts are houses. There is no lion which is a skyscraper. Every vegetable is a cloud. Every single animal with fur is a cloud. Some clouds are houses. A house is a building. As such, it is necessarily true that some buildings are clouds.

syllogism: Toute créature qui est un oiseau est aussi un animal volant. Tout ce qui est un chien est aussi un animal. Tout ce qui est un serpent est un animal à sang froid. Aucune composition n'est un animal. Tout ce qui est une chanson est aussi une composition. Il est un fait que certains animaux ne sont pas des insectes. Ainsi, nous pouvons valablement conclure que certains animaux ne sont pas des chansons.
syllogism_orig: Every creature that is a bird is also a flying animal. Anything that is a dog is also an animal. Every single thing that is a snake is a cold-blooded animal. No composition is an animal. Anything that is a song is also a composition. It is a fact that some animals are not insects. Thus, we can validly conclude that some animals are not songs.

syllogism: Nenhum humano é jamais um inseto. Tudo o que é um médico é também um humano. Tudo o que é um cientista é um profissional. Existem alguns indivíduos que encontram prazer na leitura que são bibliotecários. O grupo dos profissionais é um subconjunto do grupo das pessoas. Tudo o que é um médico é um profissional. Portanto, existem algumas pessoas que não são médicos.
syllogism_orig: No humans are ever insects. Anything that is a doctor is also a human. Anything that is a scientist is a professional. There are some individuals who find pleasure in reading who are librarians. The group of professionals is a subset of the group of people. Everything that is a doctor is a professional. Therefore, there are some people who are not doctors.

syllogism: Il n'existe rien qui soit un légume qui soit aussi un fruit. Chaque banane est un type de fruit. Chaque pomme est un fruit. Aucun fruit n'est une roche. Tout ce qui est une pomme est un fruit. Chaque fruit contient des graines. Un certain nombre de pommes contiennent des graines.
syllogism_orig: There is nothing that is a vegetable that is also a fruit. Every single banana is a type of fruit. Every single apple is a fruit. There are no fruits that are rocks. Anything that is an apple is a fruit. Every single fruit contains seeds. A number of apples contain seeds.

syllogism: Sehemu ya majengo ni mbwa. Kila jengo moja limetengenezwa kwa pipi. Hakuna nyumba ambazo si majengo. Vibanda vichache ni nyumba. Hakuna nyumba ambazo ni majengo. Hakuna kiumbe hai hata kimoja ambacho ni nyumba. Idadi fulani ya nyumba zimetengenezwa kwa pipi.
syllogism_orig: A portion of buildings are dogs. Every single building is made of candy. There are no houses that are not buildings. A few huts are houses. There are no houses that are buildings. There is not a single living thing that is a house. A certain number of houses are made of candy.

syllogism_orig: Every single person is a human. Every single human being is a mammal. Nothing that is mortal is immortal. The group of humans and the group of people have nothing in common. All of the things that are men are people. Men are not humans.

syllogism: Unter den Lebewesen, die Tiere sind, sind einige Säugetiere. Einige der als Weberknechte bekannten Dinge sind Lebewesen mit acht Beinen. Es gibt einige Lebewesen, die keine Vögel sind. Jedes einzelne Tier, das eine Spinne ist, ist ein Lebewesen mit acht Beinen. Es gibt mindestens ein Lebewesen, das ein Säugetier und zugleich ein Delfin ist. Es ist der Fall, dass kein Lebewesen, das ein Säugetier ist, ein Fisch ist. Es gibt keine Lebewesen mit Federn, die zugleich Insekten sind. Folglich sind nicht alle Weberknechte Spinnen.
syllogism_orig: Among the creatures that are animals, some are mammals. A few of the things known as daddy longlegs are creatures with eight legs. There are some living creatures that are not birds. Every single animal that is a spider is a creature with eight legs. There exists at least one creature that is a mammal and also a dolphin. It is the case that no creature that is a mammal is a fish. There are no creatures with feathers which are also insects. As a result, not all daddy longlegs are spiders.

syllogism: যে সকল বস্তু জানালা তার সবগুলোই প্রাণী। যে সকল বস্তু দরজা তার সবগুলোই প্রাণী। যে সকল বস্তু ত্রিভুজ তার সবগুলোই জ্যামিতিক আকৃতি। যে কোনো বস্তু যা কঠিন পদার্থ তা প্রাণীও বটে। যে সকল প্রাণী রয়েছে তাদের মধ্যে কিছু স্তন্যপায়ী। এটি অনুমান করা যায় যে এমন কিছু দরজা আছে যা জানালা।
syllogism_orig: All of the things that are windows are animals. All of the things that are doors are animals. All things which are triangles are geometric shapes. Anything that is a solid is also an animal. Among the creatures that are animals, some are mammals. It can be deduced that there are doors that are windows.

syllogism: Nenhum cão é um réptil. Todo cão é um mamífero. É o caso que algumas criaturas vivas não são mamíferos. Não há cães que sejam peixes. Qualquer golden retriever é um mamífero. É o caso que alguns golden retrievers são cães. Há alguns cães que são mamíferos. Isso significa que alguns cães são mamíferos.
syllogism_orig: No dog is a reptile. Every single dog is a mammal. It is the case that some living creatures are not mammals. There are no dogs that are fish. Any golden retriever is a mammal. It is the case that some golden retrievers are dogs. There are some dogs that are mammals. This means that a few dogs are mammals.

syllogism: 一些水果是自行车。一部分健康食品是蔬菜。任何水果都是食物。没有行星是食物。没有一个百香果是烘焙食品。所有可以被归类为苹果的东西都是蔬菜。没有苹果是食物。这意味着没有苹果是水果。
syllogism_orig: Some fruits are bicycles. A portion of healthy foods are vegetables. Any fruit is a food. There is no planet that is a food. Not one passion fruit is a baked good. Everything that can be classified as an apple is a vegetable. It is the case that no apple is a food. This means that no apple is a fruit.

syllogism: Mindestens ein Baum ist eine Pflanze. Jede einzelne Blume ist eine Pflanze. Es gibt keine Bäume, die nicht teleportieren können. Es gibt keine Universitäten, die Pflanzen sind. Es ist wahr, dass alle Blumen Pflanzen sind. Es ist auch wahr, dass einige Pflanzen Blumen sind. Mindestens ein Baum ist eine Universität.
syllogism_orig: At least one tree is a plant. Every single flower is a plant. There are no trees that cannot teleport. There are no universities which are plants. It is true that all flowers are plants. It is also true that some plants are flowers. At least one tree is a university.

Hay vegetales que son pimientos. También es verdad que ningún gato es un vegetal. Esto demuestra que algunos vegetales son alimentos.
syllogism_orig: No vegetable is a type of meat. It is true that every single meat is a food. Every single apple is a fruit. There are no fruits which are vegetables. There are no flowers that are vegetables. There are vegetables that are bell peppers. It is also true that no cats are vegetables. This proves that some vegetables are food.

syllogism: Toda ideia é uma árvore. Não há casos em que flores possam ser consideradas árvores. Todo humano é um animal que é um primata. Toda ideia é um animal. Uma parte dos animais de sangue quente são mamíferos. Portanto, existem animais que são árvores.
syllogism_orig: Every single idea is a tree. There are no instances where flowers can be considered trees. Every human is an animal that is a primate. Every single idea is an animal. A portion of warm-blooded animals are mammals. Therefore, there are animals that are trees.

syllogism: Elke hond is een huisdier. Geen enkel gebouw is een hond. Alle dingen die honden zijn, zijn wezens. Elke lepel is een planeet. Er zijn enkele planeten die honden zijn. Er is geen enkel zoogdier dat een kat is. Elk zoogdier is een gedomesticeerd dier. Hieruit kan worden geconcludeerd dat sommige wezens planeten zijn.
syllogism_orig: Every single dog is a domestic animal. No building is a dog. All things that are dogs are beings. Every spoon is a planet. There are some planets that are dogs. There is not a single mammal that is a cat. Every mammal is a domesticated animal. Hence, it can be concluded that some beings are planets.

syllogism: Ci sono studenti che sono lettori. Nessuna persona che è un dottore è anche un insegnante. Ogni singola persona che è uno studente è anche un educatore. Tra coloro che sono studenti, ci sono alcuni che sono atleti. Qualsiasi cosa sia un insegnante è un educatore. Ne consegue logicamente che ci sono alcuni studenti che non sono insegnanti.
syllogism_orig: There are students who are readers. No person who is a doctor is also a teacher. Every single person who is a student is also an educator. Among those who are students, there are some who are athletes. Anything that is a teacher is an educator. It logically follows that there are some students who are not teachers.

syllogism: Jede einzelne Person ist ein Mensch. Es gibt keine Person, die sowohl ein Musiker als auch eine nicht-künstlerische Person ist. Es ist wahr, dass keine Vögel Insekten sind. Unter den Dingen, die Deutsche sind, sind einige Personen. Ein Teil der Berufsköche sind Küchenchefs. Es ist wahr, dass einige Europäer Personen sind. Die einzige Schlussfolgerung ist, dass einige Deutsche keine Europäer sind.
syllogism_orig: Every single person is a human. There is no person who is both a musician and a non-artistic person. It is true that no birds are insects. Among the items that are Germans, some are people. A portion of professional cooks are chefs. It is true that some Europeans are people. The only conclusion is that some Germans are not Europeans.

syllogism: Ogni singolo albero è una pianta. Non esistono casi in cui i fiori possano essere considerati alberi. Tutte quante le rose sono anche piante. Ogni elemento che è una rosa è anche un fiore. È vero che tutte le rose sono fiori. Non esistono pietre che siano anche piante. È anche vero che alcune piante sono fiori. Esiste almeno una pietra che non è un albero.
syllogism_orig: Every single tree is a plant. There are no instances where flowers can be considered trees. Any and all roses are also plants. Every item that is a rose is also a flower. It is true that all roses are flowers. There exist no stones which are also plants. It is also true that some plants are flowers. There is at least one stone which is not a tree.

syllogism: বৃত্তের সম্পূর্ণ সমষ্টি ত্রিভুজ দ্বারা গঠিত। একটিও বর্গক্ষেত্র বৃত্ত নয়। যেকোনো কিছু যা বর্গক্ষেত্র তা একটি গোলাকার আকৃতি। এমন আকৃতি বিদ্যমান যেগুলি বর্গক্ষেত্র এবং বহুভুজও। প্রতিটি ত্রিভুজই একটি বর্গক্ষেত্র। যেকোনো কিছু যা বর্গক্ষেত্র তা একটি বহুভুজও। ত্রিভুজের একটি অংশ বর্গক্ষেত্র।
syllogism_orig: The entire set of circles is made up of triangles. Not a single square is a circle. Anything that is a square is a shape that is round. There exist shapes that are squares and are also polygons. Every single triangle is a square. Anything that is a square is also a polygon. A portion of triangles are squares.

syllogism: Todo lo que es un árbol es una planta. Es verdad que cualquier cosa que es una rosa es una flor. Un cierto número de robles son árboles. No hay animales que sean rosas. No hay casos en los que las flores puedan ser consideradas árboles. Es verdad que todas las rosas son flores. Es verdad que algunas cosas que son árboles no son robles. Se sigue que hay algunas plantas que no son robles.
syllogism_orig: Everything that is a tree is a plant. It is true that anything that is a rose is a flower. A certain number of oaks are trees. There are no animals that are roses. There are no instances where flowers can be considered trees. It is true that all roses are flowers. It is true that some things that are trees are not oaks. It follows that there are some plants that are not oaks.

syllogism: Hay algunas personas que son profesores y también son profesores de inglés. Toda persona que es bibliotecaria es estudiante. También es cierto que algunas personas educadas son seres humanos. Es una certeza que todo profesor es un ser humano. Se sabe que algunos seres humanos se encuentran entre las personas no artísticas. No hay ningún físico que no sea una persona. Sobre esta base, se ha afirmado que algunas personas educadas son profesores.
syllogism_orig: There are some people who are teachers and are also English teachers. Every single person who is a librarian is a student. It is also true that a few educated people are human beings. It is a certainty that every single teacher is a human being. It is known that some human beings are among the non-artistic people. There is no physicist who is not a person. On this basis, it has been stated that a few educated people are teachers.

syllogism: 没有圆是正方形。每一个正方形都是几何形状。所有正方形实际上都是形状。三角形从来不是正方形。没有正方形是圆。有些形状不是圆。
syllogism_orig: It is also the case that no circle is a square. A square, every single one of them, is a geometric shape. All squares are, in fact, shapes. A triangle is never a square. There are no squares which are circles. It's the case that some shapes are not circles.

syllogism: No hay coches que sean barcos. Todos y cada uno de los coches son, de hecho, vehículos. Cualquier cosa que sea un coche es un vehículo.
