syllogism_orig: There are no cars that are boats. Every single car is, in fact, a vehicle. Anything that is a car is a vehicle. Anything with an internal combustion engine needs fuel. There isn't a single car that is a two-wheeled vehicle. It is true that all cars are vehicles. There is not a single ferry that is a car. Consequently, some ferries are boats.

syllogism: Kitu chochote ambacho ni ndege ni mnyama wenye uti wa mgongo. Kila kasuku ana mdomo. Kitu chochote ambacho ni samaki kinaweza kuruka. Pia ni kweli kwamba kila ndege anaweza kuruka. Kitu chochote ambacho ni ndege ni mnyama. Hakuna ndege ambaye hana mabawa. Kila kitu ambacho ni popo ni kiumbe kinachoruka. Kutokana na haya, inaweza kuhitimishwa kwamba samaki wote ni ndege.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a bird is a vertebrate. Every parrot has a beak. Anything that is a fish can fly. It is also the case that every single bird can fly. Anything that is a bird is an animal. There are no birds that do not have wings. Every single thing that is a bat is a flying creature. From this, it can be concluded that all fish are birds.

syllogism: Chaque poisson est un animal. Tout ce qui est un reptile est aussi un animal. Aucun chien n'est un animal. Une partie des animaux sont des lézards. Chaque chat est un type d'animal. Par conséquent, certains lézards ne sont pas des reptiles.
syllogism_orig: Every fish is an animal. Anything that is a reptile is also an animal. There are no dogs which are animals. A portion of animals are lizards. Every single cat is a type of animal. Therefore, some lizards are not reptiles.

syllogism: Tous les anneaux sont des cercles. Les polygones et les cercles n'ont absolument aucun chevauchement. Il n'est pas le cas que certains cercles sont des émotions. Il est le cas qu'aucun cercle n'est une forme ronde. Au moins une chose qui est un cercle est un triangle. Tout ce qui est un carré est aussi un polygone. Donc, certains anneaux ne sont pas des formes rondes.
syllogism_orig: All of the things that are rings are circles. Polygons and circles have no overlap whatsoever. It is not the case that some circles are emotions. It is the case that no circles are round shapes. At least one thing that is a circle is a triangle. Anything that is a square is also a polygon. Thus, some rings are not round shapes.

syllogism: ద్రవంగా ఉన్న ఏదైనా ఘనపదార్థం కాదు. నీరు అంతా H2O. కుర్చీ అయిన ప్రతి ఫర్నీచర్ ద్రవంతో తయారు చేయబడింది. ద్రవంగా ఉన్న నీరు ఏదీ లేదు. సముద్రాలుగా ఉన్న నదులు ఏవీ లేవు. కాబట్టి, ప్రతి నీటి బొట్టు ఘనపదార్థం.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a liquid is not a solid. All water is H2O. Every piece of furniture that is a chair is made of liquid. There is no water that is a liquid. There are no rivers that are oceans. Consequently, every drop of water is a solid.

syllogism: 所有老虎都是哺乳动物。每只老虎都是猫科动物。每一种猫科动物都是动物。没有任何事物既是猫科动物又是猫。没有任何哺乳动物是鱼。每个人类都是一种哺乳动物。因此，所有哺乳动物都是猫科动物。
syllogism_orig: All tigers are also mammals. Every tiger is a feline. Each and every feline is an animal. There are no items that are both felines and cats. It is the case that no creature that is a mammal is a fish. Every human is a kind of mammal. Therefore, all mammals are felines.

syllogism: Hakuna paka ambaye ni mwanamke hata kidogo. Pia ni kweli kwamba kila paka ni kiumbe. Hakuna wanyama ambao ni viumbe hai. Ni kweli kwamba baadhi ya paka si vya kioo. Kila kitu ambacho ni samaki ni kiumbe. Hakuna mbwa ambao ni ndege. Kutokana na haya, inafuata kwamba paka wote ni samaki.
syllogism_orig: No cat is a woman whatsoever. It is also the case that every single cat is a creature. There are no animals that are living creatures. It is the case that some cats are not made of glass. Every single thing which is a fish is a creature. There are no dogs that are birds. From this, it follows that all cats are fish.

syllogism: Rien de ce qui est un lézard n'est un mammifère. Aucun oiseau n'est un mammifère. Rien de ce qui peut être décrit comme un chat n'est un chien. Il existe des animaux de compagnie qui sont des chiens. Aucun animal n'est un végétal. Tout chien est un mammifère. Aucun chat n'est un caniche. Nous devons conclure que certains animaux de compagnie ne sont pas des chats.
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is a lizard is a mammal. Every single bird is not a mammal. No item that can be described as a cat is a dog. There exist pets that are dogs. There are no animals that are vegetables. Every single dog is a mammal. No cat is a poodle. We must conclude that some pets are not cats.

syllogism: Elke vogel is een vis. Sommige pinguïns zijn, zoals bekend, geen vissen. Het is het geval dat geen enkel vliegend dier een pinguïn is. Elke hond is een zoogdier. Alle vliegtuigen zijn, zonder uitzondering, vogels. Dit impliceert noodzakelijkerwijs dat sommige pinguïns geen vogels zijn.
syllogism_orig: Every single bird is a fish. Some penguins, it is known, are not fish. It is the case that no flying animal is a penguin. Every single dog is a mammal. All airplains are, without exception, birds. This necessarily implies that some penguins are not birds.

syllogism: Kila kiumbe ambacho ni poodle ni mbwa. Mbwa si paka kwa vyovyote vile. Kuna wanyama ambao ni paka. Kila poodle ni mbwa. Hakuna paka ambao ni samaki. Baadhi ya samaki wanaoainishwa kama wanyama wenye uti wa mgongo. Hakuna mbwa ambao ni samaki.
syllogism_orig: Every single creature that is a poodle is a dog. Dogs are in no way cats. There are some animals which are cats. Every poodle is a dog. There are no cats which are fish. Some fish are classified as vertebrates. There exist no dogs that are fish.

syllogism: প্রতিটি বই এক টন ওজনের — এটি সত্য। প্রতিটি উপন্যাস একটি বই। সমস্ত ফ্যান্টাসি ঔপন্যাসিক ফ্যান্টাসি উপন্যাসের লেখক। এমন কোনো বই নেই যা একটি ইলেকট্রনিক যন্ত্র। কিছু উপন্যাস বই। প্রতিটি জিনিস যা একটি উপন্যাস তা একটি বই। অতএব, কিছু উপন্যাস এক টন ওজনের।
syllogism_orig: It is the case that every single book weighs a ton. Every novel is a book. All fantasy novelists are authors of fantasy novels. There is no book that is an electronic device. A portion of novels are books. Every single thing which is a novel is a book. Consequently, some novels weigh a ton.

syllogism: Существуют некоторые птицы, которые умеют летать. Не существует растения, которое является камнем. Неверно, что какое-либо растение является столом. Все деревья по определению являются растениями. Не существует столов, которые являются живыми существами. Верно, что некоторые растения являются столами.
syllogism_orig: There exist some birds that can fly. There is no plant that is a rock. It is not true that any plant is a table. All trees are, by definition, plants. There are no tables that are living things. It is the case that some plants are tables.

syllogism: Qualsiasi cosa che sia un gatto è un felino. Ogni singola cosa che sia una carota è una verdura. Tutte le cose che sono gatti sono felini. Ciascun felino è un animale. Tutte le cose che sono leoni sono felini. È anche vero che ogni leone è un mammifero. Se ne deduce che ci sono gatti che sono leoni.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a cat is a feline. Every single thing that is a carrot is a vegetable. All of the things that are cats are felines. Each and every feline is an animal. All of the things that are lions are felines. It is also true that every lion is a mammal. It can be deduced that there are cats that are lions.

syllogism: Kila chura ni amfibia. Hakuna mto ambao ni bahari kuu. Hakuna amfibia ambaye haishi nchi kavu na majini. Kila mto ni chanzo cha maji. Kuna angalau chura mmoja ambaye anaishi nchi kavu na majini.
syllogism_orig: Every single frog is an amphibian. There are no rivers that are oceans. There are no amphibians that do not live on both land and in water. Every single river is a body of water. There exists at least one frog that lives on land and in water.

syllogism: Alcuni animali sono mammiferi. Non esistono animali che volano che siano anche pesci. Ogni creatura che è un uccello è anche un animale che vola. Ogni singolo primate è un animale. Tutte le cose che sono tigri sono felini. Ci sono alcuni mammiferi che sono primati. Di conseguenza, alcuni animali sono mammiferi.
syllogism_orig: Some animals are mammals. There are no animals that fly which are also fish. Every creature that is a bird is also a flying animal. Every single primate is an animal. All things that are tigers are felines. There are some mammals that are primates. Consequently, some animals are mammals.

syllogism: Er zijn enkele stoelen die houten voorwerpen zijn. Geen enkel bureau is een stoel. Er zijn geen stoelen die als muziekinstrumenten beschouwd kunnen worden. Er zijn geen stoelen die geen meubels zijn. Bepaalde stoelen bestaan die ook antiek zijn. Alles wat een potlood is, is een schrijfinstrument. Een aantal voorwerpen die als meubels gecategoriseerd zijn, zijn geen stoelen. De conclusie dat een deel van de antieke voorwerpen geen muziekinstrumenten zijn, is onvermijdelijk.
syllogism_orig: There are some chairs that are wooden objects. No desks are chairs whatsoever. There are no chairs that can be considered musical instruments. There are no chairs that are not furniture. Certain chairs exist that are also antiques. Everything that is a pencil is a writing instrument. A number of objects categorized as furniture are not chairs. The conclusion that a portion of antiques are not musical instruments is inescapable.

syllogism: Каждая собака является представителем псовых. Ни одна собака не является птицей. Небольшое количество млекопитающих являются животными. Некоторые представители псовых являются терьерами. Не существует собак, которые являются кошачьими. Следовательно, каждый терьер является собакой.
syllogism_orig: Every dog is a canine. No dog is a bird. A small number of mammals are animals. Some canines are terriers. There are no dogs that are felines. Consequently, every single terrier is a dog.

syllogism: మానవుడైన ప్రతిదీ ఒక ప్రైమేట్. ఏ ప్రాథమిక రంగు కూడా ద్వితీయ రంగు కాదు. కొంతమంది ఓటర్లు పౌరులు. న్యాయవాదులు, మినహాయింపు లేకుండా, వృత్తి నిపుణులు. కనిపించే రంగులలో కొన్ని ప్రాథమిక రంగులుగా వర్గీకరించబడ్డాయి. ప్రతి పూడిల్ ఒక కుక్క. కొన్ని పాములు ఒక రకమైన సరీసృపాలు. కాబట్టి ప్రతి కనిపించే రంగు ద్వితీయ రంగు కాదు.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a human is a primate. Absolutely no primary color is also a secondary color. There are some voters who are citizens. Lawyers are, without exception, professionals. Some things which are visible colors are classified as primary colors. Every poodle is a dog. A few snakes are a type of reptile. It is thus the case that not every visible color is a secondary color.

syllogism: క్యారెట్లు అయిన వస్తువులు ఏవీ బెల్ పెప్పర్లు కావు. ప్రతి గిటార్ ఒక సంగీత వాయిద్యం. ప్రతి కూరగాయ ఒక గ్రహం. రాళ్ళు అయిన కొన్ని చంద్రులు ఉన్నాయి. గ్రహం అయిన ప్రతిదీ గుండ్రంగా ఉంటుంది. గ్రహం అయిన ప్రతిదీ ఒక సంగీత వాయిద్యం. కొన్ని సంగీత వాయిద్యాలు కూరగాయలు అనేది తార్కిక అవసరం.
syllogism_orig: None of the items that are carrots are bell peppers. Every single guitar is a musical instrument. Every single vegetable is a planet. There are some moons that are rocks. Anyone who is a planet is round. Anything that is a planet is a musical instrument. It is a logical necessity that some musical instruments are vegetables.

syllogism: É verdade que todos os carros são veículos. Um subconjunto de veículos consiste em caminhões. Não há carros que sejam casas. Qualquer coisa que seja um veículo também é uma máquina. Existe um subconjunto de máquinas que são carros. Nenhum carro é animal. Portanto, alguns carros não são veículos.
syllogism_orig: It is true that all cars are vehicles. A subset of vehicles consists of trucks. There are no cars that are houses. Anything that is a vehicle is also a machine. There is a subset of machines that are cars. No cars are animals. Therefore, some cars are not vehicles.

syllogism: 一些椅子是人。植物绝不是生物。一些蘑菇是蔬菜。至少有一棵树是植物。所有的树，按定义来说，都是植物。每一样是植物的东西都是生物。没有树是生物。由此可得，所有植物都是树。
syllogism_orig: A number of chairs are people. Plants are in no way living things. Some of the mushrooms are vegetables. At least one tree is a plant. All trees are, by definition, plants. Every single item which is a plant is a living organism. There are no trees that are living organisms. This implies that all plants are trees.

syllogism: Hakuna mawingu ambayo ni miamba. Hakuna mmea ambao ni mwamba. Kila gitaa ni ala ya muziki. Sehemu ya sayari ni miamba. Kitu chochote ambacho ni wingu kimetengenezwa kwa mwamba. Hakuna miamba ambayo ni milima. Kila kitu ambacho ni wimbo pia kimetengenezwa kwa maji. Kwa hivyo, milima mingine ni mawingu.
syllogism_orig: There are no clouds that are rocks. There is no plant that is a rock. Every single guitar is a musical instrument. A portion of planets are rocks. Anything which is a cloud is made of rock. There are no rocks that are mountains. Everything that is a song is also made of water. Therefore, some mountains are clouds.

syllogism: 每一个食肉动物都是动物。每一个昆虫都是有六条腿的生物。每一个哺乳动物都是昆虫。没有昆虫是狗。有一部分宠物不是哺乳动物。基于此，必然得出有些狗不是哺乳动物。
syllogism_orig: Every single carnivore is an animal. Every single insect is a creature that has six legs. Every single mammal is an insect. There are no insects which are dogs. A portion of the things that are pets are not mammals. Based on this, it must be the case that some dogs are not mammals.

syllogism: Ningún gato es un perro. No hay perros que sean reptiles. Es el caso que todos los perros son mamíferos. Todo mamífero está hecho de vidrio. Algunos de los perros son mamíferos. Todo animal que es un gato es una nube. Se sigue que ningún gato es un mamífero.
syllogism_orig: No cats are dogs. There are no dogs that are reptiles. It is the case that all dogs are mammals. Every mammal is made of glass. Some of the dogs are mammals. Any animal that is a cat is a cloud. It follows that no cat is a mammal.

syllogism: Ogni felino è un animale. Tutte le cose che sono tigri sono felini. Qualsiasi cosa che è un pappagallo è un uccello. Una parte delle cose che sono uccelli ha piume. Ci sono alcuni animali che hanno code prensili che sono scimmie. Ogni singola cosa che è un uccello è un animale. C'è un sottoinsieme di animali che è composto da mammiferi. Una parte dei mammiferi non sono felini.
syllogism_orig: Every feline is an animal. All things that are tigers are felines. Anything that is a parrot is a bird. A portion of the things that are birds have feathers. There are some animals that have prehensile tails which are monkeys. Every single thing that is a bird is an animal. There is a subset of animals that is composed of mammals. A portion of mammals are not felines.

syllogism: Ogni singolo poligono è un quadrato. È anche vero che nessun cerchio è un quadrato. Qualsiasi cosa che sia un quadrato ha quattro lati uguali. Tutte le cose che sono triangoli sono forme geometriche. Qualsiasi cosa che sia un quadrato è una forma rotonda. Qualsiasi cosa che sia un quadrato è anche un poligono. Nessun triangolo è incluso nella categoria dei quadrati. Alcuni triangoli non sono poligoni.
syllogism_orig: Every single polygon is a square. It is also the case that no circle is a square. Anything that is a square has four equal sides. All things which are triangles are geometric shapes. Anything that is a square is a shape that is round. Anything that is a square is also a polygon. No triangles are included in the category of squares. Some triangles are not polygons.

syllogism: Todos los destornilladores son también herramientas. Los martillos son artículos que son herramientas. Algunos martillos son, de hecho, herramientas. Hay algunos lápices que también son instrumentos de escritura. Ni un solo lápiz es un bolígrafo. Los artículos de cocina nunca son martillos. Es el caso que ningún guante es una herramienta. Se puede concluir que ningún guante es un martillo.
syllogism_orig: All screwdrivers are also tools. Hammers are items that are tools. A few hammers are, in fact, tools. There are some pencils which are also writing tools. Not a single pencil is a pen. Kitchen items are never hammers. It is the case that no glove is a tool. It can be concluded that no glove is a hammer.

syllogism: Qualquer coisa que seja um triângulo não é uma forma com três lados. Toda e qualquer coisa que seja um triângulo equilátero é um triângulo. Qualquer coisa que seja um quadrado é uma forma redonda. Também é o caso que nenhum círculo é um quadrado. Um quadrado, cada um deles, é uma forma geométrica. Todo e qualquer objeto que tem quatro lados iguais tem quatro lados. Portanto, é o caso que alguns triângulos equiláteros não são formas com três lados.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a triangle is not a shape with three sides. Every single thing that is an equilateral triangle is a triangle. Anything that is a square is a shape that is round. It is also the case that no circle is a square. A square, every single one of them, is a geometric shape. Every single object that has four equal sides has four sides. Therefore, it is the case that some equilateral triangles are not shapes with three sides.

syllogism: Jede einzelne Banane ist eine Art von Obst. Alles, was ein Obst ist, ist ein Gefühl. Alles, was eine Karotte ist, ist auch ein Gemüse. Alles, was als Apfel klassifiziert werden kann, ist ein Gemüse. Es gibt keine Gefühle, die Äpfel sind. Alles, was eine Karotte ist, ist auch ein Obst. Einige Obstsorten sind Fahrräder. Daraus können wir schließen, dass einige Äpfel kein Obst sind.
syllogism_orig: Every single banana is a type of fruit. Anything that is a fruit is a feeling. Everything that is a carrot is also a vegetable. Everything that can be classified as an apple is a vegetable. There are no feelings which are apples. Anything that is a carrot is also a fruit. Some fruits are bicycles. As a result, we can conclude that some apples are not fruits.

syllogism: একটি কম্পিউটার কখনো একটি ট্যাবলেট নয়। সমস্ত ইলেকট্রনিক ডিভাইস হলো আইটেম। এমন কোনো বই নেই যা একটি ইলেকট্রনিক ডিভাইস। সমস্ত ট্যাবলেট, ব্যতিক্রম ছাড়াই, ইলেকট্রনিক ডিভাইস। সমস্ত আইটেম যা ফোন সেগুলো ইলেকট্রনিক ডিভাইস। ইলেকট্রনিক ডিভাইসের একটি উপসেট কম্পিউটার দ্বারা গঠিত নয়।
syllogism_orig: A computer is never a tablet. All electronic devices are items. There is no book that is an electronic device. All of the tablets are, without exception, electronic devices. All items that are phones are electronic devices. A subset of electronic devices is not composed of computers.

syllogism: Pia ni kweli kwamba hakuna mashua ambayo ni ndege. Chochote ambacho ni gari ni chombo cha usafiri. Kila chombo cha usafiri ambacho ni gari pia ni chombo cha usafiri. Gari kamwe si ndege. Chochote chenye injini ya mwako wa ndani kinahitaji mafuta. Hakuna Ferrari ambazo ni mashine. Kila gari linaweza kuelezwa kuwa mashine. Kwa hivyo, mashua zote ni magari.
syllogism_orig: It is also the case that no boat is an airplane. Anything that is a car is a vehicle. Every vehicle that is a car is also a vehicle. A car is never an airplane. Anything with an internal combustion engine needs fuel. There are no ferraries that are machines. Every car can be described as a machine. Consequently, all boats are cars.

syllogism: Non esistono oggetti che siano sia strumenti sia dotati di manici. Qualsiasi cosa sia un martello è uno strumento. Esistono alcune matite che sono anche strumenti di scrittura. Nessuna matita è una penna. L'intero insieme degli oggetti dotati di manici è composto da martelli. Esiste un gruppo di studenti che sono anche adolescenti. Una parte degli strumenti sono martelli.
syllogism_orig: There are no objects that are both tools and have handles. Anything that is a hammer is a tool. There are some pencils which are also writing tools. Not a single pencil is a pen. The entire set of objects with handles is composed of hammers. There exists a group of students who are also teenagers. A portion of tools are hammers.

syllogism: প্রতিটি প্রাণী যেটি একটি বিড়াল সেটি একটি মেরুদণ্ডী। কুকুরদের একটি উপসমষ্টিকে স্তন্যপায়ী হিসাবে শ্রেণীবদ্ধ করা যায়। এমন একটিও মাছ নেই যেটি একটি বিড়াল। যেকোনো প্রাণী যেটি একটি বিড়াল সেটি একটি স্তন্যপায়ী। কোনো বিড়াল পুডল নয়। এর মানে হলো কোনো মাছ স্তন্যপায়ী নয়।
syllogism_orig: Every single animal that is a cat is a vertebrate. A subset of dogs can be classified as mammals. There isn't a single fish that is a cat. Any animal that is a cat is a mammal. No cat is a poodle. This means that no fish is a mammal.

syllogism: Ogni singolo cane è un animale domestico. È vero che tutti i giornali sono animali. Ci sono alcune riviste che non sono animali. Non esistono cose con le ali che siano creature viventi. Ogni singolo mammifero è un animale. Pertanto, è il caso che alcune riviste non siano giornali.
syllogism_orig: Every single dog is a domestic animal. It is true that all newspapers are animals. There are some magazines that are not animals. There are no things with wings that are living creatures. Every single mammal is an animal. Therefore, it is the case that some magazines are not newspapers.

syllogism: Die Klasse der Insekten und die Klasse der Löwen überschneiden sich nicht. Eine gewisse Anzahl von Eichen sind Bäume. Jede einzelne Blume ist eine Pflanze. Es gibt keine Dinge, die Tiere sind, die Pflanzen sind. Jedes Säugetier ist ein Haustier. Alles, was ein Baum ist, ist eine Pflanze. Folglich gibt es einige Bäume, die keine Tiere sind.
syllogism_orig: The class of insects and the class of lions do not overlap. A certain number of oaks are trees. Every single flower is a plant. There are no things which are animals that are plants. Every mammal is a domesticated animal. Everything that is a tree is a plant. Consequently, there exist some trees which are not animals.

syllogism: Algunos de los perros son mamíferos. No hay felinos que sean caninos. No hay gatos que también sean perros. Todo lo que es un pingüino también es un ave. Cada águila es un ave. Se sabe que no hay perros que sean aves. Hay algunos animales que son gorriones. Se podría concluir que ninguna ave es un gato.
syllogism_orig: Some of the dogs are mammals. There are no felines that are canines. There are no cats that are also dogs. Anything that is a penguin is also a bird. Every single eagle is a bird. It is known that there are no dogs that are birds. There are some animals that are sparrows. One might conclude that no birds are cats.

syllogism: పువ్వు అయిన ప్రతిదీ మొక్క. మొక్కలు కాని కొన్ని ల్యాప్‌టాప్‌లు ఉన్నాయి. పుట్టగొడుగులలో కొన్ని కూరగాయలు. ప్రతి కంప్యూటర్ ఒక మొక్క. గులాబి అయిన ప్రతిదీ పువ్వు అనేది నిజం. సముద్రాలు అయిన అన్ని వస్తువులు కంప్యూటర్లు. కూరగాయలు అయిన కొన్ని క్యారెట్లు ఉన్నాయి. కొన్ని ల్యాప్‌టాప్‌లు కంప్యూటర్లు కావు అనేది తప్పనిసరిగా నిజం.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a flower is a plant. There exist some laptops that are not plants. Some of the mushrooms are vegetables. Every computer is a plant. It is true that anything that is a rose is a flower. All things which are oceans are computers. There are some carrots that are vegetables. It must be the case that some laptops are not computers.

syllogism: Jedes einzelne Ding, das ein Lastwagen ist, ist ein Fahrzeug. Es ist der Fall, dass einige Pickups Fahrzeuge sind. Mindestens ein Auto hat keine Räder. Mindestens ein motorisiertes Fahrzeug ist kein Fahrzeug. Es gibt einige Fahrräder, die auch Automobile sind. Folglich sind einige Pickups keine Lastwagen.
syllogism_orig: Every single thing that is a truck is a vehicle. It is the case that a number of pickups are vehicles. At least one car does not have wheels. At least one motorized vehicle is not a vehicle. There are a few bicycles that are also automobiles. Consequently, some pickups are not trucks.

syllogism: Non è vero che qualche cane sia un gatto. Tutte le cose che sono gatti sono felini. Non esiste un solo mammifero che sia un gatto. Un piccolo numero di mammiferi sono animali. Un certo numero di golden retriever risultano essere cani. Non esistono squali che siano anche cani. Pertanto, alcuni golden retriever non sono gatti.
syllogism_orig: It is not true that any dog is a cat. All things that are cats are felines. There is not a single mammal that is a cat. A small number of mammals are animals. A certain number of golden retrievers are found to be dogs. There are no sharks which are also dogs. Thus, some golden retrievers are not cats.

syllogism: Hay algunas zanahorias que son verduras. Hay verduras que son pimientos. No hay verduras que no sean venenosas. No hay ningún plátano que sea una zanahoria. Una parte de los alimentos saludables son verduras. Algunos perros son zanahorias. Cualquier cosa que sea una zanahoria es una verdura. Se deduce que varias zanahorias son venenosas.
syllogism_orig: There are some carrots that are vegetables. There are vegetables that are bell peppers. There are no vegetables that are not poisonous. There is no banana which is a carrot. A portion of healthy foods are vegetables. Some dogs are carrots. Anything that is a carrot is a vegetable. It follows that a number of carrots are poisonous.

syllogism: Es gibt mindestens ein Lebewesen, das ein Säugetier und zugleich ein Delfin ist. Jede einzelne Katze ist ein Hund. Keine Katzen gelten als Fische. Einige der Säugetiere sind Fleischfresser. Es gibt keine Fische, die Säugetiere sind. Einige Katzenartige sind keine Säugetiere.
syllogism_orig: There exists at least one creature that is a mammal and also a dolphin. Every single cat is a dog. No cats are considered fish. Some of the mammals are carnivores. There are no fish which are mammals. Some felines are not mammals.

syllogism: Nenhum réptil é também um mamífero. Nenhum anfíbio terrestre é capaz de sobreviver em água salgada. Nenhum anfíbio é um réptil. Toda salamandra é, sem exceção, um anfíbio terrestre. Isso implica que nenhuma salamandra é capaz de viver em água salgada.
syllogism_orig: There are no reptiles which are also mammals. Not a single land-dwelling amphibian is able to survive in saltwater. Not a single amphibian is a reptile. Every salamander is, without exception, a land-dwelling amphibian. This implies that no salamander is able to live in saltwater.

syllogism: Toda cosa que es un murciélago es una criatura voladora. Es verdad que toda ave es una nube. Todo animal con pelaje es una nube. Cualquier cosa que es un ave es un vertebrado. Todo ser vivo es una nube. Algunas criaturas que pueden volar son aves. Se sigue que ninguna ave es un ser vivo.
syllogism_orig: Every single thing that is a bat is a flying creature. It is true that every bird is a cloud. Every single animal with fur is a cloud. Anything that is a bird is a vertebrate. Every single living being is a cloud. Some creatures that can fly are birds. It follows that no bird is a living being.

syllogism: Kila gari ni chombo cha usafiri. Hakuna magari ambayo ni pikipiki. Kuna baadhi ya Toyota ambazo ni magari. Chochote ambacho ni baiskeli pia ni chombo cha usafiri. Kuna baadhi ya vyombo vya usafiri ambavyo ni mashine. Ni kweli kwamba magari yote ni vyombo vya usafiri. Hakuna baiskeli ambazo ni magari. Kwa hivyo, kila gari ni mashine.
syllogism_orig: Every single car is a vehicle. There are no cars which are motorcycles. There are some Toyotas that are cars. Anything that is a bicycle is also a vehicle. There are some vehicles that are machines. It is true that all cars are vehicles. There are no bicycles that are cars. It is therefore the case that every car is a machine.

syllogism: Ogni singola creatura che è un animale con le pinne è un pesce. È vero che tutti i pesci sono vertebrati. Nessun animale che è un mammifero può essere considerato un pesce. È anche il caso che alcune balene siano pesci. Qualsiasi cosa sia un pinguino è anche un uccello. Questo porta alla conclusione che alcune balene sono animali con le pinne.
syllogism_orig: Every single creature that is an animal with fins is a fish. It is true that all fish are vertebrates. No animals that are mammals can be considered fish. It is also the case that some whales are fish. Anything that is a penguin is also a bird. This leads to the conclusion that some whales are animals with fins.

syllogism: Geen geluiden zijn getallen. De verzameling van alle gehele getallen bevat geen letters. Alle woorden zijn getallen die door twee gedeeld kunnen worden. Het is waar dat geen getallen golven zijn. Een paar getallen die oneven zijn, zijn ook deelbaar door twee. Er is geen overlap tussen even getallen en woorden. Hieruit volgt dat geen geluiden golven zijn.
syllogism_orig: No sounds are numbers. The set of all integers contains no letters. All words are numbers that can be divided by two. It is true that no numbers are waves. A few numbers that are odd are also divisible by two. There is no overlap between even numbers and words. It follows that no sounds are waves.

syllogism: గ్యాస్ జెయింట్ అయిన కనీసం ఒక వస్తువు గ్రహం. ఒక వంతెన ఖగోళ వస్తువు కావడం అసాధ్యం. గ్రహం అయిన ప్రతిదీ ఖగోళ వస్తువు. ఖగోళ వస్తువులు అయిన కొన్ని నక్షత్రాలు ఉన్నాయి. భూమి అయిన వస్తువులు గ్రహాలు కాకుండా ఉండేవి ఏవీ లేవు. కాబట్టి, కనీసం కొంత భూమి ఖగోళ వస్తువు.
syllogism_orig: At least one thing that is a gas giant is a planet. It is impossible for a bridge to be a celestial body. Everything that is a planet is a celestial body. There are some celestial bodies that are stars. There are no things that are Earth that are not planets. Therefore, at least some Earth is a celestial body.

syllogism: 偶数集合与动物集合互不相交。有些动物是人类。任何动物都是奇数。一定数量的狮子是食肉动物。有些动物是鸟类。有些奇数是偶数。
syllogism_orig: The group of even numbers and the group of animals are mutually exclusive. Some animals are human. Any animal is also an odd number. A certain number of lions are carnivores. There are some animals which are birds. There are some odd numbers that are even numbers.

syllogism: Non esiste alcun cane che sia anche una pianta. Non esistono animali che siano lucertole. Qualsiasi cosa sia un cane è un mammifero. Tutte le rose sono anche piante. Non esistono esseri umani che siano piante. Il gruppo degli esseri umani e il gruppo dei cani si escludono a vicenda.
syllogism_orig: There exists no dog that is also a plant. There are no animals which are lizards. Anything that is a dog is a mammal. Any and all roses are also plants. There are no humans who are plants. The group of humans and the group of dogs are mutually exclusive.

syllogism: Kuna maapulo mengine ambayo ni matunda. Hakuna matunda ambayo ni mboga. Kila apulo ni tunda. Hakuna matunda ambayo ni mawe. Hakuna kitu ambacho ni mboga ambacho pia ni tunda. Chochote ambacho ni apulo kinaweza kuliwa. Kila ndizi ni aina ya tunda. Kwa hivyo, baadhi ya vitu vinavyoweza kuliwa ni matunda.
syllogism_orig: There exist some apples that are fruits. There are no fruits which are vegetables. Every single apple is a fruit. There are no fruits that are rocks. There is nothing that is a vegetable that is also a fruit. Anything that is an apple is edible. Every single banana is a type of fruit. Thus, some edible things are fruits.

syllogism: Un petit nombre de mammifères sont des animaux. Il est vrai qu'aucun chien n'est un poisson. Il y a des caniches qui sont des chiens. Il n'y a aucun félin qui soit un canin. Tout ce qui est un chien a de la fourrure. Tout chien est un animal. Il n'y a aucun caniche qui n'ait pas de fourrure.
syllogism_orig: A small number of mammals are animals. It is the case that no dog is a fish. There are some poodles that are dogs. There are no felines that are canines. Anything that is a dog has fur. Every dog is an animal. There are no poodles that do not have fur.

syllogism: কোনো সোডা জুস নয়। কোনো কিছু যা সোডা তা জুস নয়। কোনো পোশাক কখনো পানীয় নয়। পানীয়গুলির একটি অংশ জুস নয়। পানীয়গুলির একটি অংশ জুস। একমাত্র যৌক্তিক সিদ্ধান্ত হলো কিছু পানীয় সোডা নয়।
syllogism_orig: There is no soda that is a juice. Nothing that is a soda is a juice. No articles of clothing are ever beverages. A portion of the items that are beverages are not juices. A portion of the things that are beverages are juices. The only logical conclusion is that some beverages are not sodas.

syllogism: গ্রহগুলির একটি অংশ পাথর। যা কিছু সালামান্ডার তা গ্রহ। যেকোনো মহাজাগতিক বস্তু যা গ্রহ তা ঘনক। মহাজাগতিক বস্তুগুলির একটি অংশ গ্রহ। যা কিছু গ্রহ তাকে মহাজাগতিক বস্তু বলে গণ্য করা হয়। এটি সত্য যে কোনো ধূমকেতু চাঁদ নয়। ফলস্বরূপ, কিছু মহাজাগতিক বস্তু ঘনক।
syllogism_orig: A portion of planets are rocks. Everything that is a salamander is a planet. Any celestial body which is a planet is a cube. A portion of celestial bodies are planets. Anything that is a planet is considered a celestial body. It is true that no comet is a moon. Consequently, some celestial bodies are cubes.

syllogism: 能呼吸氧气的生物与岩石之间没有重叠。每一只鸟都是动物。一些水生动物是鱼。动物与有喙和羽毛的生物完全不同。所有岩石都是动物。所有狗都是动物。某些动物不是能呼吸氧气的生物。
syllogism_orig: There is no overlap between living things that can breathe oxygen and rocks. Every single bird is an animal. A few aquatic animals are fish. Animals are entirely separate from creatures with beaks and feathers. All things that are rocks are animals. Everything that is a dog is an animal. Certain animals are not living things that can breathe oxygen.

syllogism: Tutti gli esseri umani sono oggetti dotati di massa. Nessuna cosa che può essere considerata un corpo celeste è un oggetto che orbita attorno a una stella. Alcune stelle sono soli. Ogni oggetto volante è una creatura dotata di ali. Tutto ciò che è un oceano è un corpo d'acqua. Ogni pianeta è un oggetto che orbita attorno a una stella. Tutto ciò che è una matita è uno strumento di scrittura. Non esistono pianeti che siano anche corpi celesti.
syllogism_orig: All humans are objects with mass. Nothing that can be considered a celestial body is an object that orbits a star. A few stars are suns. Every flying object is a creature with wings. Everything that is an ocean is a body of water. Every planet is an object that orbits a star. Everything that is a pencil is a writing tool. There exist no planets that are also celestial bodies.

syllogism: 每一个是花的物体都是动物。任何是玫瑰的东西都是一个是花的物体。任何是汽车的东西都是一个会移动的物体。每一个食肉动物都是动物。每一个哺乳动物都是动物。鸟类绝不是有翅膀的生物。这意味着每一朵玫瑰都是动物。
syllogism_orig: Every object that is a flower is an animal. Anything that is a rose is an object that is a flower. Anything that is a car is an object that moves. Every single carnivore is an animal. Every single mammal is an animal. Birds are in no way winged creatures. This means that every rose is an animal.

syllogism: Всё, что является млекопитающим, является теплокровным существом. Всё, что является млекопитающим, является насекомым. Всё, что является млекопитающим, не является насекомым. Каждое млекопитающее является животным. Некоторые животные, без сомнения, являются млекопитающими. Ни один автомобиль не является животным. Существуют домашние животные, которые являются млекопитающими. Следовательно, каждое животное сделано из дерева.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a mammal is a creature that is warm-blooded. Anything that is a mammal is an insect. Anything that is a mammal is not an insect. Every single mammal is an animal. Some animals are, without a doubt, mammals. No cars are animals. There are pets which are mammals. Therefore, every single animal is made of wood.

syllogism: Tutto ciò che è una mela è un mammifero acquatico. Ci sono alcune verdure che sono mele. Tutte le verdure sono pizze. Ogni singolo gatto è un tipo di animale. Non ci sono frutti che sono verdure. Ciò implica necessariamente che alcuni mammiferi acquatici sono verdure.
syllogism_orig: Everything that is an apple is an aquatic mammal. There are some vegetables which are apples. All vegetables are pizzas. Every single cat is a type of animal. There are no fruits which are vegetables. This necessitates that some aquatic mammals are vegetables.

syllogism: Todas las cosas que son números son animales. También es cierto que ningún gato es un vegetal. Todas las cosas que son gatos son felinos. Todas las cosas que son números son plantas. Una porción de los animales de sangre caliente son mamíferos. Se deduce que algunas plantas son animales.
syllogism_orig: All things which are numbers are animals. It is also true that no cats are vegetables. All things that are cats are felines. All things which are numbers are plants. A portion of warm-blooded animals are mammals. It follows that some plants are animals.

syllogism: Cada gato es un perro. Todo lo que es un mamífero es un animal de sangre caliente. No hay peces que sean mamíferos. Cada mamífero es un animal. Ningún gato es considerado un pez. Una parte de las cosas que son aves tienen plumas. Algunos felinos no son mamíferos.
syllogism_orig: Every single cat is a dog. Anything that is a mammal is a warm-blooded animal. There are no fish that are mammals. Every single mammal is an animal. No cats are considered fish. A portion of the things that are birds have feathers. Some felines are not mammals.

syllogism: వాహనాలలో కొంత భాగం కార్లు. కార్లలో ఏవీ సైకిళ్లు కావు. కొన్ని కార్లు వాహనాలతో కూడి ఉన్నాయి. వాహనమైనది ఏదీ రవాణా సాధనం కాదు. కారు అయిన ప్రతి వాహనం వాహనం కూడా. దీని నుండి కొన్ని కార్లు రవాణా సాధనాలు కావు అని తేలుతుంది.
syllogism_orig: A portion of vehicles are cars. There are no cars that are bicycles. A certain number of cars are composed of vehicles. Nothing that is a vehicle is a mode of transportation. Every vehicle that is a car is also a vehicle. It follows that a portion of cars are not modes of transportation.

syllogism: Ни один камень не может быть классифицирован как растение. Ни одно животное не является также растением. Ни один фрукт не является камнем. Каждый банан является разновидностью фрукта. Каждый цветок является растением. Некоторый гранит входит в категорию камней. Верно, что всё, что является розой, является цветком. Следовательно, из этого вытекает, что некоторый гранит не является растениями.
syllogism_orig: There are no rocks that can be classified as plants. There are no animals that are also plants. There are no fruits that are rocks. Every single banana is a type of fruit. Every single flower is a plant. Some granite is included in the category of rocks. It is true that anything that is a rose is a flower. Consequently, it follows that some granite is not plants.

syllogism: Existem alguns lápis que também são instrumentos de escrita. Todos os chaves de fenda são também ferramentas. Tudo o que é uma ferramenta é um objeto. Nenhum lápis é uma caneta. Não existe nenhum prego que seja um martelo. Tudo o que é um martelo é uma ferramenta. Todo martelo é uma ferramenta. Segue-se disto que todo prego é uma ferramenta.
syllogism_orig: There are some pencils which are also writing tools. All screwdrivers are also tools. Every single thing that is a tool is an object. Not a single pencil is a pen. There are no nails that are hammers. Every single thing that is a hammer is a tool. Every single hammer is a tool. It follows from this that every nail is a tool.

syllogism: Ни одна собака не является человеком. Некоторые собаки могут быть классифицированы как млекопитающие. Каждый человек является существом, имеющим глаза. Некоторые живые существа не являются млекопитающими. Также верно, что ни одна кошка не является представителем псовых. По крайней мере некоторые собаки имеют глаза.
syllogism_orig: It is the case that no dog is a human. A subset of dogs can be classified as mammals. Every human is a being that has eyes. It is the case that some living creatures are not mammals. It is also true that no cats are canines. At least some dogs have eyes.

syllogism: Каждый роман является планетой. Каждая планета является вещью, сделанной из сыра. Звёзды и газовые гиганты не имеют абсолютно ничего общего. Ни одна планета не является книгой. Ни одна Земля не является небесным телом. Ничто, являющееся журналом, не является книгой. Из этого с необходимостью следует, что ни одна книга не является романом.
syllogism_orig: Every single novel is a planet. Every single planet is a thing made of cheese. Stars and gas giants have no overlap whatsoever. No planet is a book. Not a single Earth is a celestial body. Nothing that is a magazine is a book. It is a necessary conclusion that no book is a novel.

syllogism_orig: It is true that no car is a boat. Every single car is a vehicle. It is true that all cars are vehicles. There are no vehicles that are made of metal. There are some scooters which are not vehicles. This means that no car is made of metal.

syllogism_orig: There are no items that are not plants that are plants. A certain number of oaks are trees. Every single tree is a type of plant. It is known that some oaks are trees. syllogism: ప్రతి వంటగది ఒక గది. కళాకారులలో కొంత మంది చిత్రకారులు. ప్రతి ఒక్క వైద్యుడు మానవుడు అనేది నిశ్చయం. ఫర్నిచర్‌గా వర్గీకరించబడిన కొన్ని వస్తువులు కుర్చీలు కావు. ప్రతి వంటగది వంట చేయడానికి ఒక స్థలం. దీని నుండి కొన్ని వంట చేయడానికి ఉన్న స్థలాలు గదులు అని తేలుతుంది.

syllogism_orig: There are no cars that are oceans. Every single gas is a fluid. Anything that is a liquid is a fluid. It is the case that no liquid is a solid. Stars and gas giants have no overlap whatsoever. Anything that is water is a liquid. This means that all gases are liquids.

syllogism_orig: All things that are fish are vertebrates. There are no creatures with feathers which are also insects. Every single insect is an arthropod. syllogism_orig: Some of the dogs are mammals. It is true that all felines are carnivores. There are a number of dogs that are animals. There are no dogs that are reptiles. Every single mammal is a cat. Every cat is an animal. It follows from this that every single dog is a cat.

syllogism_orig: A portion of healthy foods are vegetables. There are no fruits which are vegetables. Anything that is a fruit is a food that contains seeds. Some foods are, without a doubt, fruits. There is no planet that is a food. Therefore, every single food contains rocks.

syllogism_orig: There are oaks that are trees. It is also true that some plants are flowers. Anything that is a rose is a flower. Anything that is an oak is a plant. There are no animals that are also plants. There are no plants that are fish. It must follow that every single tree is a plant.

syllogism_orig: Anything that is a father is a mother. Fathers are in no way humans. Every human is an animal that is a primate. Of the people who are children, some of them are humans. There are no humans that are not made of glass. There are all humans which are primates. There are some mothers that are not humans.

Из этого можно заключить, что ни одна вода не является жидкостью.
syllogism_orig: All things that are glaciers are ice. Every single liquid is a fluid. There are no cars that are clouds. Every piece of furniture that is a chair is made of liquid. It is impossible for any water to be a fluid. Everything that is a song is also a mountain. Nothing that is a liquid is H2O. It can be concluded that no water is a liquid.

syllogism_orig: It is not true that any table is a couch. A few numbers that are odd are also divisible by two. Lamps are not things that are furniture. There are no numbers that are tables. It is impossible for furniture to be a chair. It is the case that some couches are numbers.

syllogism_orig: Every single idea is a thought. There are some ideas that are made of cheese. Things that are thoughts are not electrical signals in the brain. Every single idea is an emotion. Therefore, some ideas are not electrical signals in the brain.

syllogism_orig: Each and every book is a paper good. There are no cars that are houses. No cutlery items are books. No books are buildings. Some things made of paper are books. Every single fiction book is a story. From this, it is concluded that some buildings are made of paper.

Every single garment is an article of clothing. There are no shirts that are also pants. Therefore, we can conclude that a few jackets are shirts.

syllogism_orig: Anything that is a penguin is also a bird. Anything that is a cat is an animal. A creature that is a reptile is never a mammal. Every single dog is an animal. No dog is a reptile. It follows that a few cats are dogs.

syllogism: Достоверно известно, что каждый врач является человеком. Всё, что является учёным, является тем, кто учится. Всё, что является инженером, также является профессионалом. Из этого мы можем логически заключить, что некоторые исследователи не являются инженерами.
syllogism_orig: It is a certainty that every single doctor is a human being. Anything that is a scientist is a person who studies. Anything that is an engineer is also a professional. Among the group of people who are doctors, some are researchers. No person who is a doctor is also a teacher. Not a single person who is a doctor is also an engineer. Anything that is a human is a husband. From this, we can logically conclude that there are some researchers who are not engineers.

syllogism: Sehemu ya viti ni meza. Si kweli hata kidogo kwamba watu ambao ni wanafunzi ni vitu visivyo na uhai. Kila kitu ambacho ni kiumbe hai ni kitu chenye uzito. Kila kitu ambacho ni chombo ni kitu. Kuna vitu ambavyo ni metali ambavyo si dhahabu. Hakuna vitu ambavyo ni samani. Kila meza ni kitu. Kwa hivyo hakuna meza inayoweza kuwa samani.

Every single thing that is a tool is an object. There are some objects that are metals that are not gold. There are no objects that are furniture. Each and every table is an object. syllogism: ప్రతి ఒక్క కుక్క ఒక పెంపుడు జంతువు. ఎగిరే వాహనాలు మరియు కుక్కజాతి జంతువులు అయిన జంతువులు ఏవీ లేవు. ఏ కుక్క పక్షి కాదు. అన్ని ఎగిరే వాహనాలు కుక్కలు. ఏ కుక్క పిల్లిజాతి జంతువు కాదు అనేది నిజం. సరీసృపాలు అయిన కుక్కలు ఏవీ లేవు. క్షీరదాలు ఏవీ కుక్కలు కావు అనేది కూడా నిజం. కుక్కలలో ఒక భాగం కుక్కజాతి జంతువులు కావు అనేది తప్పనిసరిగా నిజం.
syllogism_orig: Every single dog is a domestic animal. There are no animals that are flying vehicles and are also canines. No dog is a bird. All flying vehicles are dogs. It is true that no dog is a feline. There are no dogs that are reptiles. It is also true that no mammals are dogs. It is necessarily true that a portion of dogs is not canines.

syllogism: 所有植物都需要阳光。存在一些蔬菜会生长。所有花都是植物。任何玫瑰都是植物。每一种蔬菜都是植物。每一种植物都是生物。所有树木按定义都是植物。由此可得，没有一种植物是蔬菜。
syllogism_orig: All plants are in need of sunlight. There exist vegetables that grow. It is true that all flowers are plants. Anything that is a rose is a plant. Every single vegetable is a plant. Every plant is a living thing. All trees are, by definition, plants. It follows that not a single plant is a vegetable.

syllogism: Il n'est pas vrai qu'un océan quelconque soit un continent. Toute chose qui est un océan nommé Pacifique est un océan. Le Canada n'est pas un continent. Le groupe des continents et le groupe des pays sont mutuellement exclusifs. Par conséquent, le Canada est un pays.
syllogism_orig: It is not true that any ocean is a continent. Every single thing that is an ocean named Pacific is an ocean. Canada is not a continent. The group of continents and the group of countries are mutually exclusive. Therefore, Canada is a country.

syllogism: Ci sono ragni che sono aracnidi. È un fatto che alcuni animali non sono insetti. Ci sono alcune persone che non sono insetti. Un insetto non è mai un aracnide. Ogni singola formica è un insetto. Ogni passero è un uccello. L'unica conclusione da trarre è che alcuni ragni non sono insetti.
syllogism_orig: There are spiders that are arachnids. It is a fact that some animals are not insects. There are some people who are not insects. An insect is never an arachnid. Every single ant is an insect. Every sparrow is a bird. The only conclusion to draw is that some spiders are not insects.

syllogism: Geen gebouwen bevinden zich binnen de groep van planten. Alle rozen zijn ook planten. Alles wat een roos is, is een plant. De categorie bomen bestaat volledig uit planten. Het is waar dat alle rozen bloemen zijn. Gebouwen en bomen zijn volledig gescheiden categorieën.
syllogism_orig: No buildings are found within the group of plants. Any and all roses are also plants. Anything that is a rose is a plant. The category of trees is entirely made up of plants. It is true that all roses are flowers. Buildings and trees are completely separate categories.

syllogism: Tra i cani, ce ne sono alcuni che sono carnivori. Ogni singolo cane è un organismo vivente. Una parte delle cose che sono uccelli hanno piume. Nessun edificio è un cane. Ci sono animali domestici che sono mammiferi. Qualsiasi cosa sia un gatto è un felino. Tutti i cani appartengono alla classe dei mammiferi. Di conseguenza, tra la classe dei mammiferi, alcuni sono carnivori.

There are pets which are mammals. Anything that is a cat is a feline. All dogs belong to the class of mammals. Consequently, among the class of mammals, some are carnivores.

syllogism_orig: There are no instances where flowers can be considered trees. Everything that is a tree is a plant. There are some oaks that are not musical instruments. syllogism_orig: Any creature that is an animal is a bird. All airplains are, without exception, birds. There is not a single bird that is a reptile. No animal that is a reptile is a mammal. Every single thing that is a bat is a flying creature. This logically means that no reptile is an animal.

syllogism_orig: Every single dog is a mammal. There are no dogs that are fish. There are some cats that are not pets. Anything that is a dog is a mammal. There are no dogs that are reptiles. syllogism_orig: Nothing that is a plastic is a metal. Every single piece of gold is a precious substance. Gold is always classified as a metal. No plastic is gold. It follows that no plastic is a precious substance.

syllogism_orig: Every single animal is a living thing. There are no fish that are land animals. Some of the mammals are carnivores. Everything that is a human is also a living thing. No animals that are primates are also fish. Consequently, every human is an animal.

syllogism: প্রতিটি মাছ গাছে বাস করে। এটা সত্য যে কোনো মাছ সমুদ্রে বাস করে না। কিছু সি বাস আছে যারা গাছে বাস করে না। মাছ আছে, এবং তাদের মধ্যে কিছু স্যামন। এর ভিত্তিতে, এটা অবশ্যই সত্য যে একটি নির্দিষ্ট পরিমাণ স্যামন সমুদ্রে বাস করে না।
syllogism_orig: It is the case that every fish lives in a tree. It is true that no fish live in the sea. There exist some sea basses which do not live in trees. There are fish, and some of them are salmons. Based on this, it must be the case that a certain amount of salmons do not live in the sea.

syllogism: Todos los loros están clasificados como aves. Es el caso que ningún ave es un pez. Una porción de las arañas son consideradas arácnidos. Hay algunos animales que son gorriones. Todo loro tiene un pico. Algunas criaturas que pueden volar son aves. Es imposible que una araña sea un ave. Es necesariamente el caso que algunos arácnidos no son aves.
syllogism_orig: All parrots are classified as birds. It is the case that no bird is a fish. A portion of spiders are considered arachnids. There are some animals that are sparrows. Every parrot has a beak. Some creatures that can fly are birds. It is impossible for a spider to be a bird. It is necessarily the case that some arachnids are not birds.

syllogism: చెట్లు అయిన అన్ని వస్తువులు జీవులు. జీవి అయిన ప్రతిదీ ఒక ప్రాణి. మొక్కలు ఏ విధంగానూ జీవులు కావు. ఏదైనా ఒకే సమయంలో జీవి మరియు ప్రాణి అయి ఉండటం అసాధ్యం. మొక్కలు ఏ విధంగానూ జీవులు కావు. చెట్లను మొక్కలుగా వర్గీకరించలేము.
syllogism_orig: All things that are trees are living organisms. Everything that is a living thing is a creature. Plants are in no way living organisms. It is impossible for something to be an organism and a creature at the same time. Plants are in no way living things. Trees cannot be classified as plants.

syllogism: Nessuna cosa che è una macchina è un animale. Qualsiasi cosa che è un pesce è un animale. È noto che una parte delle automobili sono macchine. Non esistono automobili che sono case. Nessun animale che è un cane è un uccello. Alcune delle cose che sono veicoli sono automobili. Il gruppo delle autovetture include alcune che sono automobili. Pertanto, deve essere vero che alcune automobili sono animali.
syllogism_orig: Not a single thing that is a machine is an animal. Anything that is a fish is an animal. It is known that a portion of cars are machines. There are no cars that are houses. No animal that is a dog is a bird. Some of the things that are vehicles are cars. The group of automobiles includes some that are cars. Thus, it must be true that some cars are animals.

syllogism: Каждый поезд является планетой. Существуют планеты, которые являются звёздами. Существуют спутники, которые являются планетами. Ни один мост не является небесным телом. Всё, что является спутником, является луной. Из этого следует, что все планеты являются лунами.
syllogism_orig: It is the case that every single train is a planet. There are some planets that are stars. There are satellites that are planets. It is impossible for a bridge to be a celestial body. Anything and everything that is a satellite is a moon. It must follow that all planets are moons.

syllogism: Ninguna fruta de la pasión es un producto horneado. Cualquier cosa que sea una manzana es una nube. Toda verdura es una nube. Toda manzana es una fruta. No hay frutas que sean rocas. Cualquier objeto que sea una papa es una verdura. De esto se deduce que todas las frutas son nubes.
syllogism_orig: Not one passion fruit is a baked good. Anything that is an apple is a cloud. Every vegetable is a cloud. Every single apple is a fruit. There are no fruits that are rocks. Any object that is a potato is a vegetable. It follows from this that all fruits are clouds.

syllogism: যেগুলো চড়ুই, তাদের মধ্যে কিছু প্রাণী। যা কিছু কুকুর তা প্রাণী। এমন কোনো পালকযুক্ত প্রাণী নেই যা পোকামাকড়ও বটে। যা কিছু পাখি তা প্রাণী নয়। যা কিছু কুকুর তা প্রাণীও বটে। এটি অবশ্যই সত্য যে কিছু চড়ুই পাখি নয়।
syllogism_orig: Of the items that are sparrows, some are animals. Everything that is a dog is an animal. There are no creatures with feathers which are also insects. Anything that is a bird is not an animal. Anything that is a dog is also an animal. It must be the case that some sparrows are not birds.

syllogism: Nessun leone è considerato un pesce. Non esistono rettili che siano anche mammiferi. Ci sono alcuni mammiferi che possono volare. Ogni singolo uccello è un mammifero. Non esistono pesci che siano mammiferi. Alcuni leoni non sono mammiferi.
syllogism_orig: No lions are considered fish. There are no reptiles which are also mammals. There are some mammals that can fly. Every single bird is a mammal. There are no fish which are mammals. Some lions are not mammals.

syllogism: স্তন্যপায়ী প্রাণীদের একটি উপসমষ্টি নারীদের নিয়ে গঠিত। এমন নয় যে প্রতিটি মানুষ একজন পুরুষ। প্রতিটি পুরুষ একজন মরণশীল। সকল পুরুষই মানুষ। প্রতিটি মানব একটি মরণশীল প্রাণী। যারা শিশু তাদের মধ্যে কেউ কেউ মানুষ। ফলস্বরূপ, সকল মরণশীলই মানুষ।
syllogism_orig: A subset of mammals is composed of women. It is not the case that every huma is a man. Every single man is a mortal. There are all men that are humans. Every single human being is a mortal creature. Of the people who are children, some of them are humans. As a result, all mortals are humans.

syllogism: প্রতিটি সিংহ একটি প্রাণী। কিছু চড়াইকে পাখি হিসেবে বর্ণনা করা যায়। প্রতিটি চড়াই এক ধরনের প্রাণী। কিছু প্রাণী স্তন্যপায়ী। যা কিছু চড়াই তা সবই পাখি। এমন কোনো প্রাণী নেই যা সবজি। কিছু উড়তে সক্ষম প্রাণী পাখি। অতএব, একটি নির্দিষ্ট সংখ্যক পাখি প্রাণী।
syllogism_orig: Every single lion is an animal. Some sparrows can be described as birds. Every sparrow is a type of animal. Some animals are mammals. All things that are sparrows are birds. There are no animals that are vegetables. Some creatures that can fly are birds. Therefore, a certain number of birds are animals.

syllogism: Unter den Lebewesen, die Tiere sind, sind einige Säugetiere. Einige Tiere, die Reptilien sind, sind keine Amphibien. Es gibt keine Säugetiere, die Reptilien sind. Es gibt keine Hunde, die Reptilien sind. Jeder Hund ist ein Säugetier. Es ist bekannt, dass ein Teil der Krokodile Reptilien sind. Kein Hund ist ein Reptil. Daraus können wir ableiten, dass einige Krokodile keine Amphibien sind.
syllogism_orig: Among the creatures that are animals, some are mammals. Some animal that is a reptile is not an amphibian. There are no mammals which are reptiles. There are no dogs that are reptiles. Every dog is a mammal. It is known that a portion of crocodiles are reptiles. No dog is a reptile. From this, we can deduce that some crocodiles are not amphibians.

syllogism: প্রতিটি জিনিস যা একটি গোলাপ তা একটি ফুলও। গাছের একটি অংশ উদ্ভিদের মধ্যে পাওয়া যায়। প্রতিটি জিনিস যা একটি গোলাপ তা একটি কাঁটাযুক্ত উদ্ভিদও। কোনো উদ্ভিদই স্তন্যপায়ী নয়। এমন কোনো জিনিস নেই যা উদ্ভিদ নয় অথচ উদ্ভিদ। সুতরাং, এমন কোনো গাছ নেই যা স্তন্যপায়ীও।
syllogism_orig: Every item that is a rose is also a flower. A portion of trees are to be found among the plants. Every item that is a rose is also a plant with thorns. Nothing that is a plant is a mammal. There are no items that are not plants that are plants. Thus, there are no trees that are also mammals.

syllogism: Ninguna cuchara es un tenedor. Algunas sillas resultan ser cosas que están hechas de madera. Todos los muebles son artículos que se encuentran en un hogar. No hay ninguna máquina que sea una silla. Todas las cosas que son gatos son felinos. No hay ninguna mesa que sea un escritorio. Por lo tanto, algunas cosas hechas de madera no son máquinas.
syllogism_orig: No spoons are forks. A few chairs happen to be things that are made of wood. All furniture are items found in a household. There is no machine that is a chair. All things that are cats are felines. There is no table that is a desk. Therefore, some things made of wood are not machines.

syllogism: Существо, которое является рептилией, никогда не является млекопитающим. Часть людей, которые являются людьми, также являются детьми. Всё, что является облаком, состоит из камня. Каждый человек является облаком. Также верно, что каждое млекопитающее является облаком. Все существующие облака являются Землёй. Это доказывает, что все млекопитающие являются людьми.
syllogism_orig: A creature that is a reptile is never a mammal. A portion of the people who are humans are also children. Anything which is a cloud is made of rock. Every single human is a cloud. It is also true that every mammal is a cloud. All clouds in existence are Earth. This proves that all mammals are humans.

syllogism: ప్రతి ఒక్క అరటిపండు ఒక రకమైన పండు. ప్రతి ఒక్క ఆపిల్ ఒక పండు. పువ్వులు కూరగాయలు కావు. ప్రతి ఒక్క క్యారెట్ ఒక కూరగాయ. ఏ పండు కూడా బంగాళాదుంప కాదు. ఏ జంతువు కూడా కూరగాయ కాదు. ఏ కూరగాయ కూడా పండు కాదు. కాబట్టి, కొన్ని బంగాళాదుంపలు కూరగాయలు కావు.
syllogism_orig: Every single banana is a type of fruit. Every single apple is a fruit. There are no flowers that are vegetables. Every single thing that is a carrot is a vegetable. It is the case that no fruit is a potato. There are no animals that are vegetables. There are no vegetables that are fruit. Therefore, some potatoes are not vegetables.

syllogism: সমস্ত গাছ, সংজ্ঞা অনুসারে, উদ্ভিদ। প্রতিটি ওক একটি গাছ। একটি নির্দিষ্ট সংখ্যক ওক গাছ। কোনো একটি উদ্ভিদও গাছ নয়। কিছু নির্বাচিত পাইন উদ্ভিদ হিসাবে শ্রেণীবদ্ধ। অতএব এটি একটি সত্য যে কিছু পাইন গাছ নয়।
syllogism_orig: All trees are, by definition, plants. Every single oak is a tree. A certain number of oaks are trees. No single plant is a tree. A select few pines are classified as plants. It is therefore a fact that some pines are not trees.

syllogism: প্রতিটি পোকা একটি মাকড়সা। এটি সত্য নয় যে কোনো পোকা আট পা বিশিষ্ট প্রাণী। এমন কোনো পালকযুক্ত প্রাণী নেই যা পোকাও বটে। এটি সত্য যে কিছু জীবন্ত প্রাণী স্তন্যপায়ী নয়। এমন কোনো প্রজাপতি নেই যা স্তন্যপায়ী। এর থেকে অনুমিত হয় যে প্রতিটি মাকড়সা আট পা বিশিষ্ট প্রাণী।
syllogism_orig: Every insect is a spider. It is not true that any insect is a creature with eight legs. There are no creatures with feathers which are also insects. It is the case that some living creatures are not mammals. There are no butterflies that are mammals. It follows that every spider is a creature with eight legs.

syllogism: Kila mamalia ni mnyama. Miongoni mwa viumbe ambao ni mbwa, kundi fulani ni retrieva. Sehemu ya wanyama wenye damu ya joto ni mamalia. Kiumbe ambaye ni mbwa kamwe si mamalia. Hakuna jengo ambalo ni mbwa. Ni kweli kwamba hakuna mbwa ambaye ni samaki. Kuna paka ambao pia ni mamalia. Kutokana na haya tunaweza kuhitimisha kwamba baadhi ya retrieva si mamalia.
syllogism_orig: Every single mammal is an animal. Among the creatures that are dogs, a group are retrievers. A portion of warm-blooded animals are mammals. A creature that is a dog is never a mammal. No building is a dog. It is the case that no dog is a fish. There exist cats that are also mammals. One can infer from this that some retrievers are not mammals.

syllogism: Nenhum animal é um lagarto. Alguns animais aquáticos podem ser considerados peixes. Existem alguns répteis que são animais. Nenhum animal que é um cão é uma ave. Todo e qualquer cobra é um réptil. Portanto, é o caso que todas as cobras são animais.
syllogism_orig: There are no animals which are lizards. Some aquatic animals can be considered fish. There are some reptile that are animals. No animal that is a dog is a bird. Every single snake is a reptile. It is therefore the case that all snakes are animals.

syllogism: Alle succesvolle mensen zijn degenen die rijk kunnen zijn. Onder degenen die studenten zijn, zijn er sommigen die atleten zijn. Sommige studenten zijn harde werkers. Ieder persoon is een mens. Er zijn geen harde werkers die ook luie mensen zijn. Iedere student is een persoon die tijd besteedt aan studeren. Er wordt geconcludeerd dat sommige studenten luie mensen zijn.
syllogism_orig: All successful people are those who can be rich. Among those who are students, there are some who are athletes. Some students are hard workers. Every single person is a human. There are no hard workers who are also lazy people. Every single student is a person who spends time studying. It is concluded that some students are lazy people.

syllogism: Ci sono politici che sono umani. Una parte degli animali a sangue caldo sono mammiferi. Non ci sono pesci che sono animali. Non ci sono gatti che sono pesci. Alcuni animali acquatici sono cose che sono uccelli. Ne consegue che alcuni animali sono gatti.
syllogism_orig: There are politicians who are human. A portion of warm-blooded animals are mammals. There are no fish which are animals. There are no cats which are fish. Some aquatic animals are things that are birds. It follows that some animals are cats.

syllogism: పక్షి అయిన ప్రతిదీ జంతువు. పక్షి అయిన ప్రతిదీ రెక్కల జీవి అనేది నిజం. పక్షులు అయిన కీటకాలు ఏవీ లేవు. వైద్యుడు అయిన ఏదైనా మానవుడు కూడా. పక్షులు కీటకాలు కావు అనేది నిజం. కొన్ని జీవులు క్షీరదాలు కావు అనేది వాస్తవం. చేపలు కాని కొన్ని ఏనుగులు ఉన్నాయి. దీని నుండి రాబట్టగల నిర్ణయం ఏమిటంటే రెక్కల జీవులు అయిన కీటకాలు ఉన్నాయి.
syllogism_orig: Everything that is a bird is an animal. It is true that everything which is a bird is a winged creature. There are no insects which are birds. Anything that is a doctor is also a human. It is true that no birds are insects. It is the case that some living creatures are not mammals. There are some elephants that are not fish. A conclusion that can be drawn from this is that there are insects which are winged creatures.

syllogism: Toda pessoa que é bióloga é uma cientista. Não é o caso que toda pessoa tenha sangue. Toda pessoa é um mamífero. Toda pessoa que é cozinheira profissional é uma pessoa que sabe cozinhar. Tudo que é uma pessoa é um organismo. Pode-se, portanto, concluir que alguns mamíferos não têm sangue.
syllogism_orig: Every single person who is a biologist is a scientist. It is not the case that every single person has blood. Every person is a mammal. Every person who is a professional cook is a person who can cook. Anything that is a person is an organism. One can therefore conclude that some mammals do not have blood.

syllogism: Ci sono alcuni cani che sono mammiferi. Qualsiasi cosa sia un mammifero è a sangue caldo. Non ci sono cani che sono pesci. Esistono gatti che sono anche mammiferi. Ogni cane è un mammifero. Tutte le cose che sono gatti sono felini. Tutti i gatti sono anche mammiferi. Pertanto, deve essere che alcuni gatti non sono cani.
syllogism_orig: There are some dogs that are mammals. Anything that is a mammal is warm-blooded. There are no dogs that are fish. There exist cats that are also mammals. Every dog is a mammal. All things that are cats are felines. All cats are also mammals. Therefore, it must be that some cats are not dogs.

syllogism: Alle dingen die vissen zijn, zijn gewervelde dieren. Sommige walvissen worden beschouwd als dieren die in de oceaan leven. Elk dier dat een landdier is, is geen walvis. Het is een feit dat sommige dieren geen insecten zijn. Elk zoogdier is een dier. Het is het geval dat sommige dieren die in de oceaan leven, geen landdieren zijn.
syllogism_orig: All things that are fish are vertebrates. Some whales are considered animals that live in the ocean. Any animal that is a land animal is not a whale. It is a fact that some animals are not insects. Every single mammal is an animal. It is the case that some animals living in the ocean are not land animals.

syllogism: Все люди являются млекопитающими. Каждый человек — это разновидность млекопитающего. Каждая обезьяна является приматом. Каждый человек, который является приматом, является млекопитающим. Ни одно животное, являющееся приматом, не является также рыбой. Следовательно, каждый человек является приматом.
syllogism_orig: All humans are mammals. Every human is a kind of mammal. Every monkey is a primate. Every person who is a primate is a mammal. No animals that are primates are also fish. Consequently, every single human is a primate.

syllogism: Certains vêtements sont des chemises. Les chapeaux et les vestes ne se chevauchent pas. C'est un fait que toutes les chemises sont des habits. Chaque chemise est un vêtement. Il n'existe aucune chemise qui soit un légume. Cela implique que chaque vêtement est un légume.
syllogism_orig: Some clothing is shirts. Hats and jackets do not overlap. It is a fact that all shirts are garments. Every single shirt is a piece of clothing. There are no shirts which are vegetables. This implies that every piece of clothing is a vegetable.

syllogism: ప్రతి ఒక్క చీమ ఒక కీటకం. కొన్ని కీటకాలు భృంగాలు. చీమ అయిన ప్రతిదీ ఒక కీటకం. ప్రతి భృంగం ఒక ఆర్థ్రోపాడ్. కీటకాల వర్గం మరియు సింహాల వర్గం అతిపాతం కావు. ఫలితంగా, కొన్ని ఆర్థ్రోపాడ్‌లు కీటకాలు.
syllogism_orig: Every single ant is an insect. A few of the insects are beetles. Anything that is an ant is an insect. Every beetle is an arthropod. The class of insects and the class of lions do not overlap. As a result, some arthropods are insects.

syllogism: కుక్క అయిన ప్రతిదీ జంతువు. మేఘం అయిన ప్రతిదీ జంతువు. క్షీరదాలు అయినవి సరీసృపాలు కావు. ప్రతి ఒక్క కుక్క క్షీరదం. భూమిపై నివసించని జంతువులు లేవు. ప్రతి ఒక్క రాయి మేఘం అనేది నిజం. కాబట్టి, కొన్ని జంతువులు రాళ్ళు.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a dog is an animal. Anything that is a cloud is an animal. There are no mammals which are reptiles. Every single dog is a mammal. There are no animals that do not live on land. It is the case that every single stone is a cloud. Therefore, a few animals are stones.

syllogism: Sommige fruchten zijn fietsen. Elk item dat een vis is, is een plant. Elke plant is voedsel. Het is ook waar dat geen vissen planten zijn. Elk item dat een roos is, is ook een plant met doornen. Alles wat een vrucht is, is voedsel. Hieruit volgt dat elke vrucht een plant is.
syllogism_orig: Some fruits are bicycles. Every item that is a fish is a plant. Every single plant is food. It is also true that no fish are plants. Every item that is a rose is also a plant with thorns. Everything that is a fruit is food. It follows that every fruit is a plant.

syllogism: 所有胡萝卜都不是甜椒。一部分蔬菜也是胡萝卜。任何蔬菜都不是植物。有些蔬菜是甜椒。有些胡萝卜是蔬菜。因此，有些胡萝卜不是植物这一结论是不可避免的。
syllogism_orig: None of the items that are carrots are bell peppers. A portion of the things that are vegetables are also carrots. Anything that is a vegetable is not a plant. There are vegetables that are bell peppers. There are some carrots that are vegetables. The conclusion that some carrots are not plants is inescapable.

syllogism: Todo gato é uma criatura invisível. Aves não são de forma alguma criaturas aladas. Não há cães que sejam animais. Nada que seja um animal de sangue frio é também um réptil. Alguns gatos são animais. Consequentemente, uma parte dos animais são invisíveis.
syllogism_orig: Every cat is an invisible creature. Birds are in no way winged creatures. There are no dogs which are animals. Nothing that is a cold-blooded animal is also a reptile. A number of cats are animals. Consequently, a portion of animals are invisible.

syllogism: Las flores no son de ninguna manera organismos. Cada manzana es una fruta. No hay nada que sea una verdura que también sea una fruta. Algunos zapatos son frutas. Todos los árboles son, por definición, plantas. Todas las plantas necesitan luz solar. Cada fruta crece en una planta. Se puede deducir que algunas cosas que crecen en plantas son zapatos.
syllogism_orig: Flowers are in no way organisms. Every single apple is a fruit. There is nothing that is a vegetable that is also a fruit. A few shoes are fruits. All trees are, by definition, plants. All plants are in need of sunlight. Every single fruit grows on a plant. It can be deduced that some things that grow on plants are shoes.

syllogism: Ein Teil der Pinguinpopulation sind Vögel. Einige Wassertiere sind Dinge, die Vögel sind. Alles, was ein Vogel ist, ist ein Tier. Alles, was ein Pinguin ist, ist auch ein Vogel. Es ist der Fall, dass kein Vogel ein Reptil ist. Daraus folgt, dass einige Pinguine aus der Gruppe der Reptilien ausgeschlossen sind.
syllogism_orig: A portion of the penguin population are birds. Some aquatic animals are things that are birds. Anything that is a bird is an animal. Anything that is a penguin is also a bird. It is the case that no bird is a reptile. Thus, some penguins are excluded from the group of reptiles.

syllogism: 凡是鸟都是动物。凡是鸟都是动物。同样，没有爬行动物是动物。没有水果是岩石。每一只鸟都是哺乳动物。没有鸟是岩石。存在一些鸟是鱼。因此，可以推断出有些岩石是动物。
syllogism_orig: Anything which is a bird is an animal. Anything that is a bird is an animal. It is also true that no reptiles are animals. There are no fruits that are rocks. Every single bird is a mammal. No birds are rocks. There exist some birds that are fish. Therefore, It is possible to infer that some rocks are animals.

syllogism: প্রতিটি গাছ একটি উদ্ভিদ। বিগল নামে পরিচিত কিছু প্রাণী কুকুর। যেকোনো কিছু যা গোলাপ তা একটি উদ্ভিদ। কিছু প্রাণী আছে যারা চড়ুই। বেশ কিছু জিনিস যা উদ্ভিদ নয় তা গাছ। এমন কোনো গাছ নেই যা প্রাণীও বটে। এটি সত্য যে কিছু উদ্ভিদ প্রাণী নয়।
syllogism_orig: Every single tree is a plant. Some of the animals known as beagles are dogs. Anything that is a rose is a plant. There are some animals that are sparrows. A number of items that are not plants are trees. There are no trees that are also animals. It is the case that some plants fail to be animals.

syllogism: সব মাছ পাখি। এমন কোনো পালকযুক্ত প্রাণী নেই যা একই সাথে পোকামাকড়। যা কিছু পাখি তা প্রাণী। যা কিছু পাখি তা মেরুদণ্ডী। এটি সত্য যে কোনো পাখি জলজ নয়। এর থেকে অনুমিত হয় যে কোনো জলজ জিনিস মাছ নয়।
syllogism_orig: All fish are birds. There are no creatures with feathers which are also insects. Anything that is a bird is an animal. Anything that is a bird is a vertebrate. It is true that no bird is aquatic. It follows that no aquatic thing is a fish.

syllogism: Todas las personas que son doctores son aquellas que tienen formación médica. No hay personas con formación médica que sean maestros. Ninguna persona que es doctor es también maestro. Cada pediatra es un doctor. Cada estudiante es una persona que dedica tiempo a estudiar. Cada doctor es un profesional. Ningún estudiante es profesional. Esto significa que nadie que sea maestro es doctor.
syllogism_orig: All people who are doctors are those who have medical training. There are no people with medical training who are teachers. No person who is a doctor is also a teacher. Every single pediatrician is a doctor. Every single student is a person who spends time studying. Every single doctor is a professional. No students are professionals. This means that no one who is a teacher is a doctor.

syllogism: Hay algunos peces que son mamíferos. Existen algunos mamíferos que tienen pelaje. No existe tal cosa como un animal de sangre caliente que sea un pez. Ningún animal que sea mamífero puede ser considerado pez. Hay algunos elefantes que son mamíferos. Esto lleva a la conclusión de que algunos peces son elefantes.
syllogism_orig: There are some fish which are mammals. There exist some mammals that have fur. There is no such thing as a warm-blooded animal that is a fish. No animals that are mammals can be considered fish. There are some elephants which are mammals. This leads to the conclusion that some fish are elephants.

syllogism: Hakuna magari ambayo ni pikipiki. Kila gari ni motokaa. Kila baiskeli ni kitu chenye magurudumu. Hakuna motokaa ambayo inaweza kuainishwa kama baiskeli. Chochote ambacho ni gari ni chombo cha usafiri. Baadhi ya pikipiki si magari. Hii ina maana kwamba hakuna gari linaweza kuwa baiskeli.
syllogism_orig: There are no cars which are motorcycles. Every single car is an automobile. Every bicycle is an item that has wheels. There is no automobile that can be classified as a bicycle. Anything that is a car is a vehicle. Some motorcycles are not cars. This means that no car can be a bicycle.

syllogism: Non esiste un singolo oggetto che sia un'auto e anche un camion. Qualsiasi cosa sia un aereo è un veicolo. Non esiste nulla che sia un mobile e che sia un aereo. Ogni singolo mobile è un bene domestico. Qualsiasi cosa sia un'auto è un oggetto che si muove. Di conseguenza, nessun mobile è un veicolo.
syllogism_orig: There is not a single item that is a car and also a truck. Anything that is a plane is a vehicle. There is nothing that is an item of furniture which is a plane. Every single item of furniture is a household good. Anything that is a car is an object that moves. Consequently, no piece of furniture is a vehicle.

syllogism: Kuna wanyama wa kufugwa ambao ni mamalia. Sehemu ya vitu ambavyo ni wanyama wa kufugwa si mamalia. Kuna paka wengine ambao si wanyama wa kufugwa. Watoto wa mbwa wachache hufugwa kama wanyama wa kufugwa. Kitu chochote ambacho ni mtoto wa mbwa ni chenye sumu. Hii inamaanisha kwamba idadi fulani ya wanyama wa kufugwa ni wenye sumu.
syllogism_orig: There are pets which are mammals. A portion of the things that are pets are not mammals. There are some cats that are not pets. A few puppies are kept as pets. Anything that is a puppy is venomous. This implies that a certain number of pets are venomous.

syllogism: Er zijn enkele posters die geen boeken zijn. Niets dat een fictieboek is, is een biografie. Sommige romans vallen onder de categorie fictieboeken. Elk fictieboek is een verhaal. Alle fantasyschrijvers zijn auteurs van fantasyromans. Geen bestekitems zijn boeken. Dit stelt ons in staat te stellen dat sommige romans geen biografieën zijn.
syllogism_orig: There are some posters that are not books. Nothing that is a fiction book is a biography. Some novels fall under the category of fiction books. Every single fiction book is a story. All fantasy novelists are authors of fantasy novels. No cutlery items are books. This allows us to state that some novels are not biographies.

syllogism: Il est vrai que certaines choses qui sont des arbres n'ont pas de racines. Un certain nombre de chaises sont des personnes. Tout ce qui est un arbre est fait de bois. Chaque chaise est faite de bois. Tout meuble qui est une chaise est fait de liquide. Aucune table n'est une chaise. Il est le cas que chaque poisson vit dans un arbre. Il en est nécessairement conclu que chaque chaise est un arbre.
syllogism_orig: It is true that some things that are trees do not have roots. A number of chairs are people. Anything that is a tree is made of wood. Every single chair is made of wood. Every piece of furniture that is a chair is made of liquid. There are no tables that are chairs. It is the case that every fish lives in a tree. It is necessarily concluded that every chair is a tree.

syllogism: Alguns gatos não são cães. Todo carnívoro é um animal. Todo mamífero é um animal. Todo cão é um mamífero. Nenhum animal que voa é também um peixe. Todo cão é um animal. Humanos não são de forma alguma animais. Podemos inferir que alguns gatos não são animais.
syllogism_orig: Some cats are not dogs. Every single carnivore is an animal. Every single mammal is an animal. Every single dog is a mammal. There are no animals that fly which are also fish. Every single thing which is a dog is an animal. Humans are in no way animals. We can infer that some cats are not animals.

syllogism: No hay reptiles que también sean mamíferos. No hay reptiles que sean humanos. También es cierto que ninguna hormiga es un reptil. Algunos animales son mamíferos. Entre las criaturas que son animales, algunas son mamíferos. Cada serpiente es un reptil. Absolutamente nada que sea un reptil es un mamífero. De esto se sigue que ninguna hormiga es un humano.
syllogism_orig: There are no reptiles which are also mammals. There are no reptiles that are humans. It is also true that no ant is a reptile. Some animals are mammals. Among the creatures that are animals, some are mammals. Every single snake is a reptile. Absolutely nothing that is a reptile is a mammal. It follows that no ant is a human.

syllogism: Tutto ciò che è un gatto è un animale. Non esistono animali che siano rose. Ci sono alcuni animali che sono gatti. L'insieme degli animali non contiene esseri viventi. Una parte degli animali a sangue caldo sono mammiferi. È il caso che alcuni gatti non siano fatti di vetro. Ogni singolo mammifero è un essere vivente. Nessun mammifero è un animale.
syllogism_orig: Everything that is a cat is an animal. There are no animals that are roses. There are some animals which are cats. The set of animals contains no living things. A portion of warm-blooded animals are mammals. It is the case that some cats are not made of glass. Every single mammal is a living thing. Not a single mammal is an animal.

syllogism: Todo águia é um pássaro. Nenhuma águia é um mamífero. Nenhum animal voador é um pinguim. Todo pardal é um pássaro. Alguns pássaros são papagaios. Nenhuma borboleta é um mamífero. Implica-se que alguns pássaros não são mamíferos.
syllogism_orig: Every single eagle is a bird. There are no eagles that are mammals. It is the case that no flying animal is a penguin. Every sparrow is a bird. Some birds are parrots. There are no butterflies that are mammals. It is implied that some birds are not mammals.

syllogism: Alle senatoren zijn levende organismen. Elke persoon die een premier is, is een politicus. Er zijn geen politici die leugenaars zijn. Het is het geval dat alle professionals volwassenen zijn. De verzameling eerlijke mensen en de verzameling leugenaars sluiten elkaar wederzijds uit. Allen die politici zijn, zijn ook menselijke wezens. Alle politici zijn eerlijke mensen.
syllogism_orig: All senators are living organisms. Every person who is a prime minister is a politician. There are no politicians who are liars. It is the case that all professionals are adults. The set of honest people and the set of liars are mutually exclusive. All of those who are politicians are also human beings. All politicians are honest people.

syllogism: Chaque chien est un animal. Aucun humain n'est un animal aquatique. Une partie des animaux à sang chaud sont des mammifères. Aucun zèbre n'est un canidé. Il est un fait que certains animaux ne sont pas des insectes. Il est le cas qu'un certain zèbre est un animal.
