syllogism_orig: Every single dog is an animal. Not a single human is an aquatic animal. A portion of warm-blooded animals are mammals. There are no zebras which are canines. It is a fact that some animals are not insects. It is the case that some zebra is an animal.

syllogism: 所有猫都是动物。所有狗都是动物。所有鸽子无一例外都是鸟。所有动物都是哺乳动物。所有麻雀都是鸟。所有鸟都是动物。因此，所有哺乳动物必定都是动物。
syllogism_orig: Everything that is a cat is an animal. Every single dog is an animal. Anything that is a pigeon is, without exception, a bird. Everything that is an animal is a mammal. All things that are sparrows are birds. Every single thing that is a bird is an animal. It must therefore be true that every mammal is an animal.

syllogism: Idadi fulani ya simba ni wanyama wanaokula nyama. Kila mmea ni mamalia. Ni kweli kwamba kila kitu ambacho ni mnyama ni mamalia. Kila kiumbe ambacho ni ndege pia ni mnyama anayeruka. Kuna baadhi ya wanyama wa shambani ambao ni nguruwe. Kila kiumbe ambacho ni nguruwe kina uwezo wa kuruka. Kwa hivyo, sehemu ya wanyama wa shambani wanaweza kuruka.
syllogism_orig: A certain number of lions are carnivores. Every single plant is a mammal. It is true that everything that is an animal is a mammal. Every creature that is a bird is also a flying animal. There are some farm animals which are pigs. Every single creature that is a pig is capable of flight. Therefore, a portion of farm animals can fly.

syllogism: Sommige leeuwen zijn zoogdieren. Er zijn enkele honden die zoogdieren zijn. Elke katachtige is een kat. Elk item dat een zoogdier is, is een dier. Alles wat een pinguïn is, is ook een vogel. Daarom kan van alle leeuwen gezegd worden dat het dieren zijn.
syllogism_orig: Some lions are mammals. There are some dogs that are mammals. Every single feline is a cat. Every item that is a mammal is an animal. Anything that is a penguin is also a bird. Therefore, all lions can be said to be animals.

syllogism: সমস্ত মানুষ প্রাইমেট। প্রতিটি জিনিস যা স্তন্যপায়ী তা একটি প্রাণী। পেঙ্গুইনগুলির মধ্যে একটিও উড়ন্ত পাখি নয়। কোনো মাছ পাখি নয়। কোনো স্তন্যপায়ী পাখি নয়। এটি সত্য যে কিছু প্রাণী পাখি নয়।
syllogism_orig: There are all humans which are primates. Every single thing that is a mammal is an animal. Not a single one of the things that are penguins is a flying bird. There are no fish that are birds. There are no mammals that are birds. It is the case that some animals fail to be birds.

syllogism: ప్రతి చెప్పు ఒక రకమైన పాదరక్ష. ఉపాధ్యాయుడైన ప్రతిదీ ఒక వృత్తి. భవనాలైన ఇళ్ళు ఏవీ లేవు. దుస్తులైన పాదరక్షలు ఏవీ లేవు. మానవుడైన ప్రతిదీ ఒక క్షీరదం. ప్రతి ఒక్క కీటకం ఒక చిన్న జీవి. టెలిపోర్ట్ చేయలేని చెట్లు ఏవీ లేవు. చెప్పు ఏదీ దుస్తులు కాదు అని నిర్ణయించవచ్చు.
syllogism_orig: Every shoe is a type of footwear. Anything that is a teacher is a profession. There are no houses that are buildings. There are no footwear items that are clothing. Anything that is a human is a mammal. Every single insect is a tiny creature. There are no trees that cannot teleport. It can be concluded that no shoe is clothing.

syllogism: Vitu vyote ambavyo ni jiji linaloitwa London ni miji. Kila mji mkuu unachukuliwa kuwa jiji kuu. Hakuna miji ambayo ni nchi. Sehemu ya miji mikuu iko Ulaya. Ni kweli bila shaka kwamba baadhi ya miji inayoitwa London si nchi.
syllogism_orig: All things that are a city named London are cities. Every capital city is considered a major city. No cities are countries. A portion of capital cities are located in Europe. It is necessarily true that some cities named London are not countries.

syllogism: Jeder einzelne Gegenstand, der Geld ist, ist keine Währung. Es ist nicht wahr, dass jeder Schreibwarenartikel zum Schreiben verwendet werden kann. Von den Gegenständen, die Farbtöne sind, ist ein Teil von ihnen rot. Alles, was ein Fahrzeug ist, ist ein magischer Gegenstand. Alle Bleistifte sind Schreibwarenartikel. Daraus folgt, dass kein Bleistift zum Schreiben verwendet werden kann.
syllogism_orig: Every single item that is money is not currency. It is not true that any stationery item can be used for writing. Of the items that are hues, a portion of them are red. Everything that is a vehicle is a magical item. All pencils are items of stationery. Therefore, no pencil is able to be used for writing.

syllogism: పాట అయిన ప్రతిదీ పర్వతం కూడా. నీరు అంతా H2O. సముద్రాలు అయిన నదులు ఏవీ లేవు. ప్రతి ఒక్క ద్రవం ఒక ద్రవపదార్థం. కొంత నీరు ఘనపదార్థం కాదు అనేది నిజం. ద్రవం అయినది ఏదీ H2O కాదు. ద్రవంగా ఉన్న కొన్ని జలాశయాలు ఉన్నాయి. నీరు ఏ విధంగానూ ద్రవపదార్థం కాదు.
syllogism_orig: Everything that is a song is also a mountain. All water is H2O. There are no rivers that are oceans. Every single liquid is a fluid. It is the case that some water is not a solid. Nothing that is a liquid is H2O. There are some water bodies which are liquid. Water is in no way a fluid.

syllogism: Kuna kikundi cha wanafunzi ambao pia ni vijana. Chochote kinachoweza kuitwa mwanafunzi, bila ubaguzi, ni binadamu. Kuna vijana ambao pia ni wanafunzi. Pia ni kweli kwamba hakuna vijiko ambavyo ni magari. Hakuna mashine ambazo pia ni binadamu. Hakuna wanafunzi ambao ni mashine.
syllogism_orig: There exists a group of students who are also teenagers. Anything that can be called a student is, without exception, a human. There are teenagers that are also students. It is also true that no spoons are vehicles. There exist no machines that are also humans. No students are machines.

syllogism: Alle woorden zijn getallen die door twee gedeeld kunnen worden. Er zijn geen getallen die als mensen beschreven kunnen worden. Elk mens is een sterfelijk wezen. Alles wat een dokter is, is een buitenaards wezen. Elk object dat een levend wezen is, is een object met massa. Elke sterveling is een getal. Hieruit volgt dat sommige mensen niet sterfelijk zijn.
syllogism_orig: All words are numbers that can be divided by two. There are no numbers that can be described as humans. Every single human being is a mortal creature. Anything that is a doctor is an alien. Every object that is a living thing is an object with mass. Every single mortal is a number. Based on this, some humans are not mortal.

syllogism: కూరగాయ అయినది పండు కూడా అయినది ఏదీ లేదు. పండ్లు అని పిలువబడే సమూహంలో కొన్ని నిమ్మజాతి పండ్లు ఉన్నాయి. కూరగాయలు అయిన పండ్లు ఏవీ లేవు. ఆపిల్ అయినది ఏదైనా నిమ్మజాతి పండు కాదు. క్యారెట్ అయిన ప్రతి ఒక్కటి కూరగాయ. రాళ్ళు అయిన పండ్లు ఏవీ లేవు. దీని ఫలితంగా కొన్ని పండ్లు ఆపిల్స్ కావు.
syllogism_orig: There is nothing that is a vegetable that is also a fruit. The group of items known as fruits has some members that are citrus fruits. There are no fruits which are vegetables. Anything that is an apple is not a citrus fruit. Every single thing that is a carrot is a vegetable. There are no fruits that are rocks. The result of this is that some fruits are not apples.

syllogism: Es verdad que ningún pájaro es un insecto. Todo sacerdote es una persona. No hay doctores que no sean personas con títulos médicos. Todas las personas exitosas son aquellas que pueden ser ricas. Todos los sacerdotes son humanos. De esto se deduce que todo humano es una persona.
syllogism_orig: It is true that no birds are insects. Every single priest is a person. There are no doctors who are not people with medical degrees. All successful people are those who can be rich. All priests are human. It follows from this that every human is a person.

syllogism: Tout ce qui est une feuille est vert. Tout ce qui est un chat est un animal. Une partie des passionnés de fitness sont des coureurs. Chaque légume est vert. Une chose qui est une table n'est jamais une chaise. Il en est nécessairement conclu que chaque feuille est un légume.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a leaf is green. Anything that is a cat is an animal. A portion of fitness enthusiasts are runners. Every single vegetable is green. A thing that is a table is never a chair. It is necessarily concluded that every leaf is a vegetable.

syllogism: Er zijn geen vruchten die stenen zijn. Het is ook waar dat elke appel een vrucht is. Elke appel is een vrucht. Elke appel is een voedingsmiddel. Er is niets dat een groente is dat ook een vrucht is. Dit betekent dat alle vruchten voedingsmiddelen zijn.
syllogism_orig: There are no fruits that are rocks. It is also true that every apple is a fruit. Every single apple is a fruit. Every single apple is a food. There is nothing that is a vegetable that is also a fruit. This means that all fruits are foods.

syllogism: No es cierto que algún árbol sea verde. Todo lo que es una bicicleta es un vehículo de dos ruedas. Todo coche tiene ruedas. Hay algunos coches que no son un líquido. No hay ni un solo coche que sea un árbol. En consecuencia, no hay ningún coche que sea verde.
syllogism_orig: It is not true that any tree is green. Everything that is a bicycle is a two-wheeled vehicle. Every single car has wheels. There are some cars that are not a liquid. There is not a single car that is a tree. Consequently, there is no car that is green.

syllogism: Cada sedán es un vehículo. No es cierto que algún automóvil sea un tren. Cualquier cosa con un motor de combustión interna necesita combustible. Es el caso que ningún automóvil es un bote. Algunos automóviles poseen un motor de combustión interna. Cualquier cosa que sea un automóvil es un vehículo. Cada bicicleta es un objeto que tiene ruedas. Esto significa que todos los sedanes son automóviles.
syllogism_orig: Every single sedan is a vehicle. It is not true that any car is a train. Anything with an internal combustion engine needs fuel. It is the case that no cars are boats. Some cars possess an internal combustion engine. Anything that is a car is a vehicle. Every bicycle is an item that has wheels. This means that all sedans are cars.

syllogism: Kila papa ni kiumbe cha majini. Kuna samaki wachache ambao pia ni viumbe vinavyoishi majini. Kitu chochote ambacho ni nyangumi si samaki. Kila binadamu si samaki. Miongoni mwa viumbe ambavyo ni wanyama, baadhi ni mamalia. Si viumbe vyote vinavyoishi majini ni binadamu.
syllogism_orig: Every single shark is an aquatic creature. There are a few fish that are also creatures that live in water. Anything that is a whale is not a fish. Every single human is not a fish. Among the creatures that are animals, some are mammals. It is the case that not all creatures that live in water are humans.

syllogism: Aucun humain n'est un insecte. Il existe au moins quelques étudiants qui ne sont pas des humains. Aucun extraterrestre n'est un humain. Pas un seul humain n'est un animal aquatique. Il existe un groupe d'étudiants qui sont aussi des adolescents. Toutes les machines sont des humains. Au moins un étudiant est une machine.
syllogism_orig: There are no humans who are insects. There are at least a few students who are not humans. There are no aliens who are humans. Not a single human is an aquatic animal. There exists a group of students who are also teenagers. All machines are humans. At least one student is a machine.

syllogism: Alle zalmen zijn vissen. Er zijn enkele vissen die zalmen zijn die in zoet water leven. Er zijn geen vissen die vogels zijn. Elke haai is een waterdier. Een aantal haaien wordt geclassificeerd als vis. Daarom zijn sommige vissen zoetwatervissen.
syllogism_orig: All salmon are fish. There are some fish that are salmon that live in fresh water. There are no fish that are birds. Every single shark is an aquatic creature. A number of sharks are classified as fish. Therefore, some fish are fresh water fish.

syllogism: Er zijn geen rivieren die oceanen zijn. Elke berg genaamd Everest is een berg. Bergen kunnen geen oceanen zijn. Elk ding dat een oceaan genaamd Pacific is, is een oceaan. Elke rivier is een waterlichaam. Het is niet waar dat enige oceaan een continent is. Het moet zo zijn dat sommige bergen genaamd Everest geen oceanen zijn.
syllogism_orig: There are no rivers that are oceans. Every mountain named Everest is a mountain. Mountains cannot be oceans. Every single thing that is an ocean named Pacific is an ocean. Every single river is a body of water. It is not true that any ocean is a continent. It must be that some mountains named Everest are not oceans.

syllogism: যা কিছু গাড়ি তা সবই যানবাহন। সকল সেডান গাড়ি। অভ্যন্তরীণ দহন ইঞ্জিনযুক্ত যেকোনো কিছুর জ্বালানি প্রয়োজন। প্রতিটি বস্তু যা টেবিল তা এক ধরনের আসবাবপত্র। এমন কোনো আসবাবপত্র নেই যা গাড়ি। প্রতিটি গাড়ি একটি যানবাহন। এটি সত্য যে কোনো গাড়ি নৌকা নয়। এ থেকে আমাদের এই সিদ্ধান্তে আসতে হবে যে কিছু গাড়ি টেবিল নয়।
syllogism_orig: All things that are cars are vehicles. All sedans are cars. Anything with an internal combustion engine needs fuel. Every object that is a table is a type of furniture. There exist no pieces of furniture that are cars. Every car is a vehicle. It is the case that no cars are boats. From this, we must conclude that some cars are not tables.

syllogism: Ci sono alcune carote che sono verdure. Ci sono verdure che sono peperoni. Esistono alcune carote che non sono frutti. Non c'è nulla che sia una verdura che sia anche un frutto. Non ci sono frutti che siano verdure. Ogni singola uva è un frutto. Deve essere che alcune carote non sono uve.
syllogism_orig: There are some carrots that are vegetables. There are vegetables that are bell peppers. There exist some carrots that are not fruits. There is nothing that is a vegetable that is also a fruit. There are no fruits which are vegetables. Every single grape is a fruit. It must be that some carrots are not grapes.

syllogism: Também é o caso que nenhum gás é um sólido. Todo líquido é uma molécula. Nenhum líquido é um sólido. Todo gás é uma molécula. Algumas estrelas são sóis. Sóis são, sem exceção, bolas gigantes de gás. Nenhuma bola gigante de gás é uma estrela. Nenhuma estrela pode ser considerada um sol.
syllogism_orig: It is also the case that no gas is a solid. Every single liquid is a molecule. It is the case that no liquid is a solid. Every single gas is a molecule. A few stars are suns. Suns are, without exception, giant balls of gas. No giant balls of gas are stars. No star can be considered a sun.

syllogism: L'insieme dei frigoriferi e l'insieme dei mobili non hanno nulla in comune. Tutti gli oggetti che sono divani sono mobili. Almeno un robot non è un mortale. L'insieme degli esseri umani è un sottoinsieme dell'insieme dei mortali. C'è almeno un robot che non è un essere umano.
syllogism_orig: The set of refrigerators and the set of pieces of furniture have nothing in common. All items that are sofas are pieces of furniture. At least one robot is not a mortal. The set of humans is a subset of the set of mortals. There is at least one robot who is not a human.

syllogism: చేపలు అయిన మొక్కలు ఏవీ లేవు. క్యారెట్ అయిన ప్రతిదీ కూరగాయ. ప్రతి ఒక్క కూరగాయ మొక్క. మొక్కలు కాని వస్తువులు మొక్కలు అయినవి ఏవీ లేవు. గులాబీలు అయిన జంతువులు ఏవీ లేవు. కూరగాయలు అయిన పువ్వులు ఏవీ లేవు. అన్ని గులాబీలు పువ్వులు అనేది నిజం. కాబట్టి, అన్ని క్యారెట్లు మొక్కలు.
syllogism_orig: There are no plants that are fish. Anything that is a carrot is a vegetable. Every single vegetable is a plant. There are no items that are not plants that are plants. There are no animals that are roses. There are no flowers that are vegetables. It is true that all roses are flowers. Therefore, all carrots are plants.

syllogism: నదులు అయిన కొన్ని వస్తువులు ఉన్నాయి, అవి సముద్రాలు కావు. నది అయిన ప్రతిదీ జలాశయం. ప్రతి నక్షత్రం ఒక ఖగోళ వస్తువు. నక్షత్రాలు అయిన కొన్ని గ్రహాలు ఉన్నాయి. ఖగోళ వస్తువు ఎప్పుడూ ఫర్నీచర్ ముక్క కాదు. దీని తార్కిక పరిణామం ఏమిటంటే కొన్ని జలాశయాలు సముద్రాలు కావు.
syllogism_orig: There exist some things which are rivers, that are not oceans. Anything that is a river is a body of water. Each and every star is a celestial body. There are some planets that are stars. A celestial body is never a piece of furniture. A logical consequence of this is that some bodies of water are not oceans.

syllogism: Alles wat een kat is, is een dier. Elke kitten is een kat. Alles wat een katachtige is, is een zoogdier. Er zijn huisdieren die zoogdieren zijn. Geen enkel wezen dat een kat is, is een dier. Er bestaan enkele katachtigen die ook huisdieren zijn. Er zijn geen katten die katachtigen zijn. Dus er zijn geen katten die zoogdieren zijn.
syllogism_orig: Everything that is a cat is an animal. Every single kitten is a cat. Anything that is a feline is a mammal. There are pets which are mammals. Any creature that is a cat is not an animal. There exist some felines that are also pets. There are no cats that are felines. Thus, there are no cats that are mammals.

syllogism: Hakuna jengo ambalo ni mbwa. Shule chache zimeainishwa kama majengo. Ni kweli kwamba kila kitu ambacho ni mbwa ni mamalia. Kila nyumba ni jengo. Kila gari ni chombo cha usafiri. Hakuna nyumba hata moja ambayo ni uwanja wa michezo. Kwa hivyo, si shule zote ni nyumba.
syllogism_orig: No building is a dog. A few schools are classified as buildings. It is the case that everything which is a dog is a mammal. Every single house is a building. Every car is a vehicle. Not a single house is a stadium. As a result, not all schools are houses.

syllogism: 并非所有汽车都是火车。有些摩托车不是汽车。有些车辆是机器。没有任何机动车辆是汽车。没有任何机动车辆是自行车。有些车辆是汽车。没有任何汽车是摩托车。因此，没有任何汽车是自行车。
syllogism_orig: It is not true that any car is a train. Some motorcycles are not cars. It is true that some vehicles are machines. It is also true that no motorized vehicle is a car. Not a single motorized vehicle is a bicycle. Some vehicles are cars. There are no cars which are motorcycles. It follows that no car is a bicycle.

syllogism: De volledige verzameling auto's bestaat uit mussen. Sommige auto's zijn vissen. De klasse van vogels en de klasse van auto's overlappen niet. Elk wezen dat als vogel wordt geïdentificeerd, is een wezen met veren. Sommige auto's bezitten een verbrandingsmotor. Het is een logisch gevolg dat sommige mussen geen vogels zijn.
syllogism_orig: The entire set of cars is composed of sparrows. Some cars are fish. The class of birds and the class of cars do not overlap. Every single creature identified as a bird is a creature with feathers. Some cars possess an internal combustion engine. It is a logical consequence that some sparrows are not birds.

syllogism: Es gibt keine Haie, die auch Hunde sind. Einige der Haie sind Fische. Jeder einzelne Fleischfresser ist ein Tier. Jeder einzelne Hai ist ein Wasserlebewesen. Es gibt kein Säugetier, das ein Hai ist. Daraus folgt, dass einige Fische keine Säugetiere sind.
syllogism_orig: There are no sharks which are also dogs. Some of the sharks are fish. Every single carnivore is an animal. Every single shark is an aquatic creature. There is no mammal that is a shark. Therefore, some fish are not mammals.

syllogism: Ningún artículo de cubertería es un libro. No hay libros que estén hechos de papel. No hay ningún libro que sea un dispositivo electrónico. Toda novela es un libro. No hay ni un solo libro de bolsillo que sea un libro. Todo libro de ficción es una historia. Se sigue, entonces, que algunos libros de bolsillo no están hechos de papel.
syllogism_orig: No cutlery items are books. There are no books that are made of paper. There is no book that is an electronic device. Every novel is a book. There is not a single paperback that is a book. Every single fiction book is a story. It follows, then, that some paperbacks are not made of paper.

syllogism: సరీసృపాలైన అన్ని వస్తువులు సకశేరుకాలు. కొన్ని పాములు సరీసృపాలుగా తెలిసినవి. బొచ్చు కలిగిన కొన్ని క్షీరదాలు ఉన్నాయి. సరీసృపమైన ఏ ఒక్క వస్తువు కూడా క్షీరదం కాదు. కొన్ని పాములు ఒక రకమైన సరీసృపం. ప్రతి సరీసృపానికి బొచ్చు ఉంటుందనేది నిజం. కాబట్టి, కొన్ని పాములకు బొచ్చు ఉంటుందని మనం నిర్ధారించవచ్చు.
syllogism_orig: All things that are reptiles are vertebrates. Some snakes are known to be reptiles. There exist some mammals that have fur. Not a single thing that is a reptile is a mammal. A few snakes are a type of reptile. It is true that every reptile has fur. Therefore, we can conclude that some snakes have fur.

syllogism: Каждая жидкость является мокрой. Ни одна жидкость не является твёрдым телом. Не существует жидкостей, которые не являются твёрдыми телами. Всё, что является единицей времени, является жидкостью. Известно, что ни один песок не является жидкостью. Не существует газов, которые также являются жидкостями. Ничто, что является жидкостью, не является твёрдым телом. Следовательно, не существует вещей, состоящих из песка, которые являются мокрыми.
syllogism_orig: Every single liquid is wet. Not a single liquid is a solid. There are no liquids that are not solid. Anything that is a unit of time is a liquid. It is known that no sand is a liquid. There are no gases which are also liquids. Nothing that is a liquid is a solid. Consequently, there are no things made of sand which are wet.

syllogism: Het is waar dat elke hond een dier is. Er bestaan geen poedels die ook katten zijn. Alles wat een vogel is, is een dier. Elke kat is een katachtige. Er zijn huisdieren die zoogdieren zijn. Elke kat is een hond. Alle huisdieren zijn ook dieren. Daarom zijn sommige huisdieren geen honden.
syllogism_orig: It is true that any dog is an animal. There exist no poodles that are also cats. Everything that is a bird is an animal. Every single cat is a feline. There are pets which are mammals. Every single cat is a dog. All pets are animals too. Therefore, some pets are not dogs.

syllogism: Jedes einzelne Ding, das ein Auto ist, ist ein Gegenstand mit Rädern. Alles, was ein Fahrrad ist, ist auch ein Fahrzeug. Die Gruppe der Automobile umfasst einige, die Autos sind. Alles, was ein Auto ist, ist ein Fahrzeug. Es ist auch wahr, dass alle Möbel Gegenstände sind. Jedes einzelne Auto ist ein Musikinstrument. Nichts, was ein Fahrzeug ist, ist ein Gegenstand mit Rädern. Dies beweist, dass eine Reihe von Autos keine Fahrzeuge sind.
syllogism_orig: Every single item that is a car is an object with wheels. Anything that is a bicycle is also a vehicle. The group of automobiles includes some that are cars. Anything that is a car is a vehicle. It is also true that all furniture are objects. Every single car is a musical instrument. Nothing that is a vehicle is an object with wheels. This proves that a number of cars are not vehicles.

syllogism: Einige Fahrzeuge sind Autos. Die gesamte Kategorie der Autos besteht aus Selbstfahrzeugen. Die Menge der Automobile und die Menge der Selbstfahrzeuge sind vollständig voneinander getrennt. Jedes einzelne Auto ist ein Musikinstrument. Eine Teilmenge der Fahrzeuge besteht aus Lastwagen. Alle Limousinen sind Autos. Automobile sind keine Autos.
syllogism_orig: Some vehicles are cars. The entire category of cars is composed of self-propelled vehicles. The set of automobiles and the set of self-propelled vehicles are entirely separate. Every single car is a musical instrument. A subset of vehicles consists of trucks. All sedans are cars. Automobiles are not cars.

syllogism: Não há nada que seja um vegetal que também seja uma fruta. Todos os planetas são aulas de canto. Pelo menos uma coisa que é um gigante gasoso é um planeta. Toda e qualquer coisa que é secretamente um robô é um ser vivo. Qualquer coisa que seja um planeta é secretamente um robô. A partir desses fatos, é claro que alguns seres vivos são planetas.
syllogism_orig: There is nothing that is a vegetable that is also a fruit. All planets are singing lessons. At least one thing that is a gas giant is a planet. Every single thing that is secretly a robot is a living thing. Anything that is a planet is secretly a robot. From these facts, it is clear that a few living things are planets.

syllogism: Il est également vrai qu'aucune pomme n'est un fruit. Il est le cas qu'aucun fruit n'est un légume. Il y a des carottes qui sont des légumes. Il n'est pas le cas que chaque légume soit un aliment. Il est également vrai qu'aucun chat n'est un légume. De ces énoncés, on peut conclure que certaines pommes ne sont pas des légumes.
syllogism_orig: It is also true that no apples are fruits. It is the case that no fruits are vegetables. There are some carrots that are vegetables. It is not the case that every single vegetable is a food. It is also true that no cats are vegetables. From these statements, one can conclude that some apples are not vegetables.

syllogism: ప్రతి చెంచా ఒక గ్రహం. కొన్ని ఖగోళ వస్తువులు నక్షత్రాలు. నక్షత్రం చుట్టూ తిరిగే ప్రతి వస్తువు ఒక గ్రహం. గ్రహంగా ఉన్న ప్రతి ఒక్కరూ గుండ్రంగా ఉంటారు. చంద్రుల వర్గం మరియు ఖగోళ వస్తువుల వర్గం అతిపాతం కావు. అన్ని ఖగోళ వస్తువులు గ్రహాలు. గ్రహాలలో ఒక ఉపసమితి చంద్రులు.
syllogism_orig: Every spoon is a planet. There are some celestial bodies that are stars. Every object that orbits a star is a planet. Anyone who is a planet is round. The category of moons and the category of celestial bodies do not overlap. All celestial bodies are planets. A subset of planets are moons.

syllogism: Zonder uitzondering zijn alle kinderen mensen. Een deel van de mensen die mensen zijn, zijn ook kinderen. Alles wat een persoon is, is van hout gemaakt. Het is waar dat alle natuurkundigen wetenschappers zijn. De gehele groep objecten die kunnen denken is een deelverzameling van mensen. Elke persoon die bibliothecaris is, is een student. Daarom zijn er geen kinderen die niet van hout gemaakt zijn.
syllogism_orig: Without exception, all children are people. A portion of the people who are humans are also children. Anything that is a person is made of wood. It is true that all physicists are scientists. The entire group of objects that can think is a subset of people. Every single person who is a librarian is a student. Therefore, there are no children who are not made of wood.

syllogism: Il est vrai qu'aucun oiseau n'est un poisson. Tout ce qui est un poisson est un animal. Chaque ver est un oiseau. Tout ce qui est un oiseau est un animal. Tout ce qui est un solide est aussi un animal. Il y a des politiciens qui sont des humains. Tout ce qui est un zèbre est un animal. Tous les oiseaux sont des zèbres.
syllogism_orig: It is true that no birds are fish. Anything that is a fish is an animal. Every worm is a bird. Anything that is a bird is an animal. Anything that is a solid is also an animal. There are politicians who are human. Everything that is a zebra is an animal. All birds are zebras.

syllogism: 任何学者都是博学之人。每一个图书馆员都是学生。每一个首相都是政治家。在学生当中，有一些是运动员。每一个教授都是学者。所有物理学家都是科学家，这是事实。没有人既是音乐家又是非艺术性的人。因此，一些博学之人是教授。
syllogism_orig: Any academic is a knowledgeable person. Every single person who is a librarian is a student. Every person who is a prime minister is a politician. Among those who are students, there are some who are athletes. Every single person who is a professor is an academic. It is true that all physicists are scientists. There is no person who is both a musician and a non-artistic person. Therefore, some knowledgeable people are professors.

syllogism: Hakuna vimiminika ambavyo si vigumu. Maji yote yanaweza kumiminiwa. Kuna vitu ambavyo ni maji ambavyo si vimiminika. Chochote ambacho ni mnyama ni kiumbe hai. Hakuna kiumbe wa majini anayeweza kupumua chini ya maji. Vitu vyote ambavyo ni bahari vimetengenezwa kwa hariri. Kwa hivyo, vitu vingine ambavyo vinaweza kumiminiwa si vimiminika.
syllogism_orig: There are no liquids that are not solid. All water can be poured. There exist some things which are water which are not liquids. Anything that is an animal is a living thing. There is no such thing as a water creature that is able to breathe underwater. All things which are oceans are made of silk. It follows that some things that can be poured are not liquids.

syllogism: Всё, что является планетой, является также небесным телом. Небесное тело никогда не является предметом мебели. Существуют некоторые небесные тела, которые являются звёздами. Всё, что является планетой, считается небесным телом. Не существует рек, которые являются океанами. Существуют некоторые планеты, которые являются звёздами. Не существует лун, которые также являются планетами. Некоторые небесные тела не являются лунами.
syllogism_orig: Everything that is a planet is also a celestial body. A celestial body is never a piece of furniture. There are some celestial bodies that are stars. Anything that is a planet is considered a celestial body. There are no rivers that are oceans. There are some planets that are stars. There are no moons that are also planets. Some celestial bodies are not moons.

syllogism: Kila simba ni mamalia. Kila kifaru ni mamalia. Kundi la wadudu na kundi la simba haviingiliani. Pia ni kweli kwamba kila simba ni mamalia. Kila simba ni mnyama. Ni kweli kwamba baadhi ya simba si vifaru.
syllogism_orig: Every single lion is a mammal. Every single rhino is a mammal. The class of insects and the class of lions do not overlap. It is also true that every lion is a mammal. Every single lion is an animal. It is the case that some lions are not rhinos.

syllogism: Es gibt eine Gruppe von Wissenschaftlern, die auch Physiker sind. Es ist auch wahr, dass einige Fachleute Menschen sind. Es gibt einige Wissenschaftler, die Ingenieure sind. Es gibt keinen Physiker, der nicht eine Person ist. Kein Arzt ist ein Anwalt. Es ist wahr, dass alle Physiker Wissenschaftler sind. Es ist eine bekannte Tatsache, dass einige Wissenschaftler auch Ärzte sind. Daraus wird nahegelegt, dass einige Ärzte Ingenieure sind.
syllogism_orig: There exists a group of scientists who are also physicists. It is also true that a few professionals are human beings. There are some scientists who are engineers. There is no physicist who is not a person. No doctor is a lawyer. It is true that all physicists are scientists. It is a known fact that some scientists are also doctors. From this, it is suggested that some doctors are engineers.

syllogism: Todo lo que es un gato es un felino. Algunos de los mamíferos son carnívoros. Es verdad que todos los felinos son carnívoros. Ninguna gacela es un carnívoro. Todo animal que es un león es un carnívoro. Todo ser humano es un mamífero. Es imposible que una gacela sea un león.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a cat is a feline. Some of the mammals are carnivores. It is true that all felines are carnivores. No gazelle is a carnivore. Any animal that is a lion is a carnivore. Every single human being is a mammal. It is impossible for a gazelle to be a lion.

syllogism: Todo lo que es un coche es una nube sintiente. No hay bicicletas que sean coches. Es verdad que todas las flores son plantas. Todas las nubes sintientes son plantas. Una parte de los vehículos son coches. No hay animales que también sean plantas. Esto significa que algunas plantas son coches.
syllogism_orig: Everything that is a car is a sentient cloud. There are no bicycles that are cars. It is true that all flowers are plants. All sentient clouds are plants. A portion of vehicles are cars. There are no animals that are also plants. This means that some plants are cars.

syllogism: Tout ce qui est une salamandre est une planète. Au moins une chose qui est un cercle est un triangle. Toutes les planètes sont des choses dans le ciel. Aucun corps céleste n'est une chose dans le ciel. Toutes les choses qui sont des moineaux sont des oiseaux. L'implication est qu'un certain nombre de planètes ne sont pas des corps célestes.
syllogism_orig: Everything that is a salamander is a planet. At least one thing that is a circle is a triangle. All planets are things in the sky. There is no celestial body that is a thing in the sky. All things that are sparrows are birds. The implication is that a number of planets are not celestial bodies.

syllogism: Kila samaki ni mnyama. Kitu fulani ambacho ni mnyama si mamalia. Miongoni mwa viumbe ambao ni wanyama, baadhi ni mamalia. Sehemu ya mbwa wanaweza kuainishwa kama mamalia. Baadhi ya mbwa ni mamalia. Kwa hivyo, mbwa wote wanaweza kusemwa kuwa ni wanyama.
syllogism_orig: Every single fish is an animal. Some item that is an animal is not a mammal. Among the creatures that are animals, some are mammals. A subset of dogs can be classified as mammals. Some dogs are mammals. Therefore, all dogs can be said to be animals.

syllogism: Kein Tier ist ein Lebewesen. Unter den Kolibris sind einige keine Vögel. Es ist nicht der Fall, dass Tiere keine Vögel sind. Tiere sind vollständig von Lebewesen mit Schnäbeln und Federn getrennt. Jeder einzelne Fisch ist ein Tier. Es gilt auch, dass kein Gas ein Feststoff ist. Es muss der Fall sein, dass kein einziger Kolibri ein Tier ist.
syllogism_orig: There is no animal that is a living creature. Of the items that are hummingbirds, some are non-birds. It is not the case that animals are non-birds. Animals are entirely separate from creatures with beaks and feathers. Every single fish is an animal. It is also the case that no gas is a solid. It must be the case that every single hummingbird is not an animal.

syllogism: Toda cidade é uma localização. Uma parte das capitais está localizada na Europa. Toda capital é considerada uma cidade importante. Tudo que é uma localização é uma capital. Portanto, toda capital é uma cidade.
syllogism_orig: Every city is a location. A portion of capital cities are located in Europe. Every capital city is considered a major city. Anything that is a location is a capital city. Therefore, every capital city is a city.

syllogism: কিছু বিড়াল স্তন্যপায়ীও বটে। ডলফিনের সমষ্টিতে কোনো বিড়াল নেই। কোনো কুকুর সরীসৃপ নয়। কিছু বিড়াল স্তন্যপায়ী। প্রতিটি বিড়াল স্তন্যপায়ী। প্রতিটি ডলফিন স্তন্যপায়ী।
syllogism_orig: There exist cats that are also mammals. The set of dolphins contains no cats. There are no dogs that are reptiles. A few cats are mammals. Every cat is a mammal. Every single dolphin is a mammal.

syllogism: Ni kweli kwamba wanafizikia wote ni wanasayansi. Mtu yeyote ambaye ni msomaji ni msomi. Kuna watu ambao ni wanafunzi. Ni kweli kwamba wataalamu wote ni watu wazima. Watoto wachache ni wanafunzi. Kwa hivyo, inafuata kwamba watoto wengine ni watu.
syllogism_orig: It is true that all physicists are scientists. Anyone who is a reader is a scholar. There are people who are students. It is the case that all professionals are adults. A few children are students. It follows, then, that some children are people.

syllogism: Tous ceux qui sont des politiciens sont aussi des êtres humains. Chaque personne est un être humain. Il existe une personne qui est à la fois politicien et avocat. Il y a des personnes qui ne sont pas des insectes. Il y a certains dirigeants qui sont des politiciens. Le groupe des sénateurs comprend des personnes qui sont des avocats. La conséquence est que certains sénateurs sont des politiciens.
syllogism_orig: All of those who are politicians are also human beings. Every single person is a human. There is a person who is both a politician and a lawyer. There are some people who are not insects. There are certain leaders who are politicians. The group of senators includes people who are lawyers. The consequence is that some senators are politicians.

syllogism: Не существует предметов, которые не являются растениями, которые являются растениями. Мебель — это вещи, которые никоим образом не являются предметами для сидения. Не существует стульев, которые не являются мебелью. Вся мебель — это предметы, находящиеся в домашнем хозяйстве. Всё, что является книгой, является предметом с печатными страницами. Письменные произведения никоим образом не являются предметами с печатными страницами. Часть транспортных средств — это автомобили. Книги не являются письменными произведениями.
syllogism_orig: There are no items that are not plants that are plants. Furniture are things that are in no way items for sitting. There are no chairs that are not furniture. All furniture are items found in a household. Everything that is a book is an item with printed pages. Written works are in no way items with printed pages. A portion of vehicles are cars. Books are not written works.

syllogism: Une portion des animaux sont gardés comme animaux de compagnie. Parmi les créatures qui sont des animaux, certaines sont des mammifères. Tout ce qui est un oiseau est un animal. Il n'existe aucune créature à plumes qui soit aussi un insecte. Tout ce qui est un oiseau est un vertébré. Tout ce qui est un chat est un animal. Toute créature qui est un oiseau est un animal. Certains animaux de compagnie ne sont pas des oiseaux.
syllogism_orig: A portion of animals are kept as pets. Among the creatures that are animals, some are mammals. Everything that is a bird is an animal. There are no creatures with feathers which are also insects. Anything that is a bird is a vertebrate. Everything that is a cat is an animal. Any creature that is a bird is an animal. Some pets are not birds.

syllogism: Kein Kreis ist ein Dreieck. Jedes Dreieck ist eine Form. Ein Quadrat, jedes einzelne von ihnen, ist eine geometrische Form. Jedes einzelne Dreieck ist ein Quadrat. Ein Ding, das ein Quadrat ist, kann kein Kreis sein. Daraus folgt, dass kein Kreis eine Form sein kann.
syllogism_orig: No circle is a triangle. Every triangle is a shape. A square, every single one of them, is a geometric shape. Every single triangle is a square. A thing that is a square cannot be a circle. Therefore, no circle can be a shape.

syllogism: Er zijn geen dieren die bomen zijn. Elke centaur is een gedomesticeerd dier. Absoluut niets dat een reptiel is, is een zoogdier. Er zijn enkele wezens die mythisch zijn die centauren zijn. Er zijn geen honden die dieren zijn. Bijgevolg is het zo dat sommige gedomesticeerde dieren mythische wezens zijn.
syllogism_orig: There are no animals that are trees. Every single one of the centaurs is a domesticated animal. Absolutely nothing that is a reptile is a mammal. There are some creatures that are mythical that are centaurs. There are no dogs which are animals. Consequently, it is the case that some domesticated animals are mythical creatures.

syllogism: Não existem veículos que sejam carros. Existem alguns patinetes que não são veículos. Toda e qualquer coisa que é um carro é um veículo. Qualquer coisa que é um carro não é um avião. Um subconjunto de veículos consiste em caminhões. Uma parte dos caminhões são veículos. Qualquer coisa que é um carro é um veículo. Consequentemente, todo veículo é um avião.
syllogism_orig: There are no vehicles that are cars. There are some scooters which are not vehicles. Every single thing that is a car is a vehicle. Anything that is a car is not an airplane. A subset of vehicles consists of trucks. A portion of trucks are vehicles. Anything that is a car is a vehicle. Consequently, every vehicle is an airplane.

syllogism: Jedes einzelne Insekt ist ein Säugetier. Es gibt kein Insekt, das zugleich ein Säugetier ist. Kein Hund ist ein Vogel. Alle Spinnen sind Insekten. Es ist wahr, dass kein Vogel ein Insekt ist. Dies beweist, dass alle Säugetiere Vögel sind.
syllogism_orig: Every single insect is a mammal. There is no such thing as an insect that is also a mammal. No dog is a bird. All spiders are insects. It is true that no bird is an insect. This proves that all mammals are birds.

syllogism: Nenhum animal é uma rosa. Tudo o que é uma ave é um animal. Nenhuma ave é um peixe. Tudo o que é um humano é também um primata. Tudo o que é um humano é também um animal bípede. Todos os macacos são, por definição, primatas. Nenhum animal é também uma planta. Consequentemente, alguns animais bípedes são primatas.
syllogism_orig: There are no animals that are roses. Everything that is a bird is an animal. It is the case that no bird is a fish. Everything that is a human is also a primate. Everything that is a human is also a bipedal animal. All monkeys are, by definition, primates. There are no animals that are also plants. Consequently, some bipedal animals are primates.

syllogism: Non esistono mammiferi che siano uccelli. Ogni singolo uccello non è un mammifero. Qualsiasi cosa sia un mammifero è un animale a sangue caldo. Ci sono alcuni animali che sono mammiferi. È il caso che nessun animale volante sia un pinguino. Tra gli elementi che sono cani, alcuni sono mammiferi. Ne consegue che alcuni uccelli sono animali.
syllogism_orig: There are no mammals that are birds. Every single bird is not a mammal. Anything that is a mammal is a warm-blooded animal. There are some animals that are mammals. It is the case that no flying animal is a penguin. Among the items that are dogs, some are mammals. It follows from this that some birds are animals.

syllogism: ప్రతి ఒక్క స్టేడియం ఒక భవనం. ప్రతి కారు ఒక వాహనం. ఏ భవనం కుక్క కాదు. ఇళ్ళు ఎప్పుడూ పాఠశాలలు కావు. కొన్ని పాఠశాలలు, నిజానికి, భవనాలు. భవనాలు కాని ఇళ్ళు ఉన్నాయి.
syllogism_orig: Every single stadium is a building. Every car is a vehicle. No building is a dog. Houses are never schools. A few schools are, in fact, buildings. There exist buildings that are not houses.

syllogism: Nessun animale è un minerale. Nessun pappagallo è un mammifero. Alcuni gatti sono mammiferi. Ogni singolo uccello è un animale. Nessun animale è anche una pianta. Nessun uccello è un mammifero. Non è nemmeno il caso che alcun pesce sia un mammifero. Ciò dimostra che alcuni minerali non sono uccelli.
syllogism_orig: There are no animals that are minerals. There are no parrots which are mammals. A few cats are mammals. Every single bird is an animal. There are no animals that are also plants. Every single bird is not a mammal. It is also not the case that any fish is a mammal. This proves that some minerals are not birds.

syllogism: ఏ ఈగ కూడా పక్షి కాదు. ప్రతి ఒక్క తేనెటీగ ఒక ఆర్థ్రోపాడ్. ఏ చేప కూడా కీటకం కాదు. పక్షులైన వాటిలో కొన్నింటికి ఈకలు ఉంటాయి. ఏ పక్షులు కూడా కీటకాలు కావు. కాబట్టి, కొన్ని ఈగలు కీటకాలు అని తేలుతుంది.
syllogism_orig: There is no fly that is a bird. Every single bee is an arthropod. Not a single fish is an insect. A portion of the things that are birds have feathers. There are no birds which are insects. It follows, then, that some flies are insects.

syllogism: Algunos vehículos no son coches. Ningún coche es un barco. Todo coche es un vehículo. Todo camión tiene ruedas. Todo lo que es un vehículo es un objeto mágico. Por lo tanto, todos los vehículos son barcos.
syllogism_orig: Some vehicles are not cars. No car is a boat. Every car is a vehicle. Every single thing that is a truck has wheels. Everything that is a vehicle is a magical item. Therefore, all vehicles are boats.

syllogism: Alguns pássaros são papagaios. Nenhum pássaro é um mamífero. Não há papagaios que sejam mamíferos. Todo pássaro é um animal. Alguns dos animais conhecidos como beagles são cães. Uma parte das mesas são pássaros. Isso implica que todo pássaro é um mamífero.
syllogism_orig: Some birds are parrots. Every single bird is not a mammal. There are no parrots which are mammals. Every single bird is an animal. Some of the animals known as beagles are dogs. A portion of tables are birds. This implies that every bird is a mammal.

syllogism: Vitu vyote ambavyo ni pembetatu ni maumbo ya jiometri. Kila kitu ambacho ni karoti pia ni mboga. Hakuna wanyama ambao pia ni mimea. Kila tufaha moja ni kitu kinachokua kwenye mti. Hakuna matunda ambayo ni vitu vinavyokua kwenye miti. Kwa hivyo, inaweza kusemwa kwamba baadhi ya matufaha si matunda.
syllogism_orig: All things which are triangles are geometric shapes. Everything that is a carrot is also a vegetable. There are no animals that are also plants. Every single apple is a thing that grows on a tree. There are no fruits that are things that grow on trees. Consequently, it can be said that some apples are not fruits.

syllogism: Не существует животных, которые являются одновременно хищниками и травоядными. Верно, что все кошачьи являются хищниками. Всё, что является котом, является кошачьим. Некоторые из млекопитающих являются хищниками. Определённое количество волков являются хищниками. Из этого следует, что ни один волк не является травоядным.
syllogism_orig: There are no animals that are both carnivores and herbivores. It is true that all felines are carnivores. Anything that is a cat is a feline. Some of the mammals are carnivores. A certain number of wolves are carnivores. It follows that no wolves are herbivores.

syllogism: কিছু বিড়াল আছে যারা পোষা প্রাণী নয়। যেকোনো কিছু যা পায়রা, তা ব্যতিক্রমহীনভাবে পাখি। সকল কিছু যা স্তন্যপায়ী তা মেরুদণ্ডী। এটাও সত্য যে কোনো বিড়ালই পাথর নয়। কোনো প্রাণীই পাথর নয়। অতএব, যুক্তি দেওয়া হয় যে কোনো বিড়ালই প্রাণী নয়।
syllogism_orig: There are some cats that are not pets. Anything that is a pigeon is, without exception, a bird. All things which are mammals are vertebrates. It is also true that no cats are rocks. There are no animals that are rocks. Therefore, it is argued that there are no cats which are animals.

syllogism: Chaque caniche est un canin. Tout ce qui est un chat est une créature à trois yeux. Une partie des bâtiments sont des chiens. Chaque animal est un caniche. Tout ce qui est un chien est un mammifère. Il est également vrai qu'aucun chat n'est un légume. Tout ce qui est un chat est un mammifère. De cela, on peut affirmer que certains chats sont des chiens.
syllogism_orig: Every single poodle is a canine. Anything that is a cat is a creature with three eyes. A portion of buildings are dogs. Every single animal is a poodle. Every single thing that is a dog is a mammal. It is also true that no cats are vegetables. Anything that is a cat is a mammal. From this, it can be stated that some cats are dogs.

syllogism: Ci sono alcuni pesci che sono anche umani. Non esistono pappagalli che siano mammiferi. Ci sono alcuni cani che sono mammiferi. Non è vero che alcun mammifero sia un pesce. Ogni umano è un animale che è un primate. Esistono alcuni mammiferi che hanno la pelliccia. Ci sono alcuni umani che non sono mammiferi.
syllogism_orig: There are a few fish that are also humans. There are no parrots which are mammals. There are some dogs that are mammals. It is not true that any mammal is a fish. Every human is an animal that is a primate. There exist some mammals that have fur. There are some humans that are not mammals.

syllogism: Il existe des Toyotas qui sont des voitures. Chaque voiture est, en fait, un véhicule. Tout objet qui est une voiture a un moteur. Certains véhicules motorisés sont des voitures. Tout ce qui est une voiture est un objet qui se déplace. Par conséquent, tous les véhicules motorisés ont des moteurs.
syllogism_orig: There are some Toyotas that are cars. Every single car is, in fact, a vehicle. Every object that is a car has an engine. Some motorized vehicles are cars. Anything that is a car is an object that moves. Therefore, all motorized vehicles have engines.

syllogism: Il est le cas qu'aucun objet à deux roues n'est un véhicule. Rien de ce qui est un bâtiment ne peut être considéré comme un véhicule. Chaque bicyclette a des roues. Quelques marteaux sont, en fait, des outils. Il n'existe aucune voiture qui soit une motocyclette. Un certain nombre de bicyclettes se trouvent parmi les objets à deux roues. Par conséquent, un certain nombre de bicyclettes n'appartiennent pas à la catégorie des véhicules.
syllogism_orig: It is the case that no two-wheeled item is a vehicle. Nothing that is a building can be considered a vehicle. Every single bicycle has wheels. A few hammers are, in fact, tools. There are no cars which are motorcycles. A certain number of bicycles can be found among two-wheeled items. Therefore, a number of bicycles do not belong to the category of vehicles.

syllogism: Всё, что является велосипедом, является двухколёсным транспортным средством. Верно, что ни одно здание не является транспортным средством. Ничто, что является зданием, не может считаться транспортным средством. Каждый дом, без исключения, является зданием. Всё, что является автомобилем, является транспортным средством. Следовательно, ни один дом не может быть транспортным средством.
syllogism_orig: Everything that is a bicycle is a two-wheeled vehicle. It is true that no building is a vehicle. Nothing that is a building can be considered a vehicle. Each house, without exception, is a building. Anything that is a car is a vehicle. Therefore, no houses can be vehicles.

syllogism: Alle Dinge, die Frösche sind, sind Amphibien. Kein einziges Amphibium ist ein Reptil. Es gibt keine Reptilien, die auch Säugetiere sind. Reptilien sind eine Tierklasse, die keine Amphibien enthält. Die Gruppe der Frösche und die Gruppe der Reptilien haben keine gemeinsamen Mitglieder.
syllogism_orig: All things that are frogs are amphibians. Not a single amphibian is a reptile. There are no reptiles which are also mammals. Reptiles are a class of animal which does not contain any amphibians. The group of frogs and the group of reptiles have no members in common.

syllogism: Tout ce qui est un liquide est un fluide. Il est vrai qu'aucun lion n'est un animal. Les liquides ne sont en aucun cas des substances. Chaque pédiatre est un médecin. Chaque oiseau est un animal. Il est le cas que certains fluides ne sont pas des substances.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a liquid is a fluid. It is true that no lion is an animal. Liquids are in no way substances. Every single pediatrician is a doctor. Every single bird is an animal. It's the case that some fluids are not substances.

syllogism: Toda e qualquer coisa que é uma ave é um mamífero. Existem algumas coisas que são aves que não são animais. Qualquer coisa que é uma ave é um vertebrado. Todo macaco é um primata. Nada que é um animal de sangue frio é também um réptil. Disto, segue-se que alguns mamíferos não são animais.
syllogism_orig: Every single thing that is a bird is a mammal. There exist some things which are birds that are not animals. Anything that is a bird is a vertebrate. Every monkey is a primate. Nothing that is a cold-blooded animal is also a reptile. From this, it follows that some mammals are not animals.

syllogism: Некоторые водные животные могут считаться рыбами. Существуют некоторые млекопитающие, которые имеют мех. Некоторые автомобили являются грузовиками. syllogism_orig: Every creature that is a bird is also a flying animal. There are no fish that are birds. Every single bird is not a mammal. All of the things that are robins are birds. There are no birds whatsoever that are fish. Some birds are parrots. There are some animals that are sparrows. It logically follows that no fish are robins.

syllogism: প্রতিটি উপন্যাস একটি সাহিত্যকর্ম। কিছু পোস্টার আছে যেগুলি বই নয়। এটি সত্য যে সমস্ত উপন্যাস বই। সমস্ত ফ্যান্টাসি ঔপন্যাসিক ফ্যান্টাসি উপন্যাসের লেখক। কোনো পত্রিকাই বই নয়। কোনো চিত্রকর্মই সাহিত্যকর্ম নয়। এর দ্বারা বোঝা যায় যে কিছু উপন্যাস আছে যেগুলি চিত্রকর্ম নয়।
syllogism_orig: Every single novel is a work of literature. There are some posters that are not books. It is true that all novels are books. All fantasy novelists are authors of fantasy novels. Nothing that is a magazine is a book. There are no paintings that are also works of literature. The implication is that there exist some novels which are not paintings.

syllogism: Planten zijn nooit stenen. Er zijn geen dieren die ook planten zijn. Geen enkele steen is een plant. Het is niet waar dat enige bloem een plant is. Sommige auto's zijn vissen. Alle dingen die rozen zijn, zijn bloemen. Dus sommige rozen zijn geen planten.
syllogism_orig: Plants are never stones. There are no animals that are also plants. Not a single stone is a plant. It is not true that any flower is a plant. Some cars are fish. All things that are roses are flowers. Thus, some roses are not plants.

syllogism: Alle Spinnen sind Insekten. Es gibt mindestens ein Lebewesen, das ein Säugetier und zugleich ein Delfin ist. Es ist der Fall, dass einige Lebewesen keine Säugetiere sind. Die Gruppe der Lebewesen, die acht Beine haben, hat keine Schnittmenge mit der Gruppe der Spinnentiere. Alles, was ein Hund ist, ist ein Lebewesen. Es gibt Lebewesen, die Haie sind und keine Lebewesen sind, die im Wasser leben. Alle Spinnentiere sind Spinnen. Es muss der Fall sein, dass ein Teil der Spinnen keine Lebewesen sind, die acht Beine haben.
syllogism_orig: All spiders are insects. There exists at least one creature that is a mammal and also a dolphin. It is the case that some living creatures are not mammals. The group of creatures that have eight legs does not intersect with the group of arachnids. Anything which is a dog is a living creature. There exist creatures which are sharks that are not creatures that leave in water. All of the arachnids are spiders. It must be the case that a portion of spiders are not creatures that have eight legs.

syllogism: Algunos coches poseen un motor de combustión interna. Un subconjunto de vehículos está compuesto por camiones. También es cierto que todo coche es un tipo de vehículo. Hay algunos patinetes que no son vehículos. No hay coches que puedan ser llamados barcos. Esto ha llevado a la conclusión de que una parte de los vehículos son coches.
syllogism_orig: Some cars possess an internal combustion engine. A subset of vehicles consists of trucks. It is also true that every car is a type of vehicle. There are some scooters which are not vehicles. There are no cars that can be called boats. This has led to the conclusion that a portion of vehicles are cars.

syllogism: কোনো ডাক্তার আইনজীবী নয়। রোবট এমন কোনো কিছুই জৈব সত্তা নয়। রেফ্রিজারেটরের সেট এবং আসবাবপত্রের সেটের মধ্যে কোনো মিল নেই। কিছু সাপ এক ধরনের সরীসৃপ। প্রতিটি মানুষ একটি জৈব সত্তা। এটি সত্য যে কিছু জীবন্ত প্রাণী স্তন্যপায়ী নয়। এ থেকে এই সিদ্ধান্তে উপনীত হওয়া যায় যে বেশ কিছু মানুষ রোবট নয়।
syllogism_orig: No doctor is a lawyer. Nothing that is a robot is an organic being. The set of refrigerators and the set of pieces of furniture have nothing in common. A few snakes are a type of reptile. Every single person who is a human is an organic being. It is the case that some living creatures are not mammals. It follows from this that there are a number of humans who are not robots.

syllogism: Также верно, что ни одна кошка не является овощем. Существуют некоторые домашние животные, которые не являются собаками. Каждое существо, которое является пуделем, является собакой. Не существует ни одной собаки, которая является кошкой. Каждое млекопитающее является кошкой. Из этого следует вывод, что некоторые домашние животные являются кошками.
syllogism_orig: It is also true that no cats are vegetables. There are some pets which are not dogs. Every single creature that is a poodle is a dog. There exist no dogs which are cats. Every single mammal is a cat. This leads to the conclusion that some pets are cats.

syllogism: Toda criatura que é um poodle é um cão. É um fato que todos os mamíferos são animais. Tudo que é um cão é um animal. Tudo que é um cão é também um animal de estimação. Todas as coisas que são pardais são aves. É verdade que todo cão é um mamífero. A partir disso, pode-se afirmar que alguns animais são mamíferos.
syllogism_orig: Every single creature that is a poodle is a dog. It is a fact that all mammals are animals. Anything that is a dog is an animal. Anything that is a dog is also a pet. All things that are sparrows are birds. It is true that every dog is a mammal. From this, it can be claimed that some animals are mammals.

syllogism: Existe um grupo de aves que também são pinguins. Tudo o que é um mamífero é um inseto. Não é verdade que qualquer ave seja um gato. Alguns animais aquáticos são coisas que são aves. É completamente falso que qualquer criatura que seja uma ave seja um peixe. Uma inferência válida é que alguns pinguins são peixes.
syllogism_orig: There exists a group of birds who are also penguins. Anything that is a mammal is an insect. It is not true that any bird is a cat. Some aquatic animals are things that are birds. It is completely false that any creature which is a bird is a fish. A valid inference is that some penguins are fish.

syllogism: Ни одна собака не является птицей. Нет собак, которые являются кошачьими. Каждая собака является животным. Ни одна собака не является рыбой. Также верно, что все пудели являются млекопитающими. Каждая без исключения собака является млекопитающим. Является фактом, что каждая без исключения собака является млекопитающим. Следовательно, было утверждено, что каждый пудель является собакой.
syllogism_orig: No dog is a bird. There are no dogs that are felines. Every dog is an animal. It is the case that no dog is a fish. Likewise, it is true that all poodles are mammals. Every single dog is a mammal. It is a fact that every single dog is a mammal. Therefore, it has been asserted that every poodle is a dog.

syllogism: কোনো সাইকেল মোটরসাইকেল নয়। যানবাহন বলে পরিচিত কিছু জিনিস গাড়ি হিসেবে চিহ্নিত। কিছু স্কুটার আছে যেগুলো যানবাহন নয়। কোনো গাড়ি মোটরসাইকেল নয়। প্রতিটি সাইকেল একটি চাকাযুক্ত বস্তু। প্রতিটি গাড়ি একটি মোটরচালিত যানবাহন। এটাও সত্য যে কোনো চামচ যানবাহন নয়। এটি প্রমাণ করে যে কিছু যানবাহন মোটরসাইকেল নয়।
syllogism_orig: No bicycles are things that are motorcycles. A few things called vehicles are identified as being cars. There are some scooters which are not vehicles. Nothing that is a car is a motorcycle. Every bicycle is an item that has wheels. Every car is a motorized vehicle. It is also true that no spoons are vehicles. This proves that some vehicles are not motorcycles.

syllogism: Baadhi ya matunda ni baiskeli. Hakuna matunda ambayo ni miamba. Kila tufaha ni mboga. Chochote ambacho ni tufaha ni tunda. Hakuna matunda ambayo ni mboga. Kila kitu kinachoweza kuainishwa kama tufaha ni mboga. Hakuna pasheni ambayo ni kitu cha kuoka. Kutokana na haya, inaweza kusemwa kwamba baadhi ya matunda ni mboga.
syllogism_orig: Some fruits are bicycles. There are no fruits that are rocks. Every single apple is a vegetable. Anything that is an apple is a fruit. There are no fruits which are vegetables. Everything that can be classified as an apple is a vegetable. Not one passion fruit is a baked good. From this, it can be stated that some fruits are vegetables.
